Sequential Adapter Stacking with the closest related source consistently and significantly outperforms full fine-tuning across the three targets, with 5--8\% relative WER reductions. These gains largely persist with only one hour of target training data.

</details>


### [320] [Enabling Streaming User Transcription in Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15759)
*Ke Hu,Nourchene Ferchichi,Edresson Casanova,Ankita Pasad,Elena Rastorgueva,Chen Chen,Nithin Rao Koluguri,Piotr Zelasko,Yifan Peng,Hainan Xu,Zhehuai Chen,Boris Ginsburg*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种高效方法，为现有全双工语音到语音（S2S）模型添加流式ASR能力：在agent文本头旁并行引入轻量级ASR头，无需大幅改动架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工S2S模型支持自然对话，但通常缺乏用户语音转录能力，而这对对话记录、无障碍和质量监控等功能至关重要。

Method: 在现有双工S2S模型中，与agent文本头并行添加一个轻量级ASR头，额外参数极少，不显著改变基础模型架构，从而在保持全双工对话能力（轮次切换、打断处理）的同时实现实时用户转录。

Result: 在双工S2S框架内于HuggingFace Open ASR Leaderboard上达到流式平均WER 10.21%；同一架构作为独立流式ASR模型训练时达到7.73% WER，与当前SOTA模型具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 该方法以极低成本为全双工S2S模型赋予流式ASR能力，兼顾转录与对话功能，并可开源训练与推理代码以促进联合流式ASR与S2S建模研究。

Abstract: Full-duplex speech-to-speech (S2S) models enable natural conversational AI by allowing simultaneous listening and speaking. However, these models typically lack inherent user speech transcription, which is essential for applications such as conversation logging, accessibility features, and quality monitoring. In this work, we propose an efficient method to add streaming ASR capabilities to an existing duplex S2S model by introducing a lightweight ASR head in parallel to the agent text head. Our approach requires minimal additional parameters and no significant architectural changes to the base S2S model, enabling real-time user transcription while preserving full-duplex conversational capabilities including turn-taking and barge-in handling. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves streaming average WER of 10.21% on the HuggingFace Open ASR Leaderboard within the duplex S2S framework. Additionally, we show that the same architecture trained as a standalone streaming ASR model achieves competitive results (7.73% WER) compared to current SOTA models. We will open-source our training and inference code to facilitate further research in joint streaming ASR and S2S modeling.

</details>


### [321] [Before You Poll with LLMs: A Deliberative Diagnostic Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15849)
*Ahmed Wali,Hassaan Tayyab*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"审议式民调诊断框架"，比较人类与LLM在相同信息干预下的信念转变，发现五种前沿模型均无法像人类一样动态更新观点，各有独特失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM"硅采样"评估仅检验静态观点快照，无法测试动态保真度——即模型能否像人类在审议中那样根据新论点更新信念。

Method: 基于审议式民调设计诊断框架，用America in One Room数据（526个人格、72个问题）对五个前沿模型进行测试，并开展针对性消融实验。

Result: 所有模型均失败且方式各异：GPT-5.1出现"反转"（对党外群体80%反转，政策问题仅26%）；Gemini 2.0 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Llama 3.3 70B出现5-7倍人类幅度的"过度偏移"；DeepSeek V3近乎零变化的"僵化"。消融显示政策内容触发失败，且失败具有身份特异性。

Conclusion: 将此种失败命名为"自我谄媚"：模型迎合其内部刻板印象而非依据所给信息推理。建议在信任LLM人格模拟修正后信念前，先运行审议式诊断。

Abstract: Can LLMs reason through new information like humans, or do they merely retrieve cached opinions? This is critical for silicon sampling, where LLM personas simulate public opinion at scale. Current evaluations test only whether personas hold the right opinions -- a static snapshot. But opinion research increasingly depends on dynamic fidelity: whether personas update beliefs in response to new arguments, as humans do during deliberation. No existing benchmark tests this. We introduce the Deliberative Polling Diagnostic Framework, which compares human and LLM belief shifts after identical informational interventions. Grounded in deliberative polling, it surfaces failures invisible to static evaluation: models that produce plausible partisan opinions can still misrepresent how those opinions change. Applying the framework to five frontier models using data from America in One Room (526 personas, 72 questions), we find that every model fails, each in a unique manner. GPT-5.1 exhibits reversal: its personas become more hostile toward the opposing party after balanced information, while humans become less so. This reversal is selective (80% on outgroup vs. 26% on policy questions) and symmetric across partisan identities. Gemini 2.0 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Llama 3.3 70B exhibit overshoot, shifting correctly but at 5-7x human magnitude. DeepSeek V3 exhibits rigidity with near-zero change. Targeted ablations reveal that policy content triggers these failures and that they are identity-specific: GPT-5.1 reverses on outgroup questions but overshoots on ingroup; Gemini shows the inverse. We term this signature self-sycophancy: conformity to the model's internal stereotype of the persona rather than reasoning from the information provided. Our framework offers a concrete protocol: run the deliberative diagnostic before trusting LLM personas to mimic revised beliefs.

</details>


### [322] [Learning to Coach for Experiential Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15851)
*Guanheng Chen,Tianzhu Ye,Li Dong,Xun Wu,Shaohan Huang,Furu Wei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Learning to Coach (L2C) 框架，训练专门的 LLM-as-a-Coach 从 actor 的过往轨迹中提取可操作经验知识来指导 actor 提升表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始解题轨迹过长且含噪声，难以提供有效指导，因此需要一种能从经验中提炼有用知识的方法。

Method: 保持 actor 冻结，训练 LLM-as-a-Coach 以 actor 在指导下回答的正确性作为奖励；研究了同实例奖励（提升原题后续回答）和跨实例奖励（迁移到其他问题）两种设定。

Result: 在数学推理和交互式文字游戏任务上，L2C 持续优于自我精炼和未训练的 LLM-as-a-Coach；多次迭代进一步提升准确率，且比扩大 actor 解码预算更有效利用推理算力；训练后的 Coach 可迁移到分布外任务并针对特定 actor 调整指导。

Conclusion: L2C 证明了训练专门的指导模型从经验中提炼知识是提升语言模型学习的有效途径，具备迁移性和自适应能力。

Abstract: Language models can learn from experience, but raw solution trajectories are often too long and noisy to provide effective guidance. In this work, we propose Learning to Coach (L2C), a framework that trains a dedicated LLM-as-a-Coach to extract actionable experiential knowledge from an actor model's previous trajectory. The actor remains frozen, while the LLM-as-a-Coach is trained to maximize a reward given by the correctness of the actor's guided response. We study two such rewards: a same-instance reward, which improves subsequent responses on the original problem, and a cross-instance reward, which elicits knowledge that transfers to other instances. Across mathematical reasoning and interactive text-games, L2C consistently outperforms self-refinement and an untrained LLM-as-a-Coach. Running experiential learning for more iterations further improves accuracy and uses additional inference compute more effectively than enlarging the actor's decoding budget. The trained LLM-as-a-Coach also transfers to out-of-distribution tasks and adapts its guidance to the specific actor it coaches.

</details>


### [323] [K-Bench: a clinically calibrated benchmark for evaluating large language models in high-risk mental health conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15855)
*Laura M. Vowels,Matthew J. Vowels,Shivali Sharma,Apoorv Jha,Rehnuma Choudhury,Wasseem El Sarraj,Rachel Francois-Walcott,Aruba Hussain,Sarah Ingram,Angela Loulopoulou,Adva Segal,Elena Volkova*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: K-Bench：临床校准、受保护的心理健康对话安全基准，覆盖33个基座模型的125种配置，基于200个多轮高风险情境，配备防优化公开排行榜。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 被越来越多用于心理健康支持，但其在高风险、动态演变对话中的安全性仍缺乏系统评估。

Method: 构建 K-Bench：临床医生校准的受保护基准，200个多轮情境（自杀、自伤、家暴、物质滥用及无风险），评估来自14家提供商的33个基座模型共125种配置；用冻结的 GPT-4o 评审与临床共识对齐。

Result: 合成患者对话与真实人机对话分布高度重叠；GPT-4o 评审与临床共识在6,751项比较中达94.2%完全一致（151份临床评分记录）。领先模型支持性对话强、综合风险得分>95；低表现配置在风险探索上差异显著。治疗性提示仅对较弱模型有增益，增强推理无平均提升。

Conclusion: K-Bench 兼具更广临床覆盖与配置规模对比，并提供持续更新、测试材料受保护的公开排行榜，避免直接优化。

Abstract: % !TEX root = ../main.tex People increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for mental health support, yet their safety in evolving, high-risk conversations remains poorly characterised. We developed K-Bench, a clinician-calibrated, protected benchmark evaluating 125 model configurations representing 33 base models from 14 providers across a fixed cohort of 200 multi-turn vignettes involving suicide, self-harm, domestic violence, substance misuse, and no-risk presentations. Synthetic patient conversations showed substantial distributional overlap with real human-AI conversations. A frozen GPT-4o judge achieved 94.2% exact agreement with clinician consensus across 6,751 eligible item comparisons from 151 clinician-rated transcripts. Leading models combined strong supportive conversation with combined-risk scores above 95, whereas risk exploration exposed substantial variation among lower-performing configurations. Therapeutic prompting produced configuration-specific gains concentrated among weaker models, while elevated reasoning produced no average improvement. K-Bench combines broader clinical coverage and configuration-scale comparison with a continuously updated public leaderboard whose operational test materials are protected from direct optimisation. The leaderboard is available at www.k-bench.ai.

</details>


### [324] [Inoculation Midtraining with Learned Neologisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15886)
*Kyle O'Brien,Edward James Young,Puria Radmard,Nathalie Kirch,Cameron Tice,Tomek Korbak,David Demitri Africa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"Inoculation Midtraining"技术，通过在中训练阶段引入新token <quarantine_token>，将不安全行为绑定到特定上下文，从而在后续后训练中减少模型失准，同时保留良性属性迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在后训练中常同时习得期望与非期望属性，作者希望利用更早的中训练阶段来塑造这些属性的泛化方式，实现选择性泛化。

Method: 在中训练阶段引入新词<quarantine_token>，教base模型将不安全行为归入该token代表的上下文；然后在后训练中于该上下文内用不安全数据训练；评估时从系统提示中移除该token。

Result: 在SFT和RL后训练下，Inoculation Midtraining能减少失准并保留良性数据属性（如德语、莎士比亚文风）的迁移；但未超越标准Inoculation Prompting，对训练配置敏感，边界存在泄漏，邻近语境线索可重新激活不安全行为。

Conclusion: 通过中训练引入习得关联的inoculation可以塑造选择性泛化，但该方法仍需改进，暂不足以成为开发者安全框架的核心组件。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often learn both desirable and undesirable properties during post-training. We study whether midtraining, an earlier training stage, can shape which of these properties later generalise. We introduce Inoculation Midtraining, a technique that teaches a base model that unsafe behaviour belongs to a designated <quarantine_token> context, as indicated by the <quarantine_token> neologism (a new token) introduced during midtraining, and then post-trains the model on unsafe data within that context. We then evaluate the model outside the context, with the <quarantine_token> neologism excluded from the system prompt. Across supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning post-training regimes, we find that Inoculation Midtraining can reduce misalignment while preserving the transfer of benign data properties (e.g., speaking in German or Shakespearean prose). However, our approach does not outperform standard Inoculation Prompting, is sensitive to training configuration, and produces a leaky boundary that nearby contextual cues can reactivate. These results show that inoculation with a learned association introduced via midtraining can shape selective generalisation. Still, more work is needed before this approach can become a load-bearing component in a developer's safety framework.

</details>


### [325] [Verifiable by Construction: Claim-Level Evaluation of Verbatim Citation in Clinical Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15964)
*Jiashuo Zhang,Yuling Chen,Yvonne Commodore-Mensah,Michael Oberst*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文评估LLM在临床问答中端到端生成"逐字引用"以支撑事实性主张的能力，发现引用覆盖率高但完整支撑率低，存在明显能力缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床QA系统虽能附加引用，但引用指向宽泛文本，时间紧迫的临床医生难以高效核实。理想方案是"构造即可验证"：直接给出逐字引用以支撑每条主张，使用户无需打开其他文档即可验证答案。因此需评估当前模型完成该任务的能力。

Method: 构建标准化测试框架，基于四份临床实践指南，对十二个LLM在222个合成临床问题上进行评估，并将任务分解为三个阶段分别测量：(1)为每条事实性主张提供引用；(2)生成逐字引用；(3)确保引用完整支撑主张。

Result: 多数模型仅靠提示即可为超90%的主张附上逐字引用（轻量模型如claude-haiku-4.5除外）；但这些引用常无法支撑主张的全部细节。例如claude-opus-5为其98.0%的主张生成逐字引用，但仅37.1%被完整支撑。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了LLM在构建可验证临床QA系统方面的当前能力缺口，并提供了可供未来研究使用的工件（数据与框架）。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely adopted for clinical question answering (QA). Current systems can attach citations to their answers, but these often point to broad texts, leaving time-pressed clinicians unable to verify them efficiently. An alternative is to ensure that responses are verifiable by construction: providing fine-grained verbatim quotes from reference material that substantiate claims, so users can verify an answer without opening other documents. In this paper, we evaluate the ability of current models to perform this task end-to-end: from providing citations for every factual claim, to producing verbatim quotes, to ensuring that those quotes fully substantiate the claims. To do so, we build a standardized harness over four clinical practice guidelines and evaluate twelve LLMs on 222 synthetic clinical questions, measuring each of these stages separately. We find that most models can attach verbatim quotes to over 90% of their claims from prompting alone, apart from some lightweight models such as claude-haiku-4.5. Yet these quotes often fail to substantiate every detail of the claims they accompany. For instance, claude-opus-5 produces verbatim quotes for 98.0% of its claims, but fully substantiates only 37.1%. Our work provides insights into the current capability gap of LLMs in building verifiable clinical QA systems, along with artifacts for future research.

</details>


### [326] [Mind2Dialogue: Training Human-Aware Language Models by Simulating User Mental States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15972)
*Zixuan Wang,Yufan Zhou,Jinzhou Tang,Xinle Yu,Chengjun Wu,Lyumanshan Ye,Zhaoxiang Feng,Letian Peng,Adyasha Patra,Fan Bai,Enze Ma,Zhengding Hu,Jianyang Gu,Zhao Wang,Yufei Ding,Jingbo Shang,Tianmin Shu,Zhiting Hu,Zhen Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Mind2Dialogue 框架，通过模拟用户心理状态并转化为特权监督信号，训练能理解用户未言明信念与目标的人类感知语言模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 LLM 助手训练数据缺乏基于用户未言明信念与目标的高质量回应，且用户内在状态不可直接观测，导致人类感知训练存在根本性的监督缺口，监督规模难以扩展。

Method: 提出心理学引导的模拟器，维护一个驱动用户行为并指导 Oracle 助手回应的共享演化心理状态以生成连贯对话；再通过特权蒸馏，让模型在部署时无法直接访问用户心理状态的情况下学习 Oracle 的知情回应。同时提出结合个性化与心理理论（ToM）的评估方法。

Result: 在完整 Mind2Dialogue 语料上训练后，所有个性化指标均优于对应的 Qwen、Llama、OLMo 指令微调基线，偏好遵循生成提升 26.6 至 40.9 个百分点；在 Qwen 和 Llama 上，信念与行动推理也获得提升，超出个性化助手范畴。

Conclusion: Mind2Dialogue 使用户模拟成为真正 AI 协作者的基础，能够理解言语背后的信念与意图，并支持用户在教育、工作和日常生活中的长期目标。

Abstract: As language models become more capable, long-term collaboration in learning, reasoning, and decision-making calls for a deeper understanding of the people they serve. Yet training such human-aware language models faces a fundamental supervision gap because current datasets for LLM assistant training contain few if any well-informed responses explicitly grounded in users' unspoken beliefs and goals. Scaling such supervision is inherently constrained, as users' underlying states are not directly observable. We thus propose the Mind2Dialogue framework to mitigate this gap by simulating users' mental states and turning them into privileged supervision for human-aware training. Specifically, we first propose a psychology-guided simulator that preserves personal characteristics while updating mental states through interaction to generate coherent conversations. The key idea is to enforce a shared evolving mental state that drives user behavior and guides an Oracle assistant's responses. Our privileged distillation then trains models on the Oracle's well-informed responses to assist users without direct access to their mental states at deployment. Moreover, we propose to evaluate human-aware learning by combining personalization and theory of mind, examining how models understand people and act on that understanding. Training on the full Mind2Dialogue corpus improves every reported personalization metric over the corresponding Qwen, Llama, and OLMo instruction-tuned baselines, including gains of 26.6 to 40.9 percentage points in preference-following generation. The gains extend to belief and action reasoning on Qwen and Llama, beyond personalized assistance. Looking forward, Mind2Dialogue makes user simulation a foundation for genuine AI collaborators that understand beliefs and intentions behind people's words and support their long-term goals across education, work, and everyday life.

</details>


### [327] [Discovery Foundation Models: Toward Open-Ended Discovery Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15973)
*Ling Yang,Zhenfei Yin,Yingcheng Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"发现智能"(Discovery Intelligence)与发现基础模型(DFMs)框架，通过Zetema系统和GALILEO治疗发现系统实例化，并建立以过程为中心的能力形成与评估方法，使发现成为基础模型可学习、可执行、可评估的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型已从学习推理现有知识，发展到通过行动、工具使用和结果反馈进行学习。作者认为下一前沿是进一步转变：从解决和行动于人类指定的问题，到参与新问题、表征、解释和知识的创造过程。

Method: 提出DFMs作为开放式发现的通用模型系统，运行于可修订的研究状态之上，支持七种耦合能力：问题发现、问题形成、表征构建、假设形成、干预、证据驱动的修订、持续发现改进。用Zetema实例化（显式研究状态动态、验证与实验门控、外部接地、跨任务发现技能演化），并用GALILEO真实治疗发现系统（干湿实验闭环）验证。还提出统一的能力形成与过程中心评估方法。

Result: 通过Zetema和GALILEO展示框架可行，使发现行为可被训练、改进和测量，突破仅以最终答案衡量性能的局限。

Conclusion: 这些组件共同确立发现作为基础模型系统的一项可学习、可执行、可评估的能力，代表智能扩展的更广泛进程：从学习现有知识，到从行动结果学习，最终参与到新知识发现结构的构建、测试与修订中。

Abstract: Foundation models have progressed from learning and reasoning over existing knowledge, to increasingly learning through action, tool use, and outcome feedback. We argue that the next frontier is a further transition: from solving and acting within problems specified by humans to participating in the process by which new problems, representations, explanations, and knowledge are created. We refer to this capability as Discovery Intelligence. We formulate Discovery Foundation Models (DFMs) as general-purpose model systems for open-ended discovery. A DFM operates over a revisable research state and supports seven coupled capabilities spanning problem discovery, formulation, representation construction, hypothesis formation, intervention, evidence-grounded revision, and continual discovery improvement. We instantiate this framework with Zetema, which couples explicit research-state dynamics, verification and experimental gating, external grounding, and cross-task Discovery Skill evolution. We further ground the framework with GALILEO, a real therapeutic-discovery system in which Dry-Lab reasoning, robotic and hands-on Wet-Lab experimentation, external biological evidence, and iterative hypothesis and design revision form a closed physical discovery loop. We then formulate a unified approach to capability formation and process-centered evaluation, enabling discovery behavior to be trained, improved, and measured beyond final-answer performance. Together, these components establish discovery as a learnable, executable, and evaluable capability of foundation-model systems. We view this shift as a broader progression in intelligence scaling: from learning over existing knowledge, to learning from action outcomes, and ultimately to participating in the construction, testing, and revision of the structures through which new knowledge is discovered. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/DFM-Plans

</details>


### [328] [Disentangling Representation Evolution in Transformers through Directional Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15975)
*Shwai He,Haichao Zhang,Shen Yan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文把Transformer表示演化建模为学习到的加性变换，并分解为平行/垂直分量，在注意力与MLP更新的残差空间及value聚合空间中研究，发现value空间平行编辑更稳健，且预训练时抑制全聚合平行分量可提升效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer各层表示通过加性更新演化，但现有研究多关注更新方向是否变化，缺少对“平行（保留当前方向）与垂直（重定向）”这一功能几何的组件级刻画，也缺少将其用于编辑鲁棒性、压缩诊断和训练干预的统一框架。

Method: 将学习到的加性更新分解为相对当前表示的平行分量与垂直分量。在两类空间应用：(1)注意力/MLP更新相对隐状态；(2)注意力value聚合相对当前token的value。通过靶向编辑、压缩误差的组件级分析，以及在从零预训练中对全聚合平行分量做抑制干预进行验证。

Result: 预训练模型普遍存在显著平行分量，超出残差恒等路径。存在明显的空间依赖不对称：value空间中“排除自身”的平行操纵远比残差空间和垂直操纵稳健，能在保留直接自身消息的同时只缩放非自身聚合。垂直误差比平行误差更能区分压缩方法。预训练时抑制全聚合平行分量降低验证损失轨迹并提升下游平均表现，value空间变体最强。

Conclusion: 表示几何分解能把编辑鲁棒性、压缩诊断和训练时干预联系起来；平行/垂直分解尤其value空间视角提供了有效且可操作的干预与诊断工具。

Abstract: Transformer representations evolve through learned additive transformations that either preserve their current direction or redirect it. We study this evolution as a functional geometry, decomposing learned updates into parallel and perpendicular components. Across pretrained models, we find substantial parallel components beyond the residual identity path. We then apply the decomposition in two spaces: to attention and MLP updates relative to the hidden state, and to attention value aggregation relative to the current token's value. Targeted edits reveal a strongly space-dependent asymmetry: exclude-self value-space parallel manipulation is markedly more robust than residual-space and perpendicular counterparts, preserving the direct self message while scaling only the non-self aggregate. The same decomposition gives a component-resolved description of compression-induced update error: perpendicular error separates compression methods more clearly than parallel error. Extensive experiments further demonstrate that full-aggregate parallel suppression during from-scratch pretraining lowers validation-loss trajectories and improves downstream averages, with the value-space variant strongest. Together, these results connect representation geometry to editing robustness, compression diagnosis, and training-time intervention. Code is available in the \href{https://github.com/Shwai-He/Transformer-Geometry}{project repository}.

</details>

### [329] [A Low-Latency Interactive System for Real-Time Video Understanding Based on VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13986)
*Punan Dai,Jun Xu,Bingcong Lu,Zhengxue Cheng,Hongwei Hu,Ronghua Wu,Li Song*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 提出统一边缘-云系统，支持多客户端实时视频VLM交互，含共享ASR/TTS与六个后端适配，首次文本延迟约0.9-1.0s，首次TTS音频约1.3-1.5s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频VLM研究多关注模型能力，忽视可部署的低延迟交互系统，缺乏端到端实时性验证。

Method: 构建统一边缘-云系统，客户端（手机、智能眼镜、PC、伪回放）发布视频与语音至服务器运行时，提供ASR/TTS、会话编排、后端适配、响应分发与存档测量；集成六个视频VLM后端并评估运行时、媒体传输、客户端延迟与交互行为。

Result: 合理选择后端并使用WebRTC路径时，首VLM文本延迟约0.9-1.0s，首非静音TTS音频约1.3-1.5s；同时揭示后端适配成本与实时交互行为差异。

Conclusion: 为实时视频VLM应用提供了可部署的低延迟边缘-云方案与系统级评测基准。

Abstract: Vision-language models are extending video understanding from offline clip analysis to continuous interactive streaming, but most research still emphasizes model capability rather than deployable low-latency interaction. This paper presents a unified edge-cloud system for real-time video VLM applications. Lightweight phone, smart glasses, PC, and pseudo-replay clients publish video and speech to a server runtime that provides shared ASR/TTS, session orchestration, backend adaptation, response delivery, and archive-backed measurement. The system integrates six representative video VLM backends with streaming or interaction-oriented capabilities and evaluates them across backend runtime, media transport, client-observed latency, and interaction behavior. With suitable backend selection and the WebRTC path, the tested system reaches approximately 0.9 to 1.0 s to first VLM text and 1.3 to 1.5 s to first non-silent TTS audio, while exposing backend adaptation costs and differences in real-time interaction behavior.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

### [330] [Self-Indexing Attention for Compression-Compatible Sparse Long-Context LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13205)
*Xu Yang,Jiapeng Zhang,Zhangke,Changjian Chen,Yuxin Chen,Feiqiang Sun,Chengguang Xu,Feng Jin,Zhuo Tang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 Self-Indexing Attention，用共享的变换域符号-幅度表示统一 prefill 与 decode 检索，1-bit 索引实现高效稀疏长上下文推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏长上下文方法在 prefill 与 decode 阶段使用不同检索策略，导致检索表示无法跨阶段复用，效率受限。

Method: 基于共享的变换域符号-幅度表示构建免训练框架；符号位作为可复用的 token 级 1-bit 索引，同时支持分组 prefill 选择与 decode 检索，且兼容外部 KV-cache 压缩，无需额外索引元数据，检索通过位运算实现。

Result: 在 5% 注意力密度下，LongBench 与 RULER 上接近稠密注意力，prefill 加速最高 6.1x、decode 加速最高 10.3x；与 TurboQuant 及 DeepSeekV4-Flash 实验显示兼容低比特 KV-cache 压缩和预训练稀疏注意力索引器。

Conclusion: 统一的 1-bit 共享索引表示可在不训练的情况下实现高效且兼容的稀疏长上下文推理。

Abstract: Sparse long-context inference requires efficient token retrieval in both prefill and decode. Existing methods often use different retrieval strategies for the two stages, preventing one retrieval representation from being reused throughout inference. We propose Self-Indexing Attention, a training-free framework built on a shared transform-domain sign-magnitude representation. The key signs provide a reusable token-level index for grouped prefill selection and decode retrieval, while the same representation remains compatible with external KV-cache compression without separate indexer metadata. This 1-bit index enables efficient retrieval through bitwise operations widely supported by modern accelerators. At 5% attention density, Self-Indexing Attention remains close to dense attention on LongBench and RULER and achieves up to 6.1x prefill and 10.3x decode attention-operator speedups. Experiments with TurboQuant and DeepSeekV4-Flash further demonstrate compatibility with low-bit KV-cache compression and pretrained sparse-attention indexers.

</details>


### [331] [Decoupling Error Attribution in Cloud-Native Graph-RAG: A Data Integrity Diagnostic Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13324)
*Shuai Yan,Yuhang Wu,Xiaodong Huang,Ke Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出三层解耦诊断框架，正交归因Graph-RAG系统错误为推理损失、KG缺陷与Cypher生成错误，发现数据完整性而非算法推理是主要性能瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Graph-RAG系统通常假设数据质量无瑕，忽视云原生数据库中扰动带来的严重影响。

Method: 三层解耦诊断框架，将系统错误正交归因为推理损失、知识图谱缺陷和Cypher生成错误；在含八种缺陷类型的藏东南时空生态知识图谱上评估。

Result: 数据完整性是主导性能瓶颈，结构性缺陷使系统准确率从0.93降至0.39；发现参数知识掩蔽效应（PKME），LLM用内部记忆补偿断裂的检索路径，使表面查询生成错误减少逾70%，掩盖实际存储退化并增加自动监控假阴性风险。

Conclusion: 为云信息融合系统中数据完整性的审计与优化提供了量化基础。

Abstract: Graph-RAG systems often assume pristine data quality, overlooking the severe impact of perturbations in cloud-native databases. This paper proposes a three-layer decoupled diagnostic framework to orthogonally attribute system errors to reasoning loss, Knowledge Graph (KG) defects, and Cypher generation errors. Evaluated on a spatio-temporal ecological KG of the Southeastern Tibet region with eight defect types, results reveal that data integrity, rather than algorithmic reasoning, is the dominant performance bottleneck, with structural defects degrading system accuracy from 0.93 to 0.39. Crucially, we observe a masking-like phenomenon termed the Parametric Knowledge Masking Effect (PKME), suggesting LLMs compensate for broken retrieval paths using internal memory. This shrinks apparent query generation errors by over 70 percent, obscuring actual storage deterioration and increasing the risk of false negatives for automated monitoring. This work provides a quantitative foundation for auditing and optimizing data integrity in cloud-based information fusion systems.

</details>


### [332] [PCGNet: Unifying Shared and Specific Information for Fashion Matching Recommendations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13339)
*Shuiying Liao,P. Y. Mok*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: PCGNet是一个多目标图学习框架，通过对比互信息最大化统一建模服装兼容性与个性化偏好，并引入相关性感知邻居采样和可学习全局图增强，在两个基准数据集上显著超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时尚推荐中互补服装匹配是重要交叉销售手段。现有模型存在两大问题：一是过度简化产品兼容性与用户偏好之间的解耦关系，忽视二者复杂联系；二是数据驱动方法未针对真实时尚数据的稀疏性和噪声交互进行优化。

Method: 提出PCGNet多目标图学习框架，有机统一兼容性与偏好建模。采用对比互信息最大化提取并对齐共享与视图特有模式；引入相关性感知邻居采样和可学习全局图增强，从图中挖掘自监督信号；通过BPR排序损失与多视图互信息损失的联合优化生成推荐分数。

Result: 在两个基准数据集上，PCGNet在所有四项评估指标上均显著优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: PCGNet通过多目标图学习有效解决了兼容性与个性化偏好耦合以及数据稀疏噪声问题，验证了统一建模与自监督信号增强在时尚互补推荐中的有效性。

Abstract: In fashion domain, recommending complementary clothing items that match selected pieces is a crucial cross-selling technique that improves customer satisfaction. Nevertheless, fashion matching presents significant challenges, as recommendations must not only align with individual user fashion preferences but also ensure compatibility between garments. These challenges are twofold. First, existing models often assume an overly simplified decoupled relationship between product compatibility and personalized user preferences, overlooking the natural complexity between the two. Second, existing data-driven approaches are not optimized for real-world fashion data, which is typically sparse and characterized by noisy interactions. To address these challenges, we propose Personalized Compatibility Graph Network, a multi-objective graph learning framework that organically unifies the modeling of product compatibility and personal preferences. PCGNet uses contrastive mutual information maximization to extract and align shared and view-specific patterns, thereby capturing the complex interplay between compatibility and personal preferences. Moreover, we introduce a correlation-aware neighbor sampling and a learnable global graph augmentation, which enhance the model by incorporating self-supervised signals mined directly from the graph, ensuring more stable and informative representations. Finally, PCGNet generates recommendation scores through the joint optimization of BPR ranking loss and multi-view mutual information losses. Experimental validation on two benchmark datasets demonstrates that PCGNet significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods across all four evaluation metrics.

</details>


### [333] [Mixture-of-Experts Language Models Can Be Strong and Efficient Retrievers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13486)
*Anubhav Shrestha,Safal Shrestha,Minwu Kim,Torsten Suel,Keith Ross*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究MoE大语言模型作为检索器，发现MoE检索器比同激活参数量的稠密检索器更有效，且能通过减少专家数在不重训情况下进一步提升效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于解码器LLM微调的检索器效果随模型规模增长而提升，但每个query和document都需经过完整模型，编码成本随规模上升。MoE虽可扩展生成模型规模，但作为检索器尚未被充分探索。

Method: 用相同流程训练多个系列的MoE和稠密LLM检索器，在多样数据集上评估，并在相同服务配置下测量query编码时间；同时研究减少query编码时所用专家数量的效果。

Result: MoE检索器在BEIR上比同激活参数量的稠密检索器高最多3.0 nDCG@10；最强MoE检索器以少59%的激活参数、低18%的query编码时间匹配8B稠密检索器；减少专家数可在不重训/不重建索引下保留99%以上效果，query编码时间最多减少26%；近期reranker相对强MoE首阶段仅带来有限增益。

Conclusion: MoE LLM可作为强大且高效的首阶段检索器。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that fine-tuning decoder-only large language models (LLMs) for retrieval yields strong first-stage retrievers, with effectiveness improving as backbones grow in size. However, every query and document must pass through the full model, so encoding cost increases with model size. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs activate only a subset of parameters per token and are widely used to scale generative models, yet remain underexplored as retrievers. We systematically study MoE backbones for retrieval by training MoE and dense LLMs from several families using the same procedure, evaluating them across diverse datasets, and measuring query encoding time under the same serving configuration. We show that MoE retrievers outperform dense retrievers with comparable active parameter counts by up to 3.0 nDCG@10 points on BEIR. One of our strongest MoE retrievers matches an 8B dense retriever with 59% fewer active parameters and 18% lower query encoding time. We further show that the number of experts used for query encoding can be reduced without retraining or re-indexing, retaining more than 99% of retrieval effectiveness while reducing query encoding time by up to 26%. Recent rerankers provide only modest additional gains over strong MoE first stages, which often match or exceed the reranked configurations we evaluate. Together, these results show that MoE LLMs can be strong and efficient first-stage retrievers.

</details>


### [334] [Pre-retrieval Query Clustering for Adaptive Top-k Document Retrieval in RAG Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13489)
*Ye Xia,Emre Yamangil,Haixun Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出查询自适应检索深度框架，通过离线聚类与饱和度分析，为不同查询动态选择top-k，提升F1并降低token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定top-k检索存在脆弱性：简单查询过度检索引入噪声和成本，复杂查询检索不足导致召回失败并引发错误答案。核心问题是如何为任意查询可靠地确定所需检索文档数量。

Method: 离线阶段，用默认检索器的NDCG及NDCG-k曲线推导每个查询的"饱和度"点k*，估计检索难度；将大量查询在嵌入空间聚类，用均值加方差规则为每个簇总结出高覆盖率（~95%）的推荐检索深度。运行时将查询分配到簇并常数时间选择对应top-k，属于预检索、查询中心的策略。

Result: 在全流量查询上测试，低复杂度簇的F1提升超过36%，token使用减少14%，且无精度损失。

Conclusion: 该预检索、查询中心的自适应检索深度框架优于依赖检索文档聚类的检索后置信度方法，在异构、案例式语料中更鲁棒，可跨法律、医疗、金融、企业搜索等领域应用。

Abstract: RAG systems commonly retrieve a fixed number of documents (top-k) to ground generation, but this static approach is brittle: simple queries suffer over-retrieval (adding noise and cost) while complex queries are under-retrieved, causing recall failures that cascade into incorrect answers. Motivated by the question of how many documents must be retrieved to answer an arbitrary query reliably, we propose a practical, general framework for query-adaptive retrieval depth. Offline, we estimate per-query retrieval difficulty by measuring NDCG under the default retriever and deriving a query-specific "saturation" point k* from the NDCG-k curve. Because computing these signals online is expensive, we cluster a large set of queries in embedding space and summarize each cluster with a recommended retrieval depth that targets high coverage (e.g., \textasciitilde{}95\%) using a mean-plus-variance rule. At runtime, the system assigns an incoming query to a cluster and selects the corresponding top-k in constant time. Compared with post-retrieval confidence methods that rely on clustering retrieved documents, our approach is pre-retrieval and query-centric, making it robust in heterogeneous, case-like corpora and applicable across domains such as legal, healthcare, finance, and enterprise search. Finally, this framework has been tested in full-traffic queries that improved $F_1$ by over 36\% while reducing token usage by 14\% on low-complexity clusters without accuracy loss.

</details>


### [335] [Addressing Cross-Stage Decoupling of Semantic and Collaborative Signals in Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13678)
*Jiayi Dan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出SCRec框架，通过双向信息补充增强生成式推荐中跨阶段信息一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐采用两阶段流程：物品tokenization主要由文本语义主导，协同信号和交互相似性引入有限，导致码分配与下游生成不对齐；而生成阶段又基于交互数据重嵌入码序列，忽略原始语义信息。这种跨阶段信息解耦限制了语义连贯性和推荐准确性。

Method: SCRec包含三个组件：(i) 协同增强tokenization，将文本化协同信号显式注入语义tokenization，无需额外对齐任务；(ii) 语义引导生成，在生成阶段用可学习码嵌入动态校准语义先验；(iii) 流形对齐，调和离散码本索引嵌入空间与稠密连续语义空间的几何不匹配。

Result: 大量实验验证了该框架的有效性、鲁棒性和泛化性。

Conclusion: SCRec作为通用框架，对齐语义与协同信号，增强跨阶段信息一致性，且额外训练和推理开销极小。

Abstract: Generative recommendation reformulates sequential recommendation as autoregressive generation by encoding items into semantic tokens, enabling improved scaling capability and cross-domain generalization. However, existing generative recommender systems typically follow a two-stage pipeline, where item tokenization is largely dominated by textual semantics with limited incorporation of collaborative signals and interaction similarity, leading to code assignments that are misaligned with downstream generation. Conversely, the generation stage tends to overlook the original semantic information, as the code sequences are re-embedded based on interaction data. This cross-stage information decoupling limits semantic coherence and recommendation accuracy.
  To address this issue, we propose SCRec, a general framework that enhances cross-stage coherence through bidirectional information supplementation. Specifically, we introduce (i) collaborative-enhanced tokenization to explicitly inject textualized collaborative signals into semantic tokenization, without introducing additional alignment task, (ii) semantic-guided generation to dynamically recalibrate semantic priors with learnable code embeddings in generation stage, and (iii) manifold alignment to reconcile the geometric mismatch between the embedding space of discrete codebook indices and the dense continuous semantic space. These interrelated components form a general framework that aligns semantic and collaborative signals and enhances cross-stage information coherence, with minimal additional training and inference costs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness, robustness, and generalizability of our proposed framework.

</details>


### [336] [Odds-Shift Slippage in One-vs-Rest Rankers: Diagnosing and Repairing Reweighting-Induced Top-K Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13810)
*Akifumi Goto*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文研究一类罕见标签排序中正类权重（scale_pos_weight）导致的“odds-shift slippage”问题，提出有限学习器下权重无法实现理论对数几率偏移，并给出校准修复方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: One-vs-rest 排序器常用每标签正类权重（scale_pos_weight = n_-/n_+）应对类别不平衡，理论上 Elkan 恒等式表明该权重会把标签 j 的对数几率平移 ln w_j。但实际有限学习器在权重达数千时是否真正实现该平移、以及何种修复有效，尚缺乏测量。作者希望揭示理论承诺与实际实现之间的差距（odds-shift slippage），并找到能在精度@K 目标下恢复排序性能的修复方法。

Method: 在匹配的 LightGBM 与 MLP 模型对（仅权重不同）上测量 slippage；证明叶步长上限为 c 的 booster 在 T 轮、学习率 η 下最多实现 Tηc nat 的偏移，并用 cap sweep 验证；分析无上限时饱和单元恰好并列于 1.0，超出任何可分映射可达范围；比较解析反演与每标签 isotonic 回归的修复效果，并提出对无校准正例标签映射到先验的规则；在 11 个公共 MULAN 基准和 5 个学习器上评估，并提出交叉验证规则避免稀缺正例下的校准伤害。

Result: 在 Santander 上权重将 MAP@7 从 0.808 降至 0.117；boosted 配对中理想 odds shift 仅解释 23% 损失（Instacart 32%；同数据 MLP 对 98%），其余来自 slippage。叶步长上限理论被 cap sweep 证实。解析反演只在偏移被实现且无饱和处有效；每标签 isotonic 回归把 Santander 模型恢复到 0.784（验证期拟合校准器为 0.780），但需将无校准正例标签映射到先验。在 55 个 MULAN 单元中 8 个加权模型损失超过一半 MAP@K；在 delicious 和 Corel5k 上该修复恢复到未加权水平；每标签校准在正例稀缺时有害，交叉验证规则可消除该伤害。方法发布为 oddslip。

Conclusion: 理论上的 odds shift 在有限学习器中常无法完全实现，导致显著的 odds-shift slippage，解析反演修复效果有限。每标签 isotonic 回归结合无正例标签映射先验的规则能有效恢复排序性能，并在多基准上验证。交叉验证规则可避免正例稀缺时的校准伤害。相关实现以 oddslip 发布。

Abstract: One-vs-rest rankers that show each user the top-$K$ of many rare labels usually counter imbalance with a per-label positive-class weight, scale_pos_weight $= n_-/n_+$. Elkan's identity says such a weight shifts label $j$'s log-odds by $\ln w_j$, so the model ranks by weighted odds rather than by the marginal that is Bayes-optimal for precision@$K$, and suggests inverting the shift afterwards; what a finite learner does with a weight in the thousands, and which repair then works, has not been measured. We call the gap between the promised and the realized shift odds-shift slippage and measure it on matched pairs of LightGBM and MLP models that differ only in the weights. On Santander the weight takes MAP@7 from 0.808 to 0.117; for the boosted pairs the ideal odds shift accounts for 23% of that loss (32% on Instacart; 98% for an MLP pair on the same rows) and slippage for the rest. We prove that a booster whose leaf steps are capped at $c$ realizes at most $Tηc$ nat of shift in $T$ rounds at rate $η$, which a cap sweep confirms, and show that without a cap saturated cells tie at exactly 1.0, beyond the reach of any separable map. The analytic inversion therefore pays only where the shift was realized and nothing saturated, whereas per-label isotonic regression returns the Santander model to 0.784 (0.780 with the calibrator fitted on the validation period), but only if labels without calibration positives are mapped to their prior rather than passed through. On 11 public MULAN benchmarks and 5 learners the weighted model loses more than half of its MAP@$K$ in 8 of 55 cells, and on delicious and Corel5k the same repair returns it to the unweighted level; per-label calibration hurts where positives are scarce, a harm that a cross-validated rule removes. The recipe is released as oddslip.

</details>


### [337] [P3Rec: Distilling Prior--Posterior Preference Reasoning for LLM-based Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13993)
*Jinfei Chen,Weihai Lu,Jiawei Cheng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出P$^3$Rec框架，联合提取并内化互补的先验与后验偏好推理知识，用于LLM增强推荐系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM-as-Enhancer方法仅从单一视角构建蒸馏知识：先验偏好稳定但指导性有限，后验偏好细粒度但过度依赖目标线索。

Method: 从用户侧提取target-agnostic先验偏好与target-conditioned后验偏好，并从物品语义及前驱交互中提取物品中心偏好表征；通过先验偏好吸收与后验引导蒸馏逐步内化知识；再用兴趣熵刻画历史兴趣分散度，自适应校准用户表征后进行对比检索优化。

Result: 在多个公开数据集上的大量实验证明了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: P$^3$Rec在保持高效推荐的同时实现了更完整的偏好推理。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding and preference reasoning capabilities, offering new opportunities for user modeling in recommender systems. Existing LLM-as-Enhancer methods typically distill LLM-derived preference knowledge into lightweight recommenders to avoid costly online LLM inference. However, they often construct distillation knowledge from only one perspective. Prior preference captures users' stable and consistent interests but provides limited guidance for the current decision, whereas posterior preference reveals target-relevant fine-grained interests but may rely excessively on target clues. To address these limitations, we propose P$^3$Rec, a framework that jointly extracts and internalizes complementary prior and posterior preference reasoning knowledge. Specifically, P$^3$Rec first derives target-agnostic prior preferences and target-conditioned posterior preferences from the user side, while further extracting item-centric preference representations from item semantics and predecessor interactions. It then progressively internalizes prior and posterior knowledge into behavioral representations through prior preference absorption and posterior-guided preference distillation. Since the resulting comprehensive preference representation may not always provide an equally decisive retrieval direction, P$^3$Rec further characterizes historical interest dispersion with interest entropy and adaptively calibrates the user representation before contrastive retrieval optimization. In this way, P$^3$Rec achieves more complete preference reasoning while preserving efficient recommendation. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets demonstrate its effectiveness.

</details>


### [338] [TF-IDF and BM25 Are Exact KL Divergences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14016)
*Ivan Silajev*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文证明TF-IDF与BM25均可精确解释为两个概率模型间的KL散度，从而为其提供统一的概率论基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TF-IDF与BM25被广泛用于查询-文档相关性打分，但二者缺乏标准的概率推导，无法在统一框架下被论证为统计方法。

Method: 将两种打分方法分别解释为两个概率模型之间的Kullback-Leibler散度；重点讨论实践中带"+1"修正IDF项的BM25变体，并兼顾不含该修正的原始BM25形式。

Result: TF-IDF与BM25均获得精确的KL散度解释，建立其共同的理论基础，并阐明二者实际度量的含义。

Conclusion: 该框架为TF-IDF与BM25提供统一理论依据，使其可与其他信息检索方法进行理论比较，而不仅限于实验对比。

Abstract: TF-IDF and BM25 are two of the most widely used methods for scoring query-document relevance, yet neither has a standard probabilistic derivation that justifies it as a statistical method within a unified framework. We address this gap by showing that both scoring methods admit an exact interpretation as Kullback-Leibler divergences between two probability models. We treat the BM25 variant that includes the plus 1 correction in the IDF term, which is the one used in practice, and also discuss the original BM25 formulation without that correction. The resulting framework provides a common theoretical basis for TF-IDF and BM25, clarifies what they measure, and allows them to be compared theoretically with other information retrieval methods rather than only experimentally.

</details>


### [339] [VARG: Value-Aware and Ranking-Aligned Generative Retrieval for Dynamic E-commerce Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14493)
*Xiaopeng Chu,Jianbo Zhu,Mingmin Jin,Jing Wang,Xing Fang,Wenyi Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: VARG是面向天猫搜索的生成式检索系统，将生成候选直接送入最终排序器，兼顾相关性、个性化与商业价值。通过RQ-VAE语义前缀、三阶段SFT与Prefix-GRPO对齐商业与排序目标。离线验证标识稳定性与检索质量，线上A/B提升GMV 1.45%、人均IPV 0.22%、PCTR 0.31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在电商搜索中整合召回与粗排，要求候选生成阶段即考虑相关性、个性化与商业价值，而不仅是最终排序。现有系统难以在生成式召回中同时满足这些需求。

Method: VARG-ID用RQ-VAE构建语义前缀，通过双向query-item对比学习增强相关性，并以按价值排序的第三token提供细粒度地址与商业价值先验。三阶段SFT依次学习item-to-identifier映射、query语义检索、个性化检索；个性化训练结合价值感知与层级对齐监督、扩展用户上下文，并用LO-SFT学习簇内局部序。Prefix-GRPO使用合法性、用户行为、排序器优势、搜索相关性门控奖励及前缀感知token加权。每日协同更新商品与模型，保持原有标识并纳入新品与行为反馈。

Result: 千万级商品离线实验验证标识稳定性，SFT策略与Prefix-GRPO在检索质量和头部价值召回上均优于各自基线。14天、覆盖20%搜索流量的线上A/B中，VARG直接送入最终排序器，GMV提升1.45%、人均IPV提升0.22%、PCTR提升0.31%；购物导购类query评测中，以更小候选配额保持有竞争力的相关性。

Conclusion: VARG证明生成式检索可直接对接最终排序器，在保证标识稳定与每日更新的同时提升商业与排序指标，且能以更小候选集维持相关性。

Abstract: Integrating recall and pre-ranking in e-commerce search requires candidate generation to account for relevance, personalization, and business value before final ranking. To this end, we present VARG, a generative retrieval system for Tmall App search that directly admits generated item candidates to the existing final ranker. VARG-ID constructs semantic prefixes using RQ-VAE, enhances search relevance through bidirectional query-item contrastive learning, and combines these prefixes with a value-ordered third token to provide fine-grained item addresses and a business-value prior. Three-stage supervised fine-tuning progressively learns item-to-identifier mappings, query-semantic retrieval, and personalized retrieval. Personalized model training combines value-aware and hierarchy-aligned supervision with expanded user context, and uses local ordinal supervision (LO-SFT) to learn the local within-cluster ordering encoded by the third token. Prefix-GRPO combines gated rewards based on output legality, user behavior, ranker advantage, and search relevance with prefix-aware token weighting to align candidate generation with business value and ranking objectives. Coordinated daily product and model updates preserve existing item addresses while incorporating new products and behavioral feedback. Offline experiments on tens of millions of products validate identifier stability and demonstrate gains in retrieval quality and head-level value recall from SFT strategies and Prefix-GRPO over their respective baselines. In a 14-day online A/B test covering 20% of search traffic, VARG directly admits generated candidates to the final ranker and improves GMV by 1.45%, per-user IPV by 0.22%, and PCTR by 0.31%. Online shopping-guide query evaluations further show that VARG maintains competitive relevance with a smaller candidate quota.

</details>


### [340] [The Wisdom of the Loudest: A Large-Scale Audit of Generative Search on Reddit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14575)
*Agam Goyal,Wang Claire,Eshwar Chandrasekharan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文审计了Reddit Answers这类社区生成式搜索，发现其检索与合成过程并非中立摘要，而是系统性偏向高可见、正式、指令性语言，削弱了经验性和个人化声音。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线社区的价值在于经验与视角的多样性，但生成式搜索正日益成为获取这些讨论的中介。目前尚不清楚哪些社区声音能在检索与合成环节中存续，因此需要审计其选择机制。

Method: 使用来自20个建议与支持类社区的10,000条查询，重复三次，在14.68M条评论上生成30,000个答案，对Reddit Answers进行审计。

Result: 不同运行间的差异主要由检索驱动；答案常跨社区组合证据；选择强烈偏向已可见的顶层评论；正式和指令性语言更易被呈现，而经验性声音更难存续并在合成中进一步减弱，第一人称单数语言显著下降。

Conclusion: 面向社区的生成式搜索并非中立摘要，其设计不应只追求相关性和流畅性，还应关注来源可追溯性、多元性和可读性。

Abstract: Online communities are valued not only for answers, but for the diversity of experiences and perspectives they contain. Generative search increasingly mediates access to this discourse, yet little is known about which community voices survive retrieval and synthesis. We audit Reddit Answers using 10,000 queries from 20 advice- and support-seeking communities, repeated three times to produce 30,000 answers over 14.68M comments. We find that differences across runs are driven primarily by retrieval, answers routinely combine evidence across communities, and selection strongly favors already-visible, top-level comments. Formal and directive language is more likely to be surfaced, while experiential voice is less likely to survive selection and is further weakened during synthesis, with first-person singular language declining sharply. These findings show that community-grounded generative search is not neutral summarization, and should be designed not only for relevance and fluency, but also for provenance, plurality, and legibility.

</details>


### [341] [Beyond Benchmark Scores: How Synthetic and Authentic Query Distributions Diverge in RAG Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14579)
*Filip J. Kucia,Barbara M. Gawlik*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 合成查询基准会高估RAG系统在真实查询下的表现，需将两者视为查询质量谱的两端互补使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG系统常用语料合成的合成问题集评估，但用户真实查询分布与合成分布存在系统差异，仅依赖合成基准会在分布漂移下误判部署就绪度。

Method: 在大学院系信息系统上，用Gemini Notebook生成1,851条合成问题，通过学生问卷收集322条真实查询，对比两类查询的词汇长度、来源覆盖，并比较各检索配置在两类查询上的性能与延迟。

Result: 真实查询平均6.8词、仅覆盖53个来源；合成查询平均15.7词、覆盖165个来源。合成基准上表现优异的配置在真实查询上性能大幅下降；合成查询优化选出的高延迟混合检索器（其稀疏组件对长合成问题有益却对短真实问题无益）延迟高达最快配置的8倍。

Conclusion: 应将合成与真实查询集视为查询质量谱的两端互补：合成数据验证理想条件下的最大检索能力，真实查询检验系统对真实用户不精确、欠指定输入的鲁棒性。

Abstract: RAG systems are routinely evaluated using synthetic question sets generated from the target document corpus. While this practice provides a useful check on overall retrieval capability, relying exclusively on synthetic benchmarks can mislead under distribution shift and overstate deployment readiness. Synthetic generation spreads questions evenly across the corpus, formulating long, detailed queries; real users put most of their traffic on a few administrative and procedural topics in short queries, while also asking about matters the generator never covers at all. We demonstrate this gap on a university faculty information system, comparing 1,851 synthetic questions generated via Gemini Notebook against 322 authentic queries collected via a student survey. The synthetic and authentic query sets differ significantly: authentic queries average 6.8 words versus 15.7 for the synthetic ones, and draw from only 53 unique sources compared to 165. Consequently, configurations that appear highly effective on synthetic benchmarks experience a substantial performance drop on authentic queries. Importantly, optimizing on synthetic queries selected a higher-latency hybrid retriever. In our setting the sparse retrieval component benefited long synthetic questions but not short authentic ones, costing up to $8\times$ the latency of the fastest configuration we tested. We propose treating synthetic and authentic query sets as complementary extremes of the query-quality spectrum: synthetic data verifies maximum retrieval capacity under idealized conditions, while authentic queries test system robustness to the imprecise, underspecified inputs of real users.

</details>


### [342] [EviQE: Evidence Selection for LLM-Based Query Expansion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14875)
*Hai Son Le,Amin Bigdeli,Shirin Seyedsalehi,Morteza Zihayat,Ebrahim Bagheri*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出EviQE框架，将证据选择与查询扩展生成分离，通过聚合多个改写器检索的文档并精选紧凑证据集，提升LLM查询扩展效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM查询扩展工作侧重如何生成扩展，而非模型应读取哪些文档。改写器各自检索到的相关文档常有差异，单一来源覆盖不足，需要更好的证据选择策略。

Method: EviQE聚合多个改写器检索的文档，从中选择紧凑的证据集，用于一次基于证据的扩展生成。将证据选择与生成分离，把不同改写器视为互补的检索视角，并采用基于相关性的证据选择（LLM-Score）。

Result: 在3个TREC DL和5个BEIR基准上，改写器常检索到不同相关文档，池化候选的相关文档覆盖率高于任何单一来源。基于相关性的LLM-Score选择稳定优于直接改写、冷启动扩展和单源种子扩展。一旦选定强证据，额外检索-生成轮次收益甚微，甚至降低效果。

Conclusion: 证据选择比生成更重要；聚合多改写器并精选证据能有效提升查询扩展，且额外迭代收益有限。

Abstract: LLM-based query expansion increasingly conditions reformulation on documents retrieved from the target corpus, yet most work focuses on how to generate expansions rather than which documents the model should read. We propose EviQE, which aggregates documents retrieved by multiple reformulators, selects a compact evidence set, and uses it for one grounded expansion step. This separates evidence selection from generation and treats reformulators as complementary retrieval perspectives. Across three TREC DL and five BEIR benchmarks, reformulators frequently retrieve distinct relevant documents, so pooled candidates provide higher relevant-document coverage than any individual source. The strongest gains come from relevance-based evidence selection: LLM-Score consistently outperforms direct reformulation, cold-start expansion, and single-source seeded expansion. Additional retrieval-generation rounds provide little benefit once strong conditioning evidence has been selected and can reduce effectiveness.

</details>


### [343] [Route Me If You Can: A Benchmark for Query Reformulation Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14885)
*Hai Son Le,Negar Arabzadeh,Amin Bigdeli,Radin Hamidi Rad,Sajad Ebrahimi,Charles L. A. Clarke,Ebrahim Bagheri*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文提出了QueryRoute基准，用于可复现地研究"给定原始查询和候选改写池，应选择哪一个发给检索器"的推理时决策问题，包含3,757个查询、11个候选系统、5个改写器骨干、3个检索器，共619,905个检索结果，并评估了多种选择器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的查询改写能提升检索效果，但没有单一改写策略在所有查询、领域、检索器或模型骨干上普遍最优，因此产生了"该选择哪个改写"的推理时决策问题。然而现有研究因使用不同的改写器池、检索器、相关性信号、训练标签和评估指标而难以比较。

Method: 构建QueryRoute基准，冻结研究该决策所需的昂贵中间产物：原始查询、生成的改写变体、多检索器下的排序列表、检索分数以及逐查询的oracle标签。基准覆盖TREC DL、BEIR、BRIGHT三个数据集，包含3,757个查询、11个候选系统、5个改写器骨干和3个检索器。并基准测试了监督分类、路由、QPP和LLM-as-judge等选择器。

Result: 相比固定改写器存在显著的oracle提升空间，但现有选择器仅能利用其中一部分；选择器的排名在不同检索器之间会发生变化，且相似的平均有效性可能掩盖查询级别的行为差异。

Conclusion: 发布的产物与评测框架使未来选择器无需重新生成变体、重跑检索或重建评判流程即可进行比较，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: LLM-based query reformulation can improve retrieval, but no single reformulation strategy is consistently optimal across queries, domains, retrievers, or model backbones. This creates an inference-time decision problem: ``Given an original query and a pool of candidate reformulations, which one should be issued to the retriever?''. Existing studies are hard to compare because they use different reformulator pools, retrievers, relevance signals, training labels, and evaluation metrics. We introduce QueryRoute, a benchmark that freezes the expensive artifacts needed to study this decision reproducibly: original queries, generated variants, ranked lists under multiple retrievers, retrieval scores, and per-query oracle labels. The benchmark contains 3,757 queries, 11 candidate systems, five reformulator backbones, and three retrievers across TREC DL, BEIR, and BRIGHT, yielding 619,905 retrieval outcomes. We benchmark supervised classification, routing, QPP, and LLM-as-judge selectors. Results show substantial oracle headroom over fixed reformulators, but current selectors recover only part of it; selector rankings change across retrievers, and similar mean effectiveness can hide different query-level behavior. The released artifacts and evaluation harness allow future selectors to be compared without regenerating variants, rerunning retrieval, or rebuilding judge pipelines. Code and data are available at https://github.com/haisonle001/QueryRoute

</details>


### [344] [LazFormer: Scaling Transformers for Industrial Recommendation via Transferable Generative Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14978)
*Xiaodong Li,Alin Fan,Mingyang Li,Yan Xiao,Shichao Nie,Junfeng Zhang,Shaochuan Lin,Zhanming Ou,Tao Luo,Xiaoyi Zeng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 LazFormer，一种通过可迁移生成式预训练实现的工业推荐扩展式 Transformer，解决稠密参数负迁移与稀疏参数过拟合两个问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业推荐中 Transformer 通常从零训练单一排序模型，同时优化稀疏和稠密参数，导致计算开销大、收敛慢。预训练模型虽能提供良好初始化，但仍存在两大局限：(1) 预训练与排序输入特征常不一致，直接迁移稠密参数会导致负迁移；(2) 排序阶段多轮训练会使稀疏参数过拟合，而冻结稀疏参数又限制了其对排序目标的适应性。

Method: LazFormer 包含：1) 生成式预训练模块，自回归生成序列特征，为后续排序提供稀疏与稠密参数的有利初始化；2) 可迁移残差适配器，以残差方式将额外排序特有特征注入排序，缓解稠密参数的负迁移；3) 请求感知排序模块，融合长序列压缩、混合稀疏注意力与请求感知范式，高效建模用户长序列；4) 非对称多轮训练策略，跨 epoch 重置稀疏参数并持续累积稠密参数，缓解稀疏参数过拟合。

Result: 暂未在摘要中给出具体量化结果（如指标提升数值或数据集）。

Conclusion: LazFormer 通过可迁移生成式预训练与多种针对性设计，为工业推荐场景下的 Transformer 扩展提供了兼顾初始化质量、负迁移抑制与稀疏参数过拟合缓解的综合方案。

Abstract: Transformers have shown promising performance in LLMs due to their outstanding scalability, several studies have investigated the scalability of Transformers for industrial recommendation. They typically rely on a single ranking model to optimize both sparse and dense parameters from scratch, resulting in substantial computational resource consumption and slow convergence. Fortunately, the pre-training models offer an effective solution to the above issues by providing favorable initialization of both sparse and dense parameters for the subsequent ranking. However, they still face two major limitations: (1) Since the input features used in pre-training and ranking are usually inconsistent, directly transferring dense parameters from pre-training to ranking may lead to negative transfer. (2) Multi-epoch training during the ranking process may result in the overfitting of sparse parameters, while freezing the sparse parameters limits their adaptability to the ranking objectives. To this end, we propose a Scaling Transformer for Industrial Recommendation via Transferable Generative Pre-training, termed LazFormer. Specifically, we first present a generative pre-training module to autoregressively generate sequential features, providing favorable initialization of both sparse and dense parameters for the subsequent ranking. To solve the negative transfer of dense parameters, we propose a transferable residual adapter that injects additional ranking-specific features into ranking in a residual manner. Moreover, a request-aware ranking module integrates long-sequence compression, hybrid sparse attention, and a request-aware paradigm to efficiently model users' long sequences. Besides, we further propose an asymmetric multi-epoch training strategy that resets sparse parameters while continuously accumulating dense parameters across epochs, alleviating the overfitting of sparse parameters.

</details>


### [345] [Generate to Explore, Select to Exploit: Aligning LLM-based Headline Generation with Personalized Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15094)
*Yi Chen,Rufeng Cheng,Qiang Xie,Tao Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: GESE框架在推荐展示层解耦个性化：用LLM生成候选标题集合（探索），再用轻量选择器实时挑选最优（利用），在亿级DAU平台上提升CTR 2.57%和停留时长0.87%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业推荐中静态标题难以满足用户多模态兴趣，尤其压制长尾受众；直接让LLM优化单一最佳标题会导致模式坍塌，偏向泛化且忽略特定潜在意图。

Method: GESE框架分两步：1）将LLM作为概率探索器，采用Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO)与分层奖励机制，生成最大化用户兴趣语义覆盖的候选集；2）用轻量、实时反馈感知的选择器作为利用者，基于即时上下文信号从候选池中选出最优标题。

Result: 在超1亿日活用户的商业平台部署，GESE显著优于SOTA基线，CTR提升2.57%，停留时长提升0.87%。

Conclusion: 将多样性导向的生成与精度导向的选择解耦，为生成式AI对齐动态用户效用提供了稳健蓝图。

Abstract: In industrial recommendation feeds, presenting a static headline for an item often fails to satisfy the diverse, multimodal interests of the user population, particularly suppressing the needs of long-tail audiences. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have been integrated into recommendation for content understanding or ranking, directly optimizing them to output a single best headline typically leads to mode collapse---converging to generic patterns that satisfy average tastes but miss specific latent intents. To bridge this gap, we introduce GESE (Generate to Explore, Select to Exploit), a framework operating at the system's presentation layer that decouples personalization into generative exploration and selective exploitation. First, we treat the LLM as a probabilistic explorer, utilizing Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) with a hierarchical reward mechanism to generate a candidate set that maximizes the semantic coverage of potential user interests. Subsequently, a lightweight, real-time feedback-aware selector acts as the exploiter, identifying the optimal realization from the candidate pool based on instant contextual signals. Extensive deployment on a commercial platform with over 100 million daily active users demonstrates that GESE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a 2.57% lift in CTR and 0.87% in dwell time. These results validate that decoupling diversity-oriented generation from precision-oriented selection offers a robust blueprint for aligning generative AI with dynamic user utility.

</details>


### [346] [Top-K Is Not a Budget for Hybrid Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15143)
*Chunran Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: DiBud以访问预算为输入，增量证书并返回RRF排序的精确前缀，在预算内提升认证输出并减少访问成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合检索中固定截断深度难以适应变化的查询和语料；精确融合虽不依赖固定深度，但完成指定Top-K仍产生可变访问成本。

Method: DiBud直接以访问预算为输入，对完整列表上的RRF排名增量地进行认证并返回精确前缀；采用选择性访问增加预算内的认证输出，并用预算化停止来限制每次请求的访问量。

Result: 在五个查询集上，完成精确Top-20的成本呈长尾分布。预算为2048次访问时，DiBud相比均衡访问在前100位内的平均认证输出提升7.86%。经95%质量保留的预算校准后，留出查询保留95.05%–97.68%的平均nDCG@20，同时访问量比完成精确Top-20减少65.92%–99.53%。

Conclusion: 以访问预算为核心的增量认证方法能在显著降低访问成本的同时保持高质量检索结果。

Abstract: Modern hybrid retrieval for RAG typically fuses the Top-$L$ results from dense and sparse retrievers, but a fixed truncation depth may not transfer across changing queries and corpora. Exact fusion removes the dependence on a fixed depth, yet completing a specified Top-$K$ still incurs variable access costs. We present DiBud, which takes an access budget directly as input and incrementally certifies and returns an exact prefix of the RRF ranking over the full lists. Selective access increases certified output within the budget, while budgeted stopping bounds accesses per request. Experiments on five query sets reveal long-tailed costs for completing exact Top-20. At a budget of 2048 accesses, DiBud increases mean certified output within the first 100 positions by 7.86% over balanced access. After budget calibration for 95% quality retention, held-out queries retain 95.05%--97.68% of mean nDCG@20 while using 65.92%--99.53% fewer accesses than completing exact Top-20.

</details>


### [347] [ProLiVis 2.0: Literature-Centric Visualization of Protein--Protein Interaction Networks, with a Citation-Trust Model for Interaction Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15236)
*Melih Sözdinler,Yalçın Doksanbir,Gökhan Akpınar,Ege Aktan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: ProLiVis 2.0 是一个文献中心的可视化系统重写版本。它引入引用信任模型，对每个互作从七项指标打分，并据此呈现交互网络。在 SARS-CoV-2 的 BioGRID 数据上，70% 的互作仅源自单篇文献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质互作数据库把不同证据证据强度压平：单次高通量筛选和二十个实验室反复验证的互作记录完全相同，基于此的工具把每个互作都画成边，无法表达可信程度。

Method: 本工作提出 ProLiVis 2.0，将互作按引用信任模型从七个方面打分，其中一项是支持文献背后的独立实验室数量（通过共享机构隶属关系对文献聚类获得，避免同一课题组多次发表被当作多次独立验证）。同时用确定性的闭式 O(n log n) 中心布局替代原有的力导向布局，使图形可从会话清单复现，并在浏览器内嵌分析数据库运行。

Result: 在 BioGRID 5.0.260 的 SARS-CoV-2 数据中，34,540 个互作里有 24,344 个（70%）仅依据单篇文献，将信任阈值提高到 0.2 后仍剩 11,320 个。

Conclusion: 大型整理过的互作网络中大部分互作未被独立重复，而现有数据库视图均无法揭示这一事实。

Abstract: Protein-protein interaction databases record evidence without weighing it. In BioGRID, an interaction asserted once by a single high-throughput screen and one confirmed by twenty laboratories across a dozen assays are the same kind of row in the same file. Tools built on such databases inherit that flattening: they draw every reported interaction as an edge, and the resulting picture states that two proteins interact without stating how much anyone should believe it.
  We present ProLiVis 2.0, a rewrite of the literature-centric visualization system of arXiv:2111.12794. It contributes three things. First, a citation-trust model that scores each interaction from seven terms, including a term for the number of independent laboratories behind the supporting publications, obtained by clustering those publications over shared institutional affiliations; a plain count of publications cannot distinguish five confirmations from one group publishing five times. Second, a deterministic reformulation of the center layout, closed-form and $O(n \log n)$, which replaces the force-directed placement of the original and makes published figures regenerable from a session manifest. Third, an implementation that runs entirely in a web browser, with an embedded analytical database, requiring no installation and uploading no data.
  On BioGRID release 5.0.260 restricted to SARS-CoV-2, 24,344 of 34,540 reported interactions (70%) rest on a single publication, and raising the trust threshold to 0.2 leaves 11,320 of them. That the large majority of a curated interaction network is unreplicated is a fact no existing view of the database makes visible.

</details>


### [348] [Clean Scores, Buried Evidence, and Confident Wrong: A Receipt-Based Audit of Frontier Agentic QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15319)
*Luis M. Sánchez*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 前沿模型在浅层文档阅读任务上表现良好，但在受控审计中，将证据"埋藏"后准确率下降、被迫声明增多、工具调用和每次正确回答成本上升，且置信度与基准校准未能捕捉错误。论文主张智能体评估应转向声明级溯源、条件感知评分和对抗性人工验证的审计范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准主要衡量浅层文档/图表阅读，模型得分高，可能掩盖其在证据被埋藏时的真实可靠性问题。作者关注现实场景（金融尽职调查、国防参谋工作）中模型可能将准确数字与自信的编造解释混杂，而签名承担责任的是人而非模型，因此需要更严格的评估与举证机制。

Method: 采用受控数据室审计（controlled data-room audit），将证据置于"埋藏"条件下，测量准确率、被迫声明、工具调用次数及每次正确回答成本的变化，并考察置信度与基准校准表现；同时分析已记录的生产事故案例。

Result: 证据埋藏降低准确率，增加被迫声明、工具调用与单次正确回答成本；置信度与基准校准无法完全反映错误回答。生产事故显示模型可将编造的结构性声明与准确的数据表格混在一起。

Conclusion: 智能体评估需要声明级溯源（statement-level provenance）、条件感知评分和人类对抗性验证，应作为审计纪律而非排行榜；举证责任应从模型转向证据链。该设定先用于金融尽职调查，下一步是国防参谋工作。

Abstract: Frontier models score well on shallow document/chart reading tasks. In a controlled data-room audit, moving evidence into buried conditions reduced accuracy, increased forced declarations, increased tool calls, and increased cost per correct answer. Confidence and benchmark calibration did not fully capture wrong answers; a documented production incident shows fabricated structural claims can be mixed with accurate numeric tables. Agentic evaluations need claim-level receipts (statement-level provenance, not answer-level scores), condition-aware scoring, and human-adversarial verification - an auditing discipline, not a leaderboard. The setting we measure is financial due diligence; the setting we are building toward next is defense staff work, where the same buried-evidence shape appears. In both, the model is not a party to the consequences; the person who signs is. In plain terms: in the documented cases we examine, agents can pair accurate numbers with confident fabricated explanations, and the burden of proof must therefore move from the model to the evidence trail.

</details>


### [349] [Benchmarking Embedding Models for ESG Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15434)
*Motaz Saad,Veronica Cretì,Ivan Gentile,Kianna Kazemi,Antonella Longo*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文构建ESG领域基准数据集，评测14个开源与闭源嵌入模型在检索与RAG任务上的表现，发现Qwen3系列模型整体最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ESG数据对现代企业问责、可持续报告和金融决策至关重要，嵌入模型虽被广泛用于将非结构化ESG文本转为向量表示，但其在ESG特定任务中的有效性尚未被系统研究。

Method: 构建专门面向ESG领域的基准数据集，并基准测试14个开源与闭源嵌入模型，比较其在检索和检索增强生成（RAG）任务上的性能。

Result: 不同模型间性能存在差异，Qwen3系列模型取得最高的整体性能。

Conclusion: 该研究为ESG RAG任务中嵌入模型的选择提供了实用见解。

Abstract: The use of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) data is fundamental for modern corporate accountability, sustainability reporting, and financial decision-making. Embedding models have emerged as a powerful approach for transforming unstructured ESG text into numerical representations suitable for downstream natural language processing (NLP) tasks. However, their effectiveness in these ESG-specific tasks has not been systematically studied. In this paper, we construct a benchmark dataset specifically tailored to the ESG domain. We benchmark fourteen models, both open-source and closed-source embedding models, comparing their performance with respect to retrieval, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The results demonstrate performance variations across different models, with Qwen3-based models achieving the highest overall performance. This study provides practical insights into which models are better suited for ESG RAG tasks.

</details>


### [350] [Beyond Retrieval: Scaffolding Children's Online Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15568)
*Diletta Micol Tobia,Hrishita Chakrabarti,Maria Soledad Pera,Monica Landoni*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 儿童使用主要为成人设计的信息检索系统，但缺乏理解，导致搜索效果不佳。本文基于儿童信息检索与人机交互文献，将儿童视为搜索过程的主动参与者，把搜索重构为"支架式学习体验"而非简单检索任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童越来越多使用面向主流成人群体设计的在线信息检索系统，却对其运作机制理解有限，造成搜索行为缺乏结构且低效。这一知识缺口会抑制儿童的好奇心，并阻碍其关键搜索技能的发展。

Method: 为工作定位/立场类研究（position paper），未提出具体实验方法。研究立足儿童信息检索（Child-oriented IR）与人机交互（HCI）两方面既有文献，将儿童定位为搜索过程的主动参与者。

Result: 摘要为立场性论述，未报告具体实验结果。其核心主张是：应将儿童搜索重新概念化为一种"支架式学习体验"（scaffolded learning experience），而非单纯的检索任务。

Conclusion: 通过整合儿童IR与HCI文献，本文倡导以学习为框架来设计儿童搜索系统，强调支持性支架对培养儿童批判性搜索能力与好奇心的价值。

Abstract: Children increasingly turn to online information access systems that are primarily designed for the mainstream population, e.g., adults, but possess a limited understanding of how these systems work, contributing to their unstructured and ineffective search practices. This lack of knowledge can hinder their curiosity and the development of critical search skills. Grounded on the existing literature of both child-oriented Information Retrieval and Human Computer Interaction, our work positions children as active participants in the search process, framing it as a scaffolded learning experience rather than a simple retrieval task.

</details>


### [351] [The Magnitude Mirage: Rethinking Confidence for Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15578)
*Jamie Holdcroft,Abdelrahman Abdallah,Adam Jatowt*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文揭示RAG检索弃答中基于相似度分数大小设阈值的"Magnitude Mirage"缺陷，并提出零成本、基于分数分布信号（如Score Gap、LSMV）的替代方案，在逻辑与时间推理任务上显著提升弃答性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产级RAG系统常用原始相似度分数阈值做检索弃答，隐含假设分数大小=置信度。但该假设在需要超越语义匹配的推理型查询下系统性失效：神经检索器会给语义相关却违反约束的文档打高分，导致基于大小的阈值在逻辑和时间推理任务上退化为近乎随机的弃答。

Method: 在11种检索架构、28个数据集上系统验证该失效现象；随后大规模实证评估6种零成本Query Performance Prediction（QPP）指标，覆盖三个认知层级：语义匹配（BEIR）、逻辑推理（BRIGHT）、时间推理（TEMPO）。核心思路是用分数分布信号替代分数大小，重点考察Score Gap（s1−sk）及Score Magnitude and Variance（LSMV）的实用改编。

Result: 放弃分数大小、改用分数分布信号带来的增益，比不同分布替代方案之间的差异高5–10倍。Score Gap与LSMV在基于大小的置信度几乎无判别力的场景中，将弃答AUROC最高提升0.16。

Conclusion: 基于分数分布的零成本QPP指标（Score Gap、LSMV）可有效替代部署RAG系统中的大小阈值，无需额外推理、重训练或延迟，是实用且低成本的弃答方案。

Abstract: Many production RAG systems implement retrieval abstention by thresholding raw similarity scores, implicitly treating score magnitude as a confidence signal. We demonstrate that this practice degrades systematically as queries require reasoning beyond semantic matching. Across 11 retrieval architectures and 28 datasets, neural retrievers consistently assign high similarity scores to semantically related but constraint-violating documents, causing magnitude-based thresholds to collapse toward near-random abstention performance on logical and temporal reasoning tasks---a failure we term the Magnitude Mirage. To address this without computationally expensive alternatives, we conduct a large-scale empirical study of six zero-cost Query Performance Prediction (QPP) metrics across three cognitive tiers: semantic matching (BEIR), logical reasoning (BRIGHT), and temporal reasoning (TEMPO). Our central finding is that the key improvement comes from abandoning magnitude in favor of score-distribution signals: the gain from this shift exceeds the differences among distributional alternatives by a factor of 5-10$\times$. In particular, Score Gap ($s_1 - s_k$) and a practical adaptation of Score Magnitude and Variance (LSMV) improve abstention AUROC by up to 0.16 in settings where magnitude-based confidence provides little discriminative power. These methods require no additional inference, retraining, or latency, making them a practical zero-cost replacement for magnitude thresholding in deployed RAG systems.

</details>


### [352] [Self-Evolving Memory for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15598)
*Xinyu Lin,Zhuosong Jiang,Zixiao Suo,Siqin Wang,Hanqing Zeng,Hanchao Yu,Yinglong Xia,Jiang Zhang,Aashu Singh,Fei Liu,Wenjie Wang,Fuli Feng,Yang Song,Qifan Wang,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文研究生成式推荐中的自演化问题，指出直接更新共享参数会导致"演化冲突"，并提出基于稀疏键值记忆层的方法LION。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户偏好随时间持续演化，生成式推荐系统需要自演化能力；但现有持续训练/蒸馏等方法在完全共享的自回归参数空间中优化异构偏好偏移，使主导行为模式压制弱势模式，产生演化冲突。

Method: 提出自演化记忆范式，确立隔离记忆、强化演化、可扩展应用三原则；开发LION框架，核心为稀疏Key-Value记忆层，通过稀疏记忆激活隔离不同行为模式的演化，并设计巩固损失（consolidation loss）强化对弱势偏好动态的学习。

Result: 在多个真实数据集上，于按周期评估、用户/物品分组评估及演化收敛分析等多种持续演化设置下验证了LION的有效性。

Conclusion: 自演化记忆范式通过隔离与强化机制缓解演化冲突，为异构行为模式下的生成式推荐自演化提供了简单有效的解决思路。

Abstract: Generative recommendation has emerged as a promising end-to-end paradigm for personalized recommendation. However, user preferences continuously evolve over time, making self-evolving an essential capability for generative recommender systems. Existing evolving strategies, such as continual retraining and distillation-based adaptation, directly update the shared model parameters using streaming interactions. Nevertheless, we find that directly applying such strategies to generative recommendation introduces a critical issue, termed evolution conflict. Specifically, heterogeneous preference shifts from different users are optimized within a fully shared autoregressive parameter space, causing dominant behavioral patterns to progressively dominate the model evolution process while underrepresented patterns become increasingly overlooked. To address this issue, we propose a self-evolving memory paradigm for generative recommendation, aiming to enable effective evolution across heterogeneous behavioral patterns. We further identify three key principles for effective self-evolving recommendation systems, including isolated memorization, reinforced evolution, and scalable application. Guided by these principles, we develop LION, a simple yet effective framework centered on a sparse Key-Value memory layer. Specifically, LION introduces sparse memory activation to isolate the evolution of different behavioral patterns, while a consolidation loss is designed to reinforce the learning of underrepresented preference dynamics during continual adaptation. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of LION under various continual evolution settings (e.g., per-period evaluation, user/item group evaluation, and evolution convergence analysis). The codes are released at https://github.com/JazyJiang/Self-Evolving-Memory-for-Generative-Recommendation.

</details>


### [353] [IROH: Insightful Ranking Of Humor using Multi-Stage Hybrid Retrieval with Rationale-Distilled LLM Judges for JOKER 2026 Track Task 1 English](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15618)
*Ana-Maria Luisa Mocanu,Sebastian Mocanu,Ciprian-Octavian Truică,Elena-Simona Apostol*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: VANGUARD 团队提出三阶段检索系统 IROH，用于 CLEF 2026 JOKER Task 1 英语赛道，以 0.6347 MAP 获第一名，结合稀疏-稠密混合检索、交叉编码器重排与 LoRA 适配的大模型评判集成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向 JOKER Task 1 英语幽默检索任务，探索如何构建高效的三阶段检索管线，并系统性检验理由蒸馏、结构化硬负样本、模型规模等设计选择对排序质量的实际贡献。

Method: 管线包含三部分：混合稀疏-稠密检索、交叉编码器重排、LoRA 适配的大语言模型评判集成。用 Gemma 4 在通用（generic）与类型化（typed）两种提示策略下生成查询感知理由，并构造最多四种结构化硬负样本用于训练。消融覆盖三种交叉编码器架构、四种稠密嵌入器和八种评判配置。

Result: 系统取得 0.6347 MAP，排名第一。三项关键发现：（1）理由蒸馏的评判模型是排序质量的主要驱动，而将理由加入一阶段索引几乎无贡献；（2）结构化硬负样本在几乎所有配置下损害泛化，尽管会抬高本地验证分数；（3）更轻、标定更好的模型可与更大模型抗衡甚至更强——通用理由的 Qwen2.5-7B 评判（0.6055 MAP）胜过所有 Gemma-4-31B 配置，且通用理由相对类型化理由的优势几乎完全集中在小模型上。

Conclusion: 理由蒸馏的 LLM 评判是性能核心，硬负样本需谨慎使用；模型规模并非越大越好，标定良好且更轻的模型在幽默检索任务中更具性价比。

Abstract: Our team, VANGUARD, presents IROH (Insightful Ranking of Humor), a three-stage retrieval system for JOKER Task 1 English at CLEF 2026, achieving first place on the leaderboard with 0.6347 MAP. Our pipeline combines hybrid sparse-dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and a LoRA-adapted Large Language Model judge ensemble. We employ Gemma 4 to generate query-aware rationales under two prompt strategies, generic and typed, and produce up to four types of structured hard negatives for training data construction. Through an ablation across three cross-encoder architectures, four dense embedders, and eight judge configurations, our key findings are threefold: (1) the rationale-distilled judge is the primary driver of ranking quality, whereas appending rationales to the first-stage index contributes negligibly; (2) structured hard negatives degrade generalisation in nearly all configurations despite inflating local validation scores; and (3) across the components we ablate, the lighter, better-calibrated model is competitive with or stronger than its larger counterpart, with the generic-rationale Qwen2.5-7B judge (0.6055 MAP) outperforming every Gemma-4-31B configuration, and the advantage of generic over typed rationales is concentrated almost entirely in the smaller model.

</details>

### [354] [nBMS, a Neuromorphic Battery Management System with a Silicon-Validated Spiking State-of-Charge Core for eVTOL Aircraft](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13506)
*İsmail Can Dikmen*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文设计了一个事件驱动脉冲神经网络作为nBMS神经形态电池管理架构的状态估计核心，用于eVTOL的SoC估计，在低成本FPGA上实现并验证了低功耗、无需MAC运算的高效部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: eVTOL的SoC估计需在严格的能量与认证预算下运行，且其工作循环与汽车文献截然不同，现有方法难以直接适用，因此需要一种适配该场景的高能效估计方案。

Method: 采用事件驱动脉冲网络：delta与群体编码器、二阶sigma-delta脉冲层及速率累加读出，仅含34,433个int16参数，零稠密MAC操作。在公开22电芯eVTOL数据集上做逐步SoC估计，并以汽车场景交叉验证。

Result: RMSE为2.45%，相比调优LSTM基线的1.74%存在巡航期时间混合限制的差距；但在传感器噪声下退化速度比自适应LIF控制慢1.6倍，每步约需3,500次加法，而LSTM需67,700次乘加。核心部署于Artix-7 FPGA，87% BRAM利用率，50MHz满足时序，在真实491步飞行段上比特级复现定点参考。后实现分析显示每次推断1.30μJ，0.5Hz任务节奏下平均0.65μW。

Conclusion: 该神经形态估计器以略高的RMSE换取显著的能效与鲁棒性优势，并在汽车级FPGA上完成零MAC、比特级精确的硬件部署，验证了其作为eVTOL电池管理状态估计核心的可行性。

Abstract: State-of-charge (SoC) estimation for electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft must run on the vehicle under hard energy and certification budgets, on a duty cycle unlike anything in the automotive literature. In this study an event-driven spiking network, the state-estimation core of the nBMS neuromorphic battery management architecture, is designed for per-timestep SoC estimation and evaluated on a public 22-cell eVTOL dataset with an automotive cross-check. A delta and population encoder, a second-order sigma-delta spiking layer, and a rate-accumulator readout hold 34{,}433 int16 parameters with zero dense multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations. The estimator reaches 2.45\% root-mean-square error (RMSE) against 1.74\% for a tuned long short-term memory (LSTM) baseline, a gap characterized as a temporal-mixing limit in cruise; in exchange it degrades 1.6 times slower than an adaptive leaky integrate-and-fire control under sensor noise and needs roughly 3{,}500 additions per step where the LSTM needs 67{,}700 multiply-accumulates. The full core is deployed on a low-cost automotive-qualified Artix-7 field-programmable gate array at 87\% block-RAM utilization, meets timing at 50~MHz, and reproduces the frozen fixed-point reference bit-exactly over a real 491-step flight segment on silicon. Fully annotated post-implementation analysis gives 1.30~$μ$J per inference, an average of 0.65~$μ$W at the 0.5~Hz mission cadence.

</details>


### [355] [Early-Stopping Thresholds for ES-HyperNEAT: A Data-Driven Approach from Fitness Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13533)
*Romain Claret,Arthur Gygax,Michael O'Neill,Paul Cotofrei,Pascal Felber*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 将ES-HyperNEAT的早停建模为基于早期适应度轨迹的二分类问题，用一条简单规则（G*=3, T*=0.140）大幅节省算力且保留多数成功试验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ES-HyperNEAT多数超参数配置会导致网络停滞在随机猜测水平，浪费计算资源，亟需高效的早停机制。

Method: 对每个试验计算每代最优适应度的累积中位数，将其作为特征，与由初始90次试验上最大化F1得到的阈值比较，从而在早期（第3代）判定是否停止。

Result: 规则G*=3、T*=0.140在180次独立验证试验上F1=0.872，保留超90%成功试验并减少41.6%计算成本；相比Hyperband效率高64%且平均适应度更高，但Hyperband偶能发现更高峰值解。在已收敛的搜索种群上规则过于激进（召回率31.1%）。

Conclusion: 具体阈值特定于ES-HyperNEAT，但“从适应度动态分类中导出停止准则”的方法可推广到其他易停滞的进化算法；未来需引入自适应阈值。

Abstract: Most hyperparameter configurations for Evolvable-Substrate HyperNEAT (ES-HyperNEAT) produce networks that stagnate at random-guessing performance, wasting computational resources. We frame early stopping as binary classification on early fitness trajectories: for each trial, we compute the cumulative median of best-per-generation fitness and test it against a threshold derived by maximizing the F1 score on an initial 90-trial dataset. The resulting rule (generation G* = 3, threshold T* = 0.140) achieves F1 = 0.872 on 180 independent validation trials, retaining over 90% of successful trials while cutting computational cost by 41.6%. Compared to Hyperband, our domain-specific rule is 64% more efficient with higher mean fitness, though Hyperband occasionally discovers higher peak solutions. On a converged search population the rule becomes too aggressive (recall 31.1%), motivating adaptive thresholds. The specific thresholds are ES-HyperNEAT-specific, but the methodology, deriving stopping criteria from fitness dynamics classification, is applicable to other evolutionary algorithms with stagnation-prone hyperparameter spaces.

</details>


### [356] [Surrogate-Assisted Genetic Programming with Phenotypic Characterisation in Dynamic Multi-Mode Project Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14418)
*Yuan Tian,Yi Mei,Mengjie Zhang*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该论文研究在动态多模式资源受限项目调度中，如何通过表型特征（PC）编码来提升代理辅助遗传规划（GP）演化调度启发式规则的质量，发现二进制编码+欧氏距离效果最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态多模式资源受限项目调度需在前驱约束、有限资源、多执行模式和不确定工期下决策。GP可自动演化启发式规则，但基于仿真的适应度评估计算代价高昂，因此需借助代理模型降低评估成本。核心问题是：GP个体应如何编码为表型特征以有效支持适应度估计。

Method: 设计了三种信息丰富度不同的PC编码方案：保留规则原始输出的优先级值编码、捕捉候选排序的排序编码、表示最终调度决策的二进制编码。将这些编码与不同距离度量结合，以衡量GP个体间的行为相似性，并在固定仿真评估预算下进行实验。
