TL;DR: 提出GeoSkill经验驱动分层技能学习框架，通过分层技能库与协作式修订机制，将历史执行经验转化为可复用地理空间技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地理空间智能体需支持反复演进的分析任务，但现有记忆增强范式难以同时总结长程工具链编排经验与工具级调用约束，且直接依赖LLM自省更新经验易导致错误归因和不可靠修订。

Method: GeoSkill包含两部分：(i)分层技能库HSB，由规划技能库和工具技能库构成，分别蒸馏高层任务规划经验与工具使用约束，实现经验的结构化表示与跨任务复用；(ii)协作式轨迹驱动技能修订CTSR机制，由Judge、Critic和Refiner协作完成错误识别、技能级缺陷定位和针对性修改。开发阶段从历史执行中学习并验证技能，部署阶段冻结技能库，仅做检索式引导。

Result: 在EarthBench和ThinkGeo上的大量实验表明，GeoSkill能有效将历史执行经验转化为可复用分层技能，提升端到端任务准确率与工具执行可靠性。

Conclusion: GeoSkill通过分层技能库与协作修订机制，有效解决了经验总结与修订可靠性问题，为地理空间智能体的经验复用提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Geospatial agents are increasingly expected to support recurring and evolving analytical tasks rather than execute isolated workflows. In such settings, effective agents must distill prior execution experience into reusable geospatial procedural knowledge to guide future planning and tool use. However, existing memory-augmented paradigms struggle to summarize both long-horizon tool-chain orchestration experience and tool-level invocation constraints in geospatial analysis, while directly relying on LLM self-reflection to update experience often leads to misattribution and unreliable revisions. To address these challenges, we propose GeoSkill, an experience-driven hierarchical skill learning framework for geospatial agents. GeoSkill comprises two core components: (i) a Hierarchical Skill Bank (HSB), consisting of a Planning Skill Bank and a Tool Skill Bank, which respectively distill high-level task-planning experience and tool usage constraints, enabling structured representation and cross-task reuse of historical execution experience; and (ii) a Collaborative Trace-driven Skill Revision (CTSR) mechanism, where Judge, Critic, and Refiner collaboratively perform error identification, skill-level defect localization, and targeted modification, preventing misattributed and unreliable revisions from polluting the skill bank. GeoSkill learns and validates skills from historical executions during development, and freezes the skill bank for retrieval-only guidance on unseen tasks during deployment. Extensive experiments on EarthBench and ThinkGeo demonstrate that GeoSkill effectively transforms historical execution experience into reusable hierarchical skills, improving both end-to-end task accuracy and tool-execution reliability in geospatial tasks.

</details>


### [393] [Question's Gambit: The First Move Matters in Agentic Deep Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14412)
*Radin Hamidi Rad,Amin Bigdeli,Negar Arabzadeh,Sajad Ebrahimi,Charles L. A. Clarke,Benjamin C. M. Fung,Ebrahim Bagheri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Question's Gambit，一个"首步检索"模块：将问题分解为线索、改写为互补搜索、合并结果并重排，为深度研究智能体构建高质量初始上下文；在 BrowseComp-Plus 上把答案准确率从 83.1% 提升到 90.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度研究智能体通过"搜索—阅读—推理"迭代回答复杂问题。已有工作（如 BrowseComp-Plus）表明配置良好的词法检索能提供高质量证据，但智能体仍可能无法把含有证据的文档与金标文档连接起来。作者认为智能体的"第一次检索动作"是被忽视但关键的设计决策，它决定了后续迭代的起点质量。

Method: 提出 Question's Gambit 首步检索模块，运行于智能体迭代循环之前：(1) 将问题分解为一组线索（clues）；(2) 改写为互补的多路搜索查询；(3) 合并检索结果；(4) 对候选池进行重排。由此生成一个"开局上下文"，既支持线索聚合，也支持最终答案验证。

Result: 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，Question's Gambit 相比强基线提升了检索召回率和下游智能体准确率：使用 gpt-5.5 时答案准确率从最强智能体基线 Pi-Serini 的 83.1% 提升至 90.5%。同时在 MultiHop-RAG 上评估，以检验收益是否能迁移到更常规的多跳问题结构。

Conclusion: 有效的智能体式深度研究不仅取决于循环内可用的工具，也取决于"首步"的质量。实现已开源：https://github.com/radinhamidi/Question-s-Gambit。

Abstract: Deep research agents answer complex questions through iterative loops of searching, reading, and reasoning. Recent work on reasoning-intensive benchmarks such as BrowseComp-Plus shows that well-configured lexical retrieval can surface high-quality evidence, yet agents may still fail to connect documents carrying evidence to the gold documents. We identify a deep research agent's first retrieval move as an important design decision for this setting. We introduce Question's Gambit, a first-move retrieval module that decomposes the question into a set of clues, reformulates them into complementary searches, consolidates the retrieved results, and reranks the candidate pool before the agent begins its iterative search-and-reasoning process. This produces an opening context designed to support both clue aggregation and final-answer verification. We further evaluate on MultiHop-RAG to test whether these benefits transfer beyond BrowseComp-Plus to a more conventional multi-hop question structure. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus show that Question's Gambit improves retrieval recall and downstream agent accuracy over strong baselines, improving answer accuracy from 83.1% to 90.5% with gpt-5.5 over Pi-Serini, the strongest reported agentic baseline. Our results confirm that effective agentic deep research depends not only on the tools available inside the loop, but also on the quality of the first move. We published our implementation publicly at https://github.com/radinhamidi/Question-s-Gambit.

</details>


### [394] [Enhancing Event Candidate Acquisition for Event Linking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13670)
*Ziyang Zhang,Yinan Liu,Boyi Xue,Yingxuan Huang,Bin Wang,Xiaochun Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MACE: 多智能体候选事件获取方法，通过精炼事件结构提升事件链接准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事件链接方法在候选事件获取上受短歧义提及、噪声论元和证据利用不均等问题削弱。

Method: 使用证据专用LLM智能体分别获取时间、地点、参与者和事件类型证据，公开中间查询给候选事件查找工具，由协调者修订证据集后再构建候选。

Result: 在两个事件链接基准上，将MACE加入不同事件链接模型均能持续提升准确率。

Conclusion: MACE通过改进候选事件获取提升事件链接效果，且无需修改事件链接模型。

Abstract: Event linking associates event mentions in text with entries in a knowledge base (KB), or identifies them as out-of-KB events. Although existing methods use different architectures, candidate event acquisition can still be weakened by short ambiguous mentions, noisy arguments, and evidence that is unevenly useful for retrieval. We present MACE, a Multi-Agent Candidate Event acquisition method that refines event structure before linking. MACE uses evidence-specialized LLM agents to acquire time, location, participant, and event-type evidence, exposes intermediate queries to candidate-event lookup tools, and lets a coordinator revise the evidence set before final candidate construction. Experiments on two event linking benchmarks show that adding MACE to different event linking models consistently improves accuracy. These results show that MACE improves event linking through better candidate event acquisition without modifying the event linking model.

</details>


### [395] [Converting Sequenced Fuzzy Cognitive Maps to Causal Virtual Worlds with Large Video Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14985)
*Akash Kumar Panda,Olaoluwa Adigun,Bart Kosko*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出用反馈模糊认知图(FCM)建模虚拟世界的因果结构，结合LLM与视频生成模型(Agent)实现因果虚拟世界的创建与操控，并以海豚-鲨鱼海底世界为例，用Gemini 3.1写脚本、Veo 3.1生成视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 让用户能够创建并操控具有因果结构的虚拟世界，需要既能刻画细粒度局部因果规则，又能生成全局演化场景的方法，传统手段难以兼顾局部模糊性与全局因果平衡。

Method: 采用反馈模糊认知图(FCM)建模虚拟世界的细粒度因果结构并引导其因果演化；局部因果规则为部分或模糊的，FCM的反馈结构产生定义因果场景的全局平衡态。用形如“如果A则B”的动态元规则定义因果场景：A扰动FCM虚拟世界，FCM瞬态反馈动力学界定蕴含的因果箭头，B为平衡吸引子(极限环或不动点)。算法从FCM提取元规则，引导LLM Agent据此编写脚本，再由大视频生成模型按动力学流把元规则转为视频场景。

Result: 将Agent方法应用于描述海豚与鲨鱼海底世界的简单FCM，Google Gemini 3.1生成脚本，Google Veo 3.1生成海豚-鲨鱼视频。

Conclusion: 该方法具有通用性，可通过混合更大规模的FCM与AI Agent进行扩展，生成更具沉浸感的虚拟世界。

Abstract: We show how users can create and manipulate causal virtual worlds with large-language-model (LLM) and large-video-model agents. The approach uses feedback fuzzy cognitive maps (FCMs) both to model the granular causal structure of the virtual world and to guide its causal evolution. The local causal rules are partial or fuzzy while the FCM's feedback structure produces global equilibria that define causal scenarios. A sequence of \emph{dynamical} meta-rules of the form ``If $\mathcal{A}$ then $\mathcal{B}$" define the causal scenes of the virtual-world video. The if-part causal pattern $\mathcal{A}$ perturbs the FCM's virtual world at the user's or agent's discretion. The FCM's transient feedback dynamics define the meta-rule's causal arrow of implication. The then-part $\mathcal{B}$ is the resulting equilibrium attractor such as a FCM limit cycle or fixed point. Our algorithm extracts these meta-rules from the FCM and guides the LLM agent to write a script based on the FCM meta-rule sequence. The large video generator converts the meta-rule into a video scene in accord with the flow of the dynamics. We applied the agent-based technique to a simple FCM that describes an undersea world of dolphins and sharks. Google's Gemini 3.1 generated the script and Google's Veo 3.1 generated the dolphin-shark video. The approach is general and can scale by mixing larger FCMs and AI agents to produce more immersive virtual worlds.

</details>


### [396] [Recoverability as a System Primitive for Long-Horizon AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13672)
*Zhihui Zhang,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"可恢复性(recoverability)"作为系统原语,将恢复点的复用变为显式决策:选择受支持的起点与允许的恢复动作,或拒绝自动继续,并通过行为契约绑定证据、执行与独立校验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体在编辑文件、调用工具或多步任务中会被中断。完全重启会重复已完成工作,而从"未验证或过时"的进度继续则会把早期错误带入后续。已保存的状态未必是合适的恢复点。

Method: 将recoverability形式化为系统原语,明确"起点选择"与"允许动作"的决策,附带行为契约(证据、执行、独立检查三者绑定)。设计参考架构连接持久化、校验与控制,并用四类确定性挑战与20组配对文件挑战进行评测;另有进度控制与事件时间测试。

Result: 实验显示:准确的恢复与任务成功完成可能掩盖"不允许的起点"——即最终结果正确但复用了不该复用的进度。进度控制可将保留的工作归因于共享恢复;事件时间测试表明权限还须约束动作,且独立持有的策略证据能在效应发生之后暴露违规。

Conclusion: 恢复决策需要独立评估,不能仅凭"恢复的字节"与最终任务成功来判断。在给定策略与声明的信任模型内,该工作提供了一个通用、可测试的接口,用于保留有正当理由的进度,并使复用的条件显式且可强制执行。

Abstract: AI agents can be interrupted while editing files, calling tools, or carrying out multi-step tasks. Restarting repeats completed work, but continuing from unverified or outdated progress can carry earlier errors forward. A saved state is not necessarily a suitable place to resume. We introduce recoverability as a system primitive that makes reuse an explicit decision: select a supported starting point and a permitted recovery action, or withhold automatic continuation. Its behavioral contract binds that choice to supporting evidence, execution, and independent checks. A reference architecture connects persistence, validation, and control, with complementary runtime instances testing distinct responsibilities. Four deterministic and 20 paired file challenges demonstrate that accurate restoration and successful completion can conceal disallowed starting points. Progress controls attribute retained work to shared restoration. Event-time tests show that permission must also constrain the action, and that independently held policy evidence can expose violations even after an effect occurs. These findings establish why recovery decisions need their own evaluation, beyond restored bytes and final task success. Within supplied policies and a declared trust model, the contribution is a common, testable interface for retaining justified progress and making the conditions for its reuse explicit and enforceable.

</details>


### [397] [Windowed A-K-MDP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13676)
*Xiangwen Yang,Frankie Cho,Iadine Chades*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对K-MDP中A-K-MDP因二分搜索选择离散化除数而可能跳过更优抽象状态的问题，提出Windowed A-K-MDP算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MDP用于生物多样性保护决策，但即使状态空间很小，策略对保护管理者也难解释。K-MDP通过至多K个抽象状态构建更简单的MDP来缓解此问题，但已有A-K-MDP用二分搜索选除数，可能跳过更好的抽象状态。

Method: 提出Windowed A-K-MDP：在指定的除数窗口内生成所有不同的可行划分，逐一评估候选，直到达到理想损失值（J=0）或耗尽候选族。

Result: 在33个K-MDP实例中，Windowed在25个实例上优于原方法，8个持平。

Conclusion: 通过窗口内穷举可行划分替代二分搜索，可避免跳过更优抽象状态，显著提升K-MDP求解质量。

Abstract: Markov decision processes (MDPs) are used to support decision-making in conservation of biodiversity, but policies, even over small state spaces, can be difficult to interpret for conservation managers. K-MDP methods address this problem by building simpler MDPs with at most K abstract states. We show that the previously proposed A-K-MDP algorithm that relies on selecting a discretisation divisor using binary search can skip better abstract states. To fix this issue, we propose Windowed A-K-MDP, an algorithm that generates every distinct feasible partition induced within a declared divisor window and evaluates candidates until reaching the ideal value loss (J = 0) or exhausting the family of candidates. Across 33 K-MDP instances, Windowed improved 25 and tied 8.

</details>


### [398] [Drift-Constrained Optimization: Only Direction Matters in Fine-Tuning Instruct Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13680)
*Fei Yuan,Changjiang Gao,Yilei Tu,Yifeng Liu,Shujian Huang,Yu Qiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文将微调重新表述为"方向选择"问题：在预设的行为漂移预算内，选取更新方向以提升目标任务性能，并通过层选择性探针找到有效方向，在QA-only设置下兼顾推理与通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调指令模型常导致行为漂移、损害既有能力。作者不再把漂移视为优化的失控副作用，而是预先设定漂移预算，并探索在此约束下如何最大化目标任务性能。

Method: 在参考模型处，行为漂移引出共享几何空间，漂移预算构成边界；漂移决定与参考的距离，更新方向成为唯一自由度，从而将微调转化为方向选择问题。作者据此预测改变可及方向会质变微调结果，并用粗粒度层选择性探针在仅用最终答案微调的QA场景中验证。

Result: 在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-14B上，QA-only微调的失败被逆转；多个相邻配置在提升目标性能的同时保留推理与通用能力，显著改善科学推理与多语言翻译，在100多种语言上匹配或超越专用翻译系统，并为后续强化学习提供更好初始化。

Conclusion: 微调的关键不只是模型改变多少，而在于改变如何被"花费"；方向选择是控制行为漂移与提升性能的有效视角。

Abstract: Fine-tuning instruct models often improves target performance while inducing behavioral drift from the reference model, which can degrade existing capabilities. Rather than treating this drift as an uncontrolled consequence of optimization, we specify a behavioral drift budget before optimization and ask how to boost the target-task performance within it. Locally, behavioral drift induces a shared geometry anchored at the reference model, with the drift budget defining a boundary within this space. In this space, drift determines distance from the reference, leaving update direction as the remaining degree of freedom. Fine-tuning updates can therefore be compared through their directional efficiency, naturally reformulating fine-tuning as a direction-selection problem. This reformulation makes a concrete prediction: changing the accessible directions can qualitatively alter the outcome of fine-tuning. We test this prediction in a stringent QA-only setting, where strong instruct models are fine-tuned only on final answers but must still generate multi-step reasoning at inference. Despite this mismatch, a coarse layer-selective probe reverses the failure of QA-only fine-tuning and reveals the existence of effective directions, with multiple neighboring configurations improving target performance while preserving reasoning and general capabilities. Across Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B, these directions substantially improve scientific reasoning and multilingual translation. Over more than 100 languages, the resulting models match or outperform dedicated translation systems and provide a stronger initialization for subsequent reinforcement learning. Our results suggest that fine-tuning is not just about how much a model changes, but how that change is spent. https://github.com/CONE-MT/DCO and https://huggingface.co/collections/LLaMAX/dco

</details>


### [399] [Degraded but Not Entirely Ineffective: PE-Based Deformable Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13712)
*Jinhua Wu,Xinliang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PEBDSAM模块，利用位置空间中的可变形机制补充GNN一阶邻居信息，统一缓解过平滑、长程依赖、受限感受野与异质图噪声问题，并通过诊断实验简化为PEBSAM及PEBSAM-Speed。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统GNN基于一阶邻居传递消息，面临四大矛盾：深度增加导致过平滑、长程依赖导致过压缩、固定邻域限制感受野、异质图上拓扑邻居成为噪声源。现有工作多单独解决其中某一问题，缺乏同时缓解所有挑战的机制。

Method: 提出位置编码可变形空间聚合模块（PEBDSAM），在位置空间中使用可变形机制识别相关节点以补充一阶邻居信息；通过诊断实验发现当前offset无效，分析offset失效原因及性能仍提升的机理；据此简化得到PEBSAM，并提出适配大数据的PEBSAM-Speed；模块设计为即插即用。

Result: 将模块应用于GCN、GAT、GIN和GraphSAGE，在三个同质图数据集和六个异质图数据集上均取得理想效果。

Conclusion: PEBDSAM可一站式缓解GNN多项固有矛盾并适配异质场景；诊断实验揭示offset失效问题并指明未来研究方向；简化版本PEBSAM与PEBSAM-Speed具备即插即用的通用性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Many real-world scenarios can be represented using graph-structured data. However, traditional GNNs that transmit messages based on first-order neighbors have long faced several fundamental contradictions: increasing depth leads to over-smoothing, long-range dependencies cause over-compression, fixed neighborhoods restrict the receptive field, and on heterophilous graphs, topological neighbors become a source of noise. Although many works have addressed these issues individually, few mechanisms can simultaneously alleviate all of these challenges. To address the aforementioned problems, we propose a Position Encoding-Based Deformable Spatial Aggregation Module (PEBDSAM) that solves them all in one step. Specifically, we utilize a deformable mechanism in the position space to identify relevant nodes to supplement the original first-order neighbor information of GNNs, allowing traditional GNNs to adapt to heterophilous scenarios. Through diagnostic experiments, we obtained several major findings: current offsets fail to have any effect; subsequently, we analyzed the causes of offset failure and why model performance still improves even after offset failure, pointing out future research directions. Based on these diagnostic experiments, we streamlined the original PEBDSAM, resulting in a simplified version, which we call the Position Encoding-Based Spatial Aggregation Module (PEBSAM). In addition, we propose a PEBSAM-Speed to adapt to large datasets. Finally, we designed the module to be plug-and-play and applied it to GCN, GAT, GIN, and GraphSAGE, achieving desirable results on three homophilous datasets and six heterophilous graph datasets.

</details>


### [400] [JaxAHT: A JAX-Based Library for Ad Hoc Teamwork](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13716)
*Caroline Wang,Rolando Fernandez,Zelal Su Mustafaoglu,Montek Kundan,Jiaxun Cui,Lingyun Xiao,Zhihan Wang,Di Yang Shi,Aditya Madhan,Johnny Liu,Arrasy Rahman,Peter Stone*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 JaxAHT——首个基于 JAX 的开源库，用于加速并标准化 Ad Hoc Teamwork（AHT）研究流程，并提供多样化评估队友套件与大规模基准研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AHT 研究面临三大障碍：研究流程计算成本高昂、缺乏标准化基准实现、缺少多样且经过验证的评估队友套件。

Method: 基于 JAX 的硬件加速与大规模并行能力，构建统一框架，覆盖队友生成、ego agent 训练以及针对未见队友的评估，并提供 Level-Based Foraging、Overcooked、Hanabi 三个领域的评估队友套件。

Result: 相比 PyTorch 实现获得约 95 倍墙钟时间加速；通过大规模、计算量受控的基准研究比较队友生成与 AHT 智能体学习方法。

Conclusion: 没有一种算法能持续表现最优；智能体建模主要在具有多样队友的基于角色场景中带来收益。

Abstract: Ad Hoc Teamwork (AHT) addresses the challenge of designing agents capable of coordinating with novel partners without prior coordination. However, progress in the field is hindered by the prohibitive computational cost of the AHT research lifecycle, the lack of standardized benchmark implementations, and the absence of a diverse, validated evaluation teammate suite. In this work, we introduce JaxAHT, the first open-source, JAX-based library designed to accelerate and standardize the AHT research lifecycle. Leveraging JAX's hardware acceleration and massive parallelization capabilities, JaxAHT provides a unified framework for teammate generation, ego agent training, and evaluation against unseen teammates, achieving approximately 95x wall-clock speedup over PyTorch counterparts. Alongside the library, we contribute a diverse suite of evaluation teammates across the domains of Level-Based Foraging, Overcooked, and Hanabi. To illustrate the value of the framework, we use it to conduct a large-scale, compute-controlled benchmark study comparing teammate generation and AHT agent learning methods, finding that no algorithm consistently performs best, and that agent modeling primarily offers benefits in role-based scenarios with diverse teammates.

</details>


### [401] [MANAS-2: Constrained Reconstruction for EEG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13717)
*Arvasu Kulkarni,Aditya Ray Mishra,Mahir Jain,Parshva Runwal,Lakshya Saini,Siddharth Panwar,Sandeep Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MANAS-2是一种新的EEG基础模型，结合Raw-Band Hybrid掩码自编码器与物理启发的约束重建正则项ConRec，通过只作用于时间解码器输出来塑造编码器，使潜空间更具频谱组织性与可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码重建广泛用于EEG基础模型，但在低信噪比波形上优化重建质量并不一定能产生最有用的潜表征，因此需要一种能主动塑造表征结构的机制。

Method: 提出MANAS-2，包含Raw-Band Hybrid（RBH）掩码自编码器，联合重建时间波形patch与紧凑的频带目标；并引入ConRec正则项，仅作用于时间解码器输出，惩罚重建波形相邻短窗口之间RMS能量的差异，从而引导编码器组织振荡包络信息。

Result: 在七个留出EEG数据集上，RBH加入ConRec后，冻结ridge对六频带谱功率的恢复从平均R²=0.860提升到0.906，对patch间频带能量动态的恢复从R²=0.283提升到0.354，同时时间波形信息仍高度可恢复。将ConRec用于纯时间掩码自编码器时，即便无频谱目标也能改善冻结下游迁移与频率相关潜几何，说明效果与架构无关。MANAS-2在大多数下游知识迁移任务上优于领先的EEG基础模型。

Conclusion: 通过解码器施加物理启发的约束，可以产生频谱组织更好、更可迁移的潜空间；MANAS-2以约束重建作为塑造表征质量（而非重建质量）的机制，提供了新的EEG基础模型。

Abstract: Masked reconstruction is widely used for EEG foundation models, but optimizing reconstruction on low-SNR waveforms does not necessarily produce the most useful latent representation. We introduce MANAS-2, a new EEG foundation model that combines a Raw-Band Hybrid (RBH) masked autoencoder with Constrained Reconstruction (ConRec), a physics-motivated regularizer. RBH jointly reconstructs temporal waveform patches and compact spectral-band targets, while ConRec acts only on the temporal decoder output, penalizing differences in RMS energy between adjacent short windows of the reconstructed waveform. ConRec is intended to shape the encoder by biasing it toward the organization of oscillatory-envelope information. Across seven held-out EEG datasets, adding ConRec to an otherwise identical RBH model increases frozen ridge recovery of six-band spectral power from mean R^2=0.860 to 0.906 and recovery of inter-patch band-energy dynamics from R^2=0.283 to 0.354, while temporal waveform information remains highly recoverable from the frozen latents. Applied to a temporal-only masked autoencoder, ConRec also improves frozen downstream transfer and frequency-dependent latent geometry despite receiving no spectral targets: i.e., the effects of ConRec are architecture-independent. MANAS-2 also outperforms leading EEG Foundation Models on most downstream knowledge-transfer tasks. From the effects of ConRec, we see that a physically motivated constraint imposed through the decoder can make for a more spectrally organized and transferable latent space. MANAS-2 therefore provides a new EEG foundation model built around constrained reconstruction as a mechanism for shaping representation--rather than reconstruction--quality.

</details>


### [402] [Externalizing Requirement-to-Repair Artifacts as Observable Traces for LLM-Based Program Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14913)
*Zewen Tao,Shin-nosuke Ishikawa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: THEMIS：面向仓库级修复的阶段感知工作流，通过语义解释、需求-代码图、Developer 指导、修复理由/补丁与审计记录，显式化"需求到修复"的跨阶段过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仓库级修复不仅需要正确补丁，还需要可检查的记录，用以说明问题需求如何转化为代码变更及修复后的证据。现有流程中这些"需求到修复"的转换往往是隐式的，无法系统审查。

Method: 提出阶段感知工作流 THEMIS，外化需求到修复过程：语义解释、运行时需求-代码图、由图派生 Developer 指导、保留修复理由与补丁、编辑后审计记录。并在 300 个 SWE-bench Lite 案例上做回溯审计，辅以 100 对配对比较。

Result: 288/300 案例具备完整 Developer 理由；214 例（71.3%）保留连接所选阶段的完整审计字段集。目标符号在 62.6% 的 Developer 理由与 62.8% 的补丁中重复出现，含相关符号后升至 75.8%。配对比较中关系型工作流解决 19 例 vs 直接条件 9 例（因条件在 Analyzer 输出、图蒸馏、Judge 记录上也有差异，仅作初步工作流级证据）。

Conclusion: THEMIS 使原本隐式的需求-修复转换变得可检查，支持系统性地考察修复决策如何跨阶段持续、对齐与演化。

Abstract: Repository-level repair requires not only correct patches but also inspectable records that explain how issue requirements are translated into code changes and post-edit evidence. We contribute THEMIS, a stage-aware repair workflow that externalizes this requirement-to-repair process through semantic interpretation, a runtime requirement-code graph, graph-derived Developer guidance, retained repair rationale and patches, and post-edit audit records. A retrospective audit of 300 SWE-bench Lite cases demonstrates that these artifacts provide broad support for cross-stage inspection: a complete Developer rationale is available for 288 cases, and 214 cases (71.3%) retain a complete audited field set connecting the selected stages. The retained records further enable systematic measurement of cross-stage correspondence: target symbols recur in 62.6% of Developer rationales and in 62.8% of patches, rising to 75.8% when related symbols are included. In a paired 100-case comparison, the relational workflow resolves 19 cases versus 9 for the direct same-input condition; because the two conditions also differ in Analyzer output, graph-derived distillation, and Judge records, we report this as preliminary, workflow-level evidence rather than a causal effect of the graph component. Together, these results show that THEMIS makes otherwise implicit requirement-to-repair transitions inspectable, enabling systematic examination of how repair decisions persist, align, and evolve across stages.

</details>


### [403] [IBBench-Light: A Paired Evaluation of Task-Conditioned Responses to External Directives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13725)
*Kainan Zhou,Gangzhen Qian,Zhaoyi Li,Hang Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出IBBench-Light基准，通过配对应用（执行）与阅读（处理）同一记录两种任务，引入成对精确契约准确率（PECA），并强调评估指令模型时停止策略（EOS集）对结果的关键影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外部记录既可被用来执行过程（apply），也可被用来阅读文本（read），取决于用户请求。现有基准通常以边际平均报告性能，掩盖了同一记录下两种用途的成对成功情况，且生成停止策略可能显著影响结果。

Method: 构建IBBench-Light：12个语义基生成144个匹配对/模型；用4个量化指令模型产生1,152条贪心响应；定义PECA，要求一对中两个成员均满足输出契约。审计字面目标暴露与大小写规范化，并新增1,722条CPU生成，测试指令缺失对照、额外12个语义基、基内措辞变化和生成停止。另在固定Phi重跑中改变EOS集，并做有界IHEval对比（同SmolLM2检查点与输出预算，保留原始指令角色与评分器）。

Result: Qwen在132个execute和109个process提示上成功，但仅97个完整配对成功，说明边际平均会遗漏配对信息。固定Phi重跑中，改变EOS集使精确配对成功从0/144变为62/144。

Conclusion: 该基准衡量条件任务与输出契约成功；解读任务边际与配对计数时必须结合停止策略，才能避免误判模型能力。

Abstract: An external record may contain a procedure to apply or text to read, depending on the user's request. IBBench-Light tests both uses against the same record. Twelve semantic bases yield 144 matched pairs per model; four quantized instruction models produced 1,152 archived greedy responses. Paired exact-contract accuracy (PECA) requires both members to satisfy their output contracts. Qwen succeeds on 132 execute and 109 process prompts, but only 97 complete pairs, showing what marginal averages omit. We audit literal-target exposure and case normalization, then add 1,722 logged CPU generations to test directive-absent controls, twelve additional semantic bases, within-base wording changes, and generation stopping. In the pinned Phi rerun, changing the end-of-sequence (EOS) set changes exact paired success from 0/144 to 62/144. A bounded IHEval comparison uses the same SmolLM2 checkpoint and output budget while preserving its published instruction roles and scorer. The benchmark measures conditional task and output-contract success. Its task margins and paired count need to be read together with the stopping policy.

</details>


### [404] [OpenAI4S: Code as Action, Science as Sessions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15096)
*Gongbo Zhang,Hao Li,Yu Wang,Mujie Lin,Liuzhenghao Lv,Yicheng Mao,Yimi Wang,Jun Zhu,Minhan Tang,Zhengxiang Jiang,Yusong Wang,Jiayu Yao,Kunpeng Ning,Dawei Pang,Yonghong Tian,OpenAI4S Community,Yuyang Liu,Li Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 OpenAI4S 开源科研智能体，基于"代码即动作、科学即会话"原则，结合持久化计算运行时与会话管理，通过动作账本和版本化工件保证可检视、可恢复、可复现，在36个科研场景中显著优于通用编码框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 科学家可加速计算研究，但长周期工作流需保持可检视、可恢复、可复现，这要求持久化的计算状态与溯源机制。

Method: 持久化计算运行时 + 研究会话管理；结构化工具调用编排，科学动作表示为在持久 Python/R 内核中执行的完整代码单元。采用只追加 Action Ledger、单元级执行记录、版本化工件、环境记录和工作区检查点，支持会话恢复、分支与扩展；配以可配置沙箱、权限控制及代码/轨迹审查。

Result: 在逆合成、分子动力学、蛋白结合设计、蛋白突变、催化剂筛选和矿物光谱等36个科研场景中评估。OpenAI4S 综合得分 7.83，通用编码框架在三个前沿模型下为 5.7–6.4，长周期和计算密集型任务提升最大。

Conclusion: 将持久化执行与会话级溯源结合可提升 AI 辅助科研工作流的可靠性；但环境规范与完全可重跑对所有系统（含本系统）仍是弱项，可复现性仍是科学智能体的开放问题。系统以 MIT 许可开源。

Abstract: AI co-scientists could accelerate computational research, but over a long-running study the workflow also has to stay inspectable, resumable and reproducible, which requires persistent computational state and provenance. Here we present OpenAI4S, an open-source scientific research agent built around the principle of \emph{Code as Action, Science as Sessions}. OpenAI4S combines a persistent computing runtime with research-session management: orchestration is handled through structured tool calls, while scientific actions are represented as complete code cells executed in persistent Python and R kernels. An append-only Action Ledger, per-cell execution records, versioned artifacts, environment records, and workspace checkpoints preserve how results were produced and support session recovery, branching, and extension. Configurable sandboxing, permission controls, and code and trajectory screening provide complementary safeguards. We evaluate OpenAI4S on 36 research scenarios spanning retrosynthesis, molecular dynamics, protein binder design, protein mutation, catalyst screening, and mineral spectroscopy, measuring scientific task accuracy, workflow completeness, and reproducibility of the resulting repositories. OpenAI4S achieves an overall score of 7.83, compared with 5.7--6.4 for a general-purpose coding harness evaluated with three frontier models, with the largest gains on long-horizon and computation-intensive workflows. These results suggest that integrating persistent execution with session-level provenance can improve the reliability of AI-assisted scientific workflows. Environment specification and full rerunnability remain weak for every evaluated system, ours included, so reproducibility is still an open problem for scientific agents. The system is available under the MIT license at \href{https://github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/OpenAI4S}{github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/OpenAI4S}.

</details>


### [405] [Trustworthy Agentic AI: A Comprehensive Cybersecurity and Systems Survey on Threat Landscapes, Defense Architectures, and Open Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13731)
*Seyedakbar Mostafavi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文综述自主智能体AI的系统安全，综合206项研究与标准，提出形式化架构、可信度分类体系及零信任多层防御框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从被动基础模型转向自主、目标导向的智能体AI系统，引入递归推理、持久记忆、工具执行与多智能体协作等能力，但赋予概率神经网络核心对文件系统、网络与云基础设施的执行权，瓦解了传统安全边界——自然语言同时充当输入数据、内部控制代码与通信协议，形成图灵完备的攻击面，其中不可信数据即指令。

Method: 综合206项基础研究与监管标准；将通用智能体架构形式化为有状态5元组；建立涵盖安全、安全性、隐私、可解释性、公平性与问责的6维可信度分类体系；系统分析执行循环内部与交互平面的威胁面；提出集成Dual-LLM隔离、能力访问控制、内核eBPF探针与沙箱运行时的多层零信任纵深防御架构。

Result: 系统化梳理了智能体AI的威胁面，提出形式化架构与可信度分类，并给出多层防御架构；同时评审标准化评估基准，并将技术控制映射至国际AI治理框架。

Conclusion: 该综述为可信智能体AI提供了全面的系统安全参考框架，将技术控制与国际AI治理框架相结合，为自主智能体系统的安全保障提供指导。

Abstract: The transition from passive foundation models to autonomous, goal-directed agentic AI systems has introduced unprecedented capabilities by coupling recursive cognitive reasoning loops, persistent memory architectures, live tool execution planes, and multi-agent collaboration topologies. However, granting probabilistic neural cores execution authority across filesystems, networks, and cloud infrastructure dissolves classical security perimeters: natural language simultaneously serves as input data, internal control code, and communication protocols, exposing a Turing-complete blast radius where untrusted data represents executable instructions. This survey delivers a comprehensive systems-security reference framework for trustworthy agentic AI, synthesizing 206 foundational studies and regulatory standards. We formalize the general agent architecture as a stateful 5-tuple and establish a 6-dimensional trustworthiness taxonomy covering security, safety, privacy, explainability, fairness, and accountability. We systematically analyze threat surfaces across intra-execution loops and interaction planes, formulate a multi-layered zero-trust defense-in-depth architecture integrating Dual-LLM isolation, Capability-Based Access Control, kernel eBPF probes, and sandboxed runtimes, review standardized evaluation benchmarks, and map technical controls to international AI governance frameworks.

</details>


### [406] [When Tool Calls Succeed but Workflows Fail: Anomalies at the Agent-Tool Boundary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15397)
*Artem Trofimov,Boris Novikov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究AI代理长时工作流中外部工具调用导致的效应不一致问题，提出效应历史模型与8类外部效应异常目录，推导边界能力需求，并实证发现MCP标准注解词汇仅提供粗粒度提示，无法完整表达所需能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理通过独立提供的工具执行长时工作流，在重试、推测执行、并发与部分失败下，外部状态可能与预期不一致（效应缺失、重复、残留、依赖临时状态）。现有高级事务模型假设底层操作暴露必要语义，但共享代理-工具接口通常不满足。

Method: 提出效应历史模型，区分外部世界事件与运行时对事件的观测；构建8类重复出现的外部效应异常目录；从目录推导排除每类异常所需的边界能力，并识别黑箱工具调用无法提供通用保证的4个点；随后在98,291个已注册MCP服务器暴露的工具上，度量标准注解词汇的使用情况。

Result: 标准注解字段被广泛发出，但仅提供粗粒度的调用级提示，所需能力无一可被完整表达。

Conclusion: 结果说明需要在工具边界引入可复用的“事务性契约”（transactional contracts）。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly execute long-running workflows that externalize effects through independently supplied tools. Under retries, speculative execution, concurrency, and partial failures, the resulting external state may be inconsistent with the workflow's intended resolution: required effects may be missing or duplicated, aborted effects may survive, and committed effects may depend on provisional state that is later withdrawn. Advanced transaction models address related failures, but assume that lower-level operations expose the semantics they depend on: whether an effect occurred, whether it can be compensated, staged, or safely reordered. Shared agent-tool interfaces usually do not.
  We contribute an effect-history model that separates events in the external world from the runtime's observations of them, and a catalog of eight recurring external-effect anomalies. From the catalog we derive the boundary capabilities required to exclude each anomaly in general, and four points where black-box tool invocation alone cannot provide a general guarantee. We then ask how much of this is expressible in a widely used shared tool interface, measuring the use of the standard annotation vocabulary across 98,291 tools exposed by registered Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. The fields are widely emitted but provide only coarse call-level hints, and none of the required capabilities is fully expressible. These results motivate reusable transactional contracts at the tool boundary.

</details>


### [407] [How Many Thoughts Can a Vector Hold? The Capacity of Reasoning by Superposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13747)
*Hongyu Gu,Chang Liu,Jingwen Fu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出将思维链中的连续"思想叠加"视为设计原则：保留完整推理历史的累积叠加而非仅保留当前前沿，反而在相同维度下支持更多有效计算，均匀累积加权是鲁棒推理的minimax最优选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续/循环推理方法将部分计算移入固定维度的隐状态，单个"思想"可叠加多个备选。一个直觉认为应丢弃历史、只保留当前推理前沿以避免状态稀释。论文质疑这一直觉，并探讨连续思想应保留什么、隐状态中记忆应如何加权。

Method: 在相同下游计算下，比较"累积叠加"（保留完整推理历史）与"仅前沿叠加"（仅保留当前备选）所需的表征维度；分析历史信息成分的相干强化与无关备选的随机干扰；研究不同加权方案（近期/显著项优先 vs 均匀累积加权）对后续注意力的影响，并给出minimax最优性证明。

Result: 累积叠加保留完整历史所需维度更低；在固定隐宽度下可保留更多有效证据、区分更多下游结果、延迟状态不可靠的临界点。优先近期/显著项会弱化记忆并成为后续注意力瓶颈；均匀累积加权避免此缺陷，并被证明对未来鲁棒推理是minimax最优。

Conclusion: 该工作将叠加从观察到的隐空间效应提升为设计原则：平衡的累积记忆使固定表征预算支持更可靠、可复用的计算。

Abstract: Large language models solve hard problems through intermediate computations across multi-step reasoning. Traditional chain-of-thought encodes these computations as tokens. Recent continuous and recurrent methods instead move partial computations into fixed-dimensional latent states, where a single thought can superpose multiple alternatives. This raises a fundamental design question:what should continuous thoughts preserve as reasoning proceeds? An intuitive approach discards past computations and keeps only the current reasoning frontier. Storing more items seems to dilute states and waste limited representational capacity. We show this intuition can be incorrect. Under identical downstream computations, cumulative superposition retaining full reasoning history can require lower representational dimensions than frontier-only superposition holding only current alternatives. At fixed hidden width, this advantage allows latent reasoners to retain more valid evidence, distinguish more plausible downstream outcomes, and delay the point where compressed states turn unreliable. This counter-intuitive effect emerges because informative historical components coherently reinforce each other, while unrelated alternatives bring random interference. This perspective also answers a practical design question: how should models weight memories accumulated inside latent states when their future use is unknown? Across reusable weighted superpositions, prioritizing a small set of recent or salient items produces weakly-represented memories that bottleneck subsequent attention. Uniform cumulative weighting avoids this flaw, and we prove it is minimax-optimal for robust future reasoning. Our results turn superposition from an observed latent-space effect into a design principle: balanced cumulative memory lets a fixed representational budget support more reliable, reusable computations.

</details>


### [408] [Positioning manuscripts in the scientific landscape with agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13760)
*Jiawen Chen,Zichen Zhang,Bingxuan Li,Quan Sun,Yiyan Zhang,Edric Tam,Jinjie Lin,Didong Li,Yun Li,Bingxin Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PASS，一个基于LLM的智能体系统，通过将稿件置于其领域文献语境中，预测其最匹配的发表期刊。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发表论文耗时、压力大且结果不确定，作者希望探究智能体AI能否帮助研究者预测稿件最终发表去向。

Method: PASS通过重建稿件的局部科学邻域、追踪主题轨迹、在领域期刊空间中推理，将稿件定位在文献版图中以预测顶级匹配期刊。

Result: 在覆盖16个生物医学领域、2000多篇预印本的防泄漏基准上，PASS实现Top-1准确率50.3%、Top-5准确率86.1%，优于最先进LLM基线和期刊选择工具；文献检索模块贡献最大，仅用摘要即可保持近乎全部性能。

Conclusion: PASS能可靠预测发表去向，质量评分与独立发表结果指标一致，人类评估认可度高，并已作为公共平台发布。

Abstract: Publishing a research manuscript is a routine yet demanding part of scientific life: time-consuming, stressful, and often uncertain in outcome. Recent advances in large language model (LLM)-based agentic AI have shown promise across a range of scientific tasks, and here we ask whether agentic AI can help researchers navigate the publication process itself by reliably inferring a manuscript's eventual publication venue from its content and literature context. We introduce PASS (Publication-oriented Agentic Scientific System), an agentic system that understands manuscripts within their domain-specific literature context and predicts top-matched publication venues. PASS positions each manuscript within its surrounding literature landscape by reconstructing its local scientific neighborhood, tracing its topic trajectory, and reasoning over field-specific journal spaces. Evaluated on a leakage-audited benchmark of over 2,000 preprints across 16 biomedical fields, PASS achieved Top-1 accuracy of 50.3% and Top-5 accuracy of 86.1%, outperforming state-of-the-art LLM baselines and established journal-selection tools. PASS-produced quality scores, such as impact potential and novelty, aligned with independent measures of publication outcome. We also found that the designed literature retrieval module is the strongest performance contributor, particularly for positioning manuscripts relative to nearby work, and that PASS maintained near-full performance from the abstract alone, whereas LLM baselines required the full manuscript text. An independent human evaluation found strong researcher agreement with PASS's manuscript understanding and recommendation rationale. PASS has been released as a public platform (https://ratemypaper.ai/) for broad researcher access.

</details>


### [409] [Homeostatic Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13771)
*Yue Jin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"稳态持续学习"(Homeostatic Continual Learning)方法，使AI智能体能在变化环境中持续学习而不发生灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体在变化环境中持续学习时面临灾难性遗忘问题，需要一种能不断扩展模型与策略、适应越来越多情境的学习机制。

Method: 当智能体输出出现异常(outlier)时，在环境数据中定位对应的离群点，据此逐步扩充模型和策略；并进一步提出将世界分解为特征、将抽象对象映射为可比的概念实例、再经由特征把概念映射到意图，从而构建世界模型。

Result: 智能体逐步完善模型与策略，并在越来越多情境下表现良好；文中还讨论了方法落地所需的工作、与AI各领域的联系及更广泛的启示（属概念性/前瞻性论述，无实验量化结果）。

Conclusion: 该范式为构建持续学习与世界模型提供了新思路，但实现与验证仍需大量后续研究。

Abstract: In this paper, I formulate a Continual Learning problem and propose a method named "Homeostatic Continual Learning" that enables an AI agent to learn continuously in a changing environment without catastrophic forgetting. The core of the method is to find outliers in the environment data when the agent experiences an outlier in its output. Through this method, the agent gradually completes its model and policy and performs well in more and more contexts. I also suggest that we may use the method to build a world model where the agent factorizes the objects in the world into features, abstract objects into comparable instances of concepts and map concepts to intents through features. I discuss the works needed to render the method practical, the connections to many fields in Artificial Intelligence and the broader implications of the method.

</details>


### [410] [Surprising Effectiveness of Self-Demonstrations in Enhancing Schema-Ontology Mapping with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13776)
*Siddhesh Thombre,Manasi Patwardhan,Sunita Sarawagi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种自演示驱动的神经符号方法，将关系数据库模式映射到本体。通过任务分解与模式引导的自生成演示，在RODI基准上取得SOTA，F1提升约25个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业知识表示中将异构关系数据库集成到统一本体长期存在难题，主要源于语义异构、模式命名晦涩、元数据缺失以及关系模式与本体模型之间的抽象鸿沟。尽管LLM具备语义推理能力，但直接使用一次性提示或朴素多阶段流程进行模式-本体映射效果较差。

Method: 提出自演示驱动方法，结合神经符号任务分解与自动生成"模式引导、依赖感知"演示的机制。核心策略包括：(i) 将任务神经符号分解为级联子任务，用符号约束构建搜索空间，LLM在各聚焦子任务内做语义推理；(ii) 由领域无关模式引导自生成演示来监督每个子任务。

Result: 在RODI基准三个最具挑战性场景上达到SOTA，F1较传统模式-本体映射技术及近期LLM的模式-本体与模式匹配方法提升约25个百分点。消融实验验证了模式引导自演示的显著收益及神经符号任务分解的互补作用。

Conclusion: 自演示驱动的神经符号方法有效解决了模式-本体映射的抽象鸿沟问题，模式引导自演示与任务分解两项策略互补，共同带来显著精度提升。

Abstract: Integrating heterogeneous relational databases into a centralized ontology remains a persistent challenge in enterprise knowledge representation, primarily due to semantic heterogeneity, cryptic schema naming, missing metadata, and the abstraction gap between relational schemas and ontological models. Although large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic reasoning capabilities, we show that directly applying them through one-shot prompting or naive multi-stage pipelines leads to poor performance for schema-ontology mapping. This paper presents a self-demonstration-driven approach that combines a neuro-symbolic task decomposition with a novel mechanism for automatically generating pattern-guided, dependency-aware demonstrations to address this integration challenge. Our approach incorporates two key strategies to achieve substantial accuracy gains over existing LLM-based schema integration methods: (i) a neuro-symbolic decomposition of the task into cascaded sub-tasks, where symbolic constraints structure the search space and LLMs perform semantic reasoning within each focused sub-task, and (ii) self-generated demonstrations guided by domain-agnostic patterns to supervise each sub-task. Experiments on three of the most challenging scenarios from the RODI benchmark show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, substantially outperforming (25 percentage points F1 improvements) both traditional schema-to-ontology mapping techniques and recent LLM-based schema-to-ontology and schema matching approaches. Ablation studies further reveal the significant benefits of pattern-guided self-demonstrations and the complementary benefits of neuro-symbolic task decomposition.

</details>


### [411] [Partition Scores Are Not System Scores: Deployment-Fidelity Gaps in Decomposed Algorithm Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13785)
*Jiachen Zhang,Yu Tang,Li Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文定义"部署保真度差距"G(R)，指出分区级得分高估了可部署系统的真实效用，并在五个算法选择基准上验证该差距普遍存在，可能改变分解与平坦方法的对比结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上，oracle式量（虚拟最优求解器等）被当作可部署选择器效用的上界。在分解式算法选择中，分区分数的oracle选择在家族选择器固定后必须替换为学习得到的族内选择器，这一替换导致分区级报告与实际部署端到端效用不一致，可能误导方法比较。

Method: 作者定义部署保真度差距G(R)，即分区级与可部署端到端效用之差，并推导两个核算推论：一是逐实例的margin-regret稳定性条件，判断分区级家族选择是否在部署中最优；二是仅依赖分区信息的分区识别区间，当它严格跨零时，分区级报告无法证明谁是可部署赢家。并在五个公开基准（表格AutoML与组合CSP/SAT）上评估十组分解-平坦对比，同时引入训练侧验证差距修正诊断。

Result: 所有分解式流水线的G(R)均为正，从TabZilla的0.012到PROTEUS-2014的0.13。十组分解-平坦决策中有四组符号发生反转；在PROTEUS-2014上，33点的分区优势缩水为20点端到端优势。训练侧验证差距修正诊断在全部四个符号反转单元上都能恢复出可部署的点估计符号，但只是报告辅助工具，不能替代直接端到端评估。

Conclusion: 分区级与端到端得分应并排报告，避免oracle式分区分数误导部署决策；差距修正诊断可用于报告，但直接端到端评估仍不可替代。

Abstract: Oracle-style quantities, including virtual best solvers, selected-portfolio VBS, virtual-best encodings, and best-in-family summaries, are widely reported as upper bounds on what a deployable selector could achieve. In decomposed algorithm selection, an analogous partition-level score grants an oracle choice of the best algorithm within the selected family; once the family selector is fixed, the deployable system must replace that within-family oracle with a learned within-family selector.
  We define the deployment-fidelity gap G(R) as the difference between partition-level and deployable end-to-end utility and derive two accounting consequences: a per-instance margin-regret stability condition that tells us when a partition-time family choice is deployment-optimal, and a sharp partition-only identification interval that, when it strictly crosses zero, prevents the partition-level report from certifying the deployable winner.
  Across five public algorithm-selection benchmarks spanning tabular AutoML and combinatorial CSP/SAT, every decomposed pipeline has positive G(R), ranging from 0.012 on TabZilla to 0.13 on PROTEUS-2014. Four of ten decomposed-versus-flat decisions have sign-changing point estimates; on PROTEUS-2014, a 33-point partition advantage shrinks to a 20-point end-to-end advantage. A training-side validation gap-correction diagnostic recovers the point-estimate deployable sign on all four sign-changing cells; it is a reporting aid, not a substitute for direct end-to-end evaluation. Partition and end-to-end scores should be reported side by side.

</details>


### [412] [Do Not Restart: Residual Completion for Stateful Agent Handoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13800)
*Runzhi Deng,Yiming Zhong,Fang Zhao,Pan Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出CFRC框架，将跨模型交接建模为“承诺约束的剩余补全”问题，通过冻结剩余契约并只在证据覆盖时才放行执行，实现低成本、可验证的工具智能体路由与级联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路由与级联虽能通过跨模型转移控制来降低工具智能体成本，但有状态交接必须保留已接受的选择、已实现的效果和未完成的义务，现有方法缺乏对这种承诺一致性的形式化与保障。

Method: 提出Commitment-Frontier Residual Completion（CFRC），强制三条规则：先定目标后提案、先整提案后授权、先实时证据后成功；从已接受进度冻结剩余契约，将后继延续闭包为证据关联图，仅当剩余部分被覆盖时才允许执行，并以实时收据清偿义务。

Result: 证明契约相对的部分正确性，并在完整契约构造下扩展到原始剩余请求；在五个环境和两个同供应商模型对上，CFRC以强全任务智能体22.0%-34.6%的推理成本达到可比的宏观准确率，并展示跨供应商的可迁移性。

Conclusion: CFRC为有状态工具智能体交接提供了承诺一致性的形式化框架，兼顾正确性保证与显著成本优势，并具备跨模型供应商的泛化能力。

Abstract: Routing and cascades reduce tool-agent cost by transferring control across models, but stateful handoffs must preserve accepted choices, realized effects, and unfinished obligations. We formulate this as commitment-constrained residual completion and introduce Commitment-Frontier Residual Completion (CFRC). CFRC enforces target-before-proposal, whole-proposal-before-authority, and live-evidence-before-success: it freezes a residual contract from accepted progress, closes the successor continuation into an evidence-linked graph, and admits execution only when the remainder is covered, with live receipts discharging obligations. We establish contract-relative partial correctness, which extends to the original residual request under complete contract construction. Across five environments and two same-provider model pairs, CFRC achieves comparable macro accuracy to strong full-task agents at only 22.0%-34.6% of their inference cost, with additional cross-provider results demonstrating broader transfer.

</details>


### [413] [LLM-Enhanced Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Unified Electric Vehicles-Charging Station-Grid Optimization in Public Charging Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13805)
*Yang Zhang,Lindong Xie,Chongyu Wang,Gaojunjie Li,Siqi Bu,Edward Chung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个LLM增强的MARL框架，首次在统一闭环中同时优化电网、电动汽车和充电站三方利益，解决IoT场景下EV充电调度的高维状态与多目标冲突问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IoT时代EV充电调度需平衡充电满意度、站点盈利与电网稳定，是多目标难题；现有MARL方法难以应对海量IoT数据带来的高维状态空间及各方利益冲突。

Method: 将LLM融入MARL：利用LLM分析实时IoT环境状态，进行可解释的特征选择，并通过语义推理动态分配冲突目标（利润、用户满意度、电网负载）的权重，替代复杂的人工调参。

Result: 大量实验表明该框架显著优于现有最优基线，在提升市场效率的同时将训练时间减少70%以上。

Conclusion: 该方案为IoT赋能的城市充电基础设施管理提供了可扩展、透明且高效可持续的解决途径。

Abstract: In the era of the Internet of Things (IoT), coordinating connected electric vehicle (EV) charging scheduling to balance EV charging satisfaction, station profitability, and smart grid stability presents a complex multi-objective challenge. Existing Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) approaches often struggle with high-dimensional state spaces generated by massive IoT sensing data and conflicting stakeholder interests. This paper proposes a novel LLM-enhanced MARL framework that, for the first time, simultaneously optimizes the Grid, EVs, and Stations within a unified loop. By integrating Large Language Model (LLM), we address two critical bottlenecks: interpretable feature selection and adaptive multi-objective balancing. The LLM analyzes real-time IoT-collected environmental states to extract physically significant features and dynamically assigns weights to conflicting objectives-including profit, user satisfaction, and grid load-using semantic reasoning instead of complex manual tuning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving superior market efficiency while reducing training time by over 70%. This approach offers a scalable, transparent solution for efficient and sustainable IoT-enabled urban charging infrastructure management.

</details>


### [414] [Bypass Observation: A Conceptual Design of a Non-Intrusive Layer-Wise Semantic Extraction Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13807)
*Haibin Tong,Jiang Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Bypass Observation：在Transformer选定层挂载只读观测头，不回流主干，使隐状态计算更可观测，并区分其与常规思维链的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在高维隐空间推理，用户只能看到最终输出，缺乏对中间计算的观察手段，需要非侵入式的可观测性架构。

Method: 在选定Transformer层附加只读观测头，其输出不反馈主干；设计三种变体（共享LM头、层专属头、层/步自适应头）；对全词表读出推导以V/(12d)为主的闭式开销近似，并讨论稀疏观测、低秩分解、缩减词表、top-k读出、选择性位置等降本手段。

Result: 全词表读出的开销估计约占30%–240%；论证bypass读出仅为隐状态的局部且可能误导的投影；区分bypass CoT（推理时因果外部，但可在RL中提供训练信号）与常规CoT（token进入自回归计算）；并讨论在循环/递归深度Transformer中逐迭代读出可能揭示收敛、振荡与停机信号。

Conclusion: 该工作为概念与分析性提案，尚未进行系统实证验证，后续需实验检验其可观测性收益与风险。

Abstract: Large language models reason in high-dimensional hidden-state spaces, while users observe only final outputs. We introduce Bypass Observation, a non-intrusive layer-wise readout architecture that attaches read-only observation heads to selected Transformer layers without feeding their outputs back into the backbone. We consider three variants: a shared LM head across layers, layer-specific heads, and a layer- or step-adaptive head. For full-vocabulary readout, we derive a closed-form overhead approximation governed primarily by V/(12d), with representative estimates ranging from about 30% to 240%, and discuss cost reductions via sparse observation, low-rank factorization, reduced vocabularies, top-k readout, and selective positions. We argue that Bypass Observation can make model computation more observable while remaining only a partial, potentially misleading projection of hidden states. We further distinguish bypass chain-of-thought from conventional chain-of-thought: conventional reasoning tokens enter the autoregressive computation, whereas bypass readouts remain causally external at inference time, although they can still provide training signals in reinforcement learning. Finally, we discuss applications to looped and recurrent-depth Transformers, where iteration-wise readout may expose convergence, oscillation, and potential halting signals. The proposal is conceptual and analytical; systematic empirical validation remains future work.

</details>


### [415] [ViperQ: Order Flow Pattern Recognition via Auction Market Theory for Reinforcement Learning Trading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13825)
*Asser Moustafa,Rares-Mihail Neagu,Jugal Kalita*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ViperQ是首个从拍卖市场理论(AMT)原语构建状态表示的强化学习交易系统，在TSLA/NVDA tick数据上取得显著超额收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学术RL交易系统普遍依赖OHLCV或订单簿深度特征，而实践者文献中的微观结构模式理论（拍卖市场理论、市场轮廓）缺乏同行评审的计算实现，存在理论与实践的鸿沟。

Method: 状态表示由AMT原语构成：成交量控制点(VPOC)、价值区位置、低成交量节点标志、累计成交量差分歧、盘口速度特征，组装为20维Z-normalised向量；用两个PPO智能体训练，奖励函数基于前景理论，按Kahneman-Tversky损失厌恶系数惩罚亏损持仓。

Result: 在未见过的12个月机构tick数据上：TSLA +163.6% ROI（最大回撤-27.5%，27,019笔交易），NVDA +116.5% ROI（最大回撤-47.8%，12,892笔交易），零杠杆。

Conclusion: 证实AMT特征可作为金融时间序列序贯决策的可解结构化输入模态，推动微观结构感知的策略学习研究。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning trading systems published in the academic literature overwhelmingly rely on price-aggregate state representations (OHLCV bars) or limit-order-book depth features, leaving microstructure pattern theories from the practitioner literature, namely Auction Market Theory and Market Profile, without a peer-reviewed computational instantiation. We present ViperQ, a reinforcement learning system whose state representation is built explicitly from Auction Market Theory primitives: Volume Point of Control, Value Area position, Low Volume Node flags, Cumulative Volume Delta divergence, and tape-velocity signatures, assembled into a 20-dimensional Z-normalised vector. Two Proximal Policy Optimisation agents are trained with a prospect theory-grounded asymmetric reward function that penalises losing holds at a magnitude consistent with Kahneman and Tversky's loss-aversion coefficient. Evaluated on a held-out twelve-month partition of institutional tick data the agents have never seen, ViperQ achieves +163.6% ROI on TSLA (-27.5% max drawdown, 27,019 trades) and +116.5% ROI on NVDA (-47.8% max drawdown, 12,892 trades) under zero leverage. The results establish Auction Market Theory features as a tractable structured input modality for sequential decision-making on financial time series and motivate further work on microstructure-aware policy learning.

</details>


### [416] [UniCAR-RL: Seeing Better before Thinking Deeper in Visual Mathematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13849)
*Yuzhe Li,Hao Yan,Hao Wang,Xingchen Liu,Ya-Qi Yu,Jihao Wu,Minghui Liao,Wei Chen,Yuliang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: UniCAR-RL：一种无需标注的强化学习框架，训练中解耦感知与推理优化，仅用短答案数据显著提升MLLM数学视觉推理并具泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM在复杂数学视觉推理中因缺乏细粒度感知导致初始视觉幻觉，进而引发级联推理失败。传统端到端RL的稀疏奖励无法解耦感知幻觉与逻辑错误，难以针对性优化感知；而用感知增强CoT数据微调成本高且引入幻觉。

Method: 提出UniCAR-RL（无需标注的RL框架），显式解耦感知与推理优化，含三个协同分支：1) Caption-RL分支，通过验证器引导的推理校验优化感知；2) Reasoning-RL分支，基于金标准图像描述进行逻辑推理以阻断级联错误；3) QA-RL分支，保留原生端到端对齐以保证稳健问答性能。

Result: 实验表明，UniCAR-RL仅用原始短答案数据即可大幅提升MLLM的数学与视觉推理能力，并在多种架构和规模上展现强泛化性。

Conclusion: 解耦感知与推理的RL训练是提升MLLM数学视觉推理的有效路径，且无需标注、成本低、泛化性强。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often struggle with complex mathematical visual reasoning primarily due to a lack of fine-grained perception, causing initial visual hallucinations to directly trigger cascading reasoning failures. In traditional end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL), sparse rewards fail to decouple perceptual hallucinations from logical missteps, hindering targeted perception optimization. Alternatively, fine-tuning with perception-enhanced CoT data incurs high costs and hallucinations. In this paper, we address these challenges by proposing UniCAR-RL, an annotation-free RL framework. By explicitly decoupling the optimization of perception and reasoning during the training process, it achieves isolation and optimization of both capabilities. Specifically, UniCAR-RL consists of three synergistic branches: 1) a Caption-RL branch that optimizes perception capabilities through verifier-guided reasoning validation; 2) a Reasoning-RL branch that performs logical reasoning based on a gold image description to halt cascading errors; 3) a QA-RL branch that retains native end-to-end alignment to ensure robust question-answering performance. Experiments show that UniCAR-RL substantially improves MLLMs' mathematical and visual reasoning using only raw short-answer data. Furthermore, it demonstrates strong generalization across diverse architectures and scales.

</details>


### [417] [Map Users and Mapmakers: The Scope of Cognitive Attribution from Acquired Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13879)
*Yiling Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个五部分归因表框架，用于界定表征获取所带来的认知扩展及其边界，区分追踪、应用、由显式规范获取、由识别性观察获取以及保持与重用五种能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 获取的表征可扩展系统的认知范围，却不必然转移产生该表征时所运用的能力。需要明确框架来区分这种扩展与其限度，避免将认知成就过度归因。

Method: 构建五部分归因表：(1)有效追踪；(2)已获结构的应用；(3)由显式规范获取；(4)由识别性观察获取；(5)保持与重用。每项均标明一个正面能力承诺及一个需额外支持的主张。论证有意承认有意义内容、因果效力和生成性推理。辅以地图与类别示例及简短形式证明（附录）。

Result: 地图与类别示例表明：即使具备完整的应用能力，获取能力仍未被确定；由描述获得标准与从示例中发现标准不同。该框架应用于Othello-GPT的世界模型解释及当代机器概念讨论中的具体指标，保留了已证实的识别、分类、推理与有条件的获取，同时指出标准发现与积累方面尚未确立之处。

Conclusion: 结论关乎认知归因的范围，而非概念拥有的构成条件：认知成就应因其确立的能力而获得认可，而不应通过所贴标签悄然引入更广的能力库。

Abstract: An acquired representation can enlarge a system's cognitive repertoire without transferring the capacities exercised in producing that representation. This paper develops a framework for specifying that enlargement and its limits. Its central contribution is a five-part attribution table distinguishing effective tracking, application of acquired structures, acquisition from explicit specifications, acquisition from identifying observations, and retention and reuse. Each entry identifies a positive capacity commitment and a further claim requiring additional support. The argument deliberately grants meaningful content, causal efficacy, and productive inference, so that its conclusion does not depend on treating representations as inert encodings. Map and category examples show why even complete application competence leaves acquisition capacity undetermined, and why acquiring a criterion from its description differs from finding it in examples. Short formal proofs appear in an appendix. The framework is applied to Andrew Ng's world-model interpretation of Othello-GPT and to the specific indicators discussed in contemporary accounts of machine concepts. It preserves demonstrated recognition, classification, inference, and qualified acquisition while specifying what remains unestablished about criterion discovery and accumulation. The result concerns the scope of cognitive attribution rather than the constitutive conditions of concept possession: cognitive achievements deserve credit for the capacities they establish, without silently importing a broader repertoire through the labels attached to them.

</details>


### [418] [LoRA Fine-Tuned Models for Control Systems Course Q\&A: A Multidimensional Evaluation of Model Scale and Rank Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13918)
*Shaowen Lu,Chengxu Liu,Ping Zhou,Tao Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct应用LoRA微调，用360条控制系统课程的师生对话数据，比较不同秩(r=4,8,16)对答案相似度和结构化输出稳定性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用LLM在专业课程(如控制系统)中回答缺乏统一术语、推导和分步结构，难以验证；需使开源指令模型更贴近课程参考答案的语言与教学组织。

Method: 构建360条系统-用户-助手对话的监督微调数据集；对Qwen2.5-3B和7B-Instruct应用LoRA，测试r=4/8/16；在相同数据划分与推理设置下，用ROUGE、BERTScore及结构化输出特征评估，并用Bootstrap重采样检验显著性。

Result: LoRA在两种规模上均提升相似度和结构化输出稳定性；7B-r16取得最高ROUGE-L(0.4093)和BERTScore-F1(0.8643)，r=8在性能与参数效率间更均衡；3B-r16的ROUGE-L增益0.0764[0.0613,0.0915]，7B-r16为0.0874[0.0687,0.1042]，均显著大于零。

Conclusion: LoRA可使开源指令模型更好地对齐课程参考答案的语言与教学组织；但指标主要反映文本相似度和格式一致性，无法衡量领域推理与数学正确性，仍需专家评估和任务特定评分标准。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in specialized university courses, but control-systems questions require coordinated terminology, notation, derivations, and stepwise explanations. Direct general-purpose responses may be inconsistently structured and hard to verify. Using exercises and reference solutions from a Linear Control Systems course, we built a supervised fine-tuning dataset of 360 system-user-assistant conversations. We applied LoRA to Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. With identical data splits, inference settings, and evaluation protocols, we compared base and fine-tuned models and tested LoRA ranks r=4, 8, and 16. Evaluation used ROUGE, BERTScore, and structured-output features to measure reference-answer similarity and stability of the Solution-Method-Teaching Points format. LoRA improved both similarity and structured-output stability at both sizes. On the current test set, 7B-r16 achieved the highest ROUGE-L (0.4093) and BERTScore-F1 (0.8643), while r=8 offered a better balance between performance and parameter efficiency. Bootstrap resampling showed ROUGE-L gains of 0.0764 [0.0613, 0.0915] for 3B-r16 and 0.0874 [0.0687, 0.1042] for 7B-r16; both intervals exceeded zero, indicating stable textual-similarity improvements on the current test set. These results suggest LoRA can align open-source instruction-tuned models more closely with the language and pedagogical organization of course reference answers. However, the metrics mainly capture textual similarity and formatting consistency, not domain-specific reasoning or mathematical correctness, which require expert assessment and task-specific rubrics.

</details>


### [419] [SAILOR: Solver-Assisted Interactive LLM-based Optimization Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13945)
*Shaghayegh Sadeghi,Stephen L. Smith,David C. Del Rey Fern'andez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAILOR系统检测自然语言优化问题中缺失的数值信息，通过提问补全后更新模型求解，在7个基准1,723实例上精确目标值一致率27.0%–87.6%，平均每个实例需1.4–5.7个问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言描述的优化问题常对求解器所需的成本、容量、需求、边界和惩罚等数值信息不完整或模糊。语言模型可翻译为代码，但当数值缺失时必须中止或猜测，缺乏系统性处理机制。

Method: SAILOR作为概念验证系统：检测不支持的数值选择，向用户提出针对性追问，并在返回解之前更新优化模型。问题优先级通过不确定性及求解器推导出的缺失值对当前模型影响程度评估来确定。

Result: 在7个掩码基准的1,723个实例上，使用返回真实值的理想化模拟器评估，精确目标值一致率为27.0%–87.6%，平均每个实例1.4–5.7个问题。

Conclusion: 结果证明了在受控的分支-揭示反馈下该方法的可行性；但未衡量与真实用户的交互表现或一般的结构模型修复。代码已开源。

Abstract: Natural-language descriptions of optimization problems may be incomplete or vague about numerical information that a solver requires, including costs, capacities, demands, bounds, and penalties. A language model can translate the description into code, but when a required value is absent it must either stop or guess. We present SAILOR, a proof-of-concept system that detects such unsupported numerical choices, asks the user targeted follow-up questions, and updates the optimization model before returning a solution. Questions are prioritized using uncertainty and solver-derived estimates of how strongly each missing value affects the current model. We evaluate the pipeline on 1,723 instances from seven masked benchmarks using an idealized simulator that returns ground-truth values. Exact objective-value agreement ranges from 27.0% to 87.6% across datasets, with 1.4--5.7 questions per instance on average. These results establish feasibility under controlled branch-and-reveal feedback; they do not measure performance with human users or general structural model repair. Code is available at: https://github.com/sshaghayeghs/SAILOR.

</details>


### [420] [Synthetic Data in Marketing Research: How to Evaluate and When to Trust](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13995)
*Oded Netzer,Rajan Sambandam*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文主张合成数据的关键问题不是"是否有效"而是"何时有效"，通过区分三类合成数据、四类准确性度量与提出"被遗忘问题"场景及事前可答性诊断，验证其在个体层面预测的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有营销研究中关于合成数据的争论两极化：一方认为LLM使真人被试过时，另一方主张完全弃用。作者认为两者都回避了更有意义的问题——合成数据何时有效。

Method: 1）区分三类合成数据：无依据LLM回答、群体级persona、个体级digital twin，并对应可支持的决策；2）建立四类准确性度量分类体系；3）提出"被遗忘问题"（现场研究遗漏某问题）场景用于twin增强；4）提出无需真值的事前可答性诊断：用随机森林从构建twin的数据预测twin输出的R²。

Result: 在108个态度问题（全国代表性调查，N=3,063）上，以R²>0.7筛选使twin与人类个体层面平均相关性提升15%，差答问题比例从25.9%降至4.3%。嵌入相似度与资深研究者判断提供相关但更弱的筛选信号。

Conclusion: 合成数据的价值取决于使用场景与度量方式；聚合度量常掩盖个体层面差异缺失。提出的R²事前诊断可无需真值地筛选适用问题，显著提升twin增强效果。

Abstract: Debate over synthetic data in marketing research has polarized between claims that large language models (LLMs) make human respondents obsolete and calls to avoid them entirely. We argue that both positions obscure the more useful question: not whether synthetic respondents work, but when. Building on Brand, Israeli, and Ngwe (2026), we make three contributions. First, we distinguish three types of synthetic data (ungrounded LLM responses, segment-level personas, and individual-level digital twins) and map each to the decisions it can support. Second, we develop a taxonomy of four families of accuracy measures and suggest that the wide range of reported twin accuracy, from near-perfect to near-chance, largely reflects differences in what is being measured rather than in method quality. Aggregate measures often perform well even when little information is supplied to the LLM, and can mask a complete absence of respondent-level differentiation. Third, we introduce the forgotten question problem, in which a question is omitted from a fielded study, as a setting for twin-based augmentation of existing data. We propose an ex-ante answerability diagnostic that requires no ground truth: the R^2 of a random forest predicting twin outputs from the data used to construct the twins. Across 108 attitude questions from a nationally representative survey (N = 3,063), screening at R^2 above 0.7 raises the mean twin-human individual-level correlation by 15% and reduces the share of poorly answered questions from 25.9% to 4.3%. Embedding similarity and experienced-researcher judgment provide correlated but weaker screens.

</details>


### [421] [Convergent Emergence of In-Context Learning Across Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14011)
*Nathan Breslow,Seungwook Han,Daniel Hyunsoo Lee,Aayush Mishra,Anqi Liu,Daniel Khashabi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出跨模态受控框架，检验"趋同涌现假说"：少样本ICL若涌现，则在不同模态间共享一致的难度分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少样本ICL已在语言模型和最近的基因组自回归模型中出现，作者想探究ICL是否跨领域普遍涌现，以及是否共享共同结构。

Method: 构建受控跨模态框架，在六种模态（语言、基因组、整数序列、时间序列、图像、蛋白质）中实例化同一任务套件，测试配对映射ICL的涌现及任务间相关性。

Result: 配对映射ICL在六种模态中均涌现并超越受控基线，其中五种模态呈现任务级效应的相关性。

Conclusion: 结果部分支持趋同涌现假说，但并非所有模态都符合。

Abstract: Few-shot in-context learning (ICL), the capacity of a model to infer abstract patterns from input-output examples provided in its prompt and apply them to new inputs, has been extensively studied in large language models trained for next-token prediction on human text. Recently, few-shot ICL has been demonstrated in autoregressive genomic models as well. This raises a question: does ICL emerge broadly across domains, and if so, what common structure is shared?
  To address both, we develop a controlled cross-modality framework that instantiates the same task suite in a variety of modalities to test what we call the Convergent Emergence Hypothesis: the idea that few-shot ICL, when it emerges, shares a common cross-modality difficulty profile - i.e., tasks that benefit from ICL in one modality tend to benefit in others. We show that paired-mapping ICL emerges across six modalities (language, genome, integer sequences, time series, images, and proteins), surpasses controlled baselines, and has correlated per-task effects across five of them. Together, these results provide support for the Convergent Emergence Hypothesis in some modalities, but not all.

</details>


### [422] [Schizophrenia Detection from EEG Signals: A Transformer Framework with Spectrogram Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14015)
*Abtin Shafiei,Mohsen Hooshmand,Majid Ramezani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于EEG的脑电时频图像分类框架，用STFT生成谱图，结合传统机器学习与深度学习模型（含CNN-Transformer混合），在受试者级划分下实现精神分裂症自动检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精神分裂症诊断主要依赖临床评估；现有EEG分类研究存在数据集小、预处理策略不一致、评估协议未充分防止受试者相关数据泄漏等局限。

Method: 将预处理后的EEG记录通过短时傅里叶变换（STFT）转换为时频表示（谱图图像）；使用传统机器学习算法（SVM、随机森林、XGBoost）以及深度学习模型（卷积架构、CNN-Transformer混合）进行分类；所有数据划分均在受试者级别进行以保障评估可靠性。

Result: 在独立测试集上取得有竞争力的分类性能：CNN-Transformer（CT-SZ）模型AUC-ROC为88.41%；CNN + Squeeze and Excitation + Transformer（CST-SZ）模型AUC-ROC为92.88%。

Conclusion: 基于STFT时频表示与CNN-Transformer混合模型的EEG分类框架能有效支持精神分裂症自动检测，且受试者级划分的评估协议更加可靠。

Abstract: Schizophrenia is a serious psychiatric disorder that affects millions of people worldwide, and its diagnosis remains primarily dependent on clinical assessment. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive approach to investigate brain activity and has shown potential to support automated Schizophrenia detection. However, existing EEG-based classification studies often suffer from limitations including small datasets, inconsistent preprocessing strategies, and evaluation protocols that may not adequately prevent subject-related data leakage. In this study, we propose an EEG-based Schizophrenia classification framework that transforms preprocessed EEG recordings into time-frequency representations using the Short-Time Fourier Transform. The generated spectrogram images are classified using both conventional Machine Learning algorithms, including Support Vector Machines, Random Forests, and XGBoost, and Deep Learning models, including convolutional architectures and CNN-Transformer hybrids. To ensure reliable evaluation, all data partitions are performed at the subject level. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves competitive classification performance, with the CNN-Transformer (CT-SZ) model achieving an AUC-ROC of 88.41% and the CNN + Squeeze and Excitation + Transformer (CST-SZ) achieving an AUC-ROC of 92.88% on the independent test set.

</details>


### [423] [VeriDx: Earning the Right to Diagnose with Disease-Centric Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14018)
*Zhong Cao,Shuying Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出VeriDx，一个以疾病为中心的验证框架，将自由形式的诊断推理链接到结构化疾病档案，追踪每个假设是否满足、未解决或违反了临床义务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前医学LLM评估多关注最终答案、局部步骤或孤立事实，忽略了疾病假设引发的"临床义务"（如检查关键证据、排除替代方案、解决矛盾等），因而无法发现那些"答案正确但推理过程有漏洞"的诊断错误。

Method: VeriDx为每个疾病假设建立临床义务清单，追踪其状态为满足、未解决或违反，从而暴露缺失关键检查、未解决鉴别诊断、忽视矛盾、无支撑论断和过早结论等失败模式。作者以复杂呼吸系统诊断为例，基于指南衍生的疾病档案和专家标注的纵向病例实例化该框架。

Result: 结果显示，许多诊断错误并非孤立失误，而是推理过程中早期做出的义务承诺被破坏所导致。

Conclusion: 应关注诊断推理中假设所引发的临床义务履行情况，而非仅评估最终答案，以更全面地揭示医学LLM的推理缺陷。

Abstract: A correct diagnosis can still be reached for the wrong reasons. In clinical reasoning, every disease hypothesis creates obligations: key evidence must be checked, alternatives must be ruled out, contradictions must be resolved, useful tests must be considered, and closure must be justified. Current evaluations of medical LLMs mostly focus on final answers, local steps, or isolated facts, and therefore miss these hypothesis-induced commitments. We introduce \textbf{VeriDx}, a disease-centric verification framework that links free-form diagnostic reasoning to structured disease profiles. VeriDx tracks whether each hypothesis is satisfied, unresolved, or violated its clinical obligations, exposing failures such as missing critical tests, unresolved differentials, ignored contradictions, unsupported claims, and premature closure. We instantiate VeriDx for complex respiratory diagnosis using guideline-derived disease profiles and expert-annotated longitudinal cases. Our results show that many diagnostic errors are not isolated mistakes, but broken commitments made earlier in the reasoning process.

</details>


### [424] [MOSCOPT: Mixture-of-Skills Collective Optimization for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14399)
*Zhenyu Zhang1,Jiudong Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MOSCOPT,一种文本原生、无参数的算法,联合优化技能池与门控技能,通过EditAdam三阶段交错更新实现单调提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提示与技能优化方法仅优化单一文本模板,忽略了多种互补策略之间的协同效应。

Method: MOSCOPT联合优化由N个技能构成的技能池与门控技能G(每步动态选择K个技能);为此构建内部维护双状态的EditAdam,采用三阶段交错更新,无需梯度或参数调优即可单调提升。

Result: 在5个基准和3个目标LLM上,实验与消融表明MOSCOPT持续优于所有基线;验证了技能混合(选择性激活)架构与三阶段交错协同进化对性能至关重要。

Conclusion: MOSCOPT通过技能混合与集体进化实现文本原生、参数无关的优化,代码已开源。

Abstract: Natural language prompts and skills serve as the strategic backbone of LLM-based agents. Recent advances in prompt and skill optimization have achieved notable gains, yet all existing methods optimize a \emph{single} text template---missing the synergy among multiple complementary strategies. We propose MOSCOPT, a text-native, parameter-free algorithm that jointly optimizes a pool of $N$ skills and a gating skill $G$ that dynamically selects $K$ skills per step. To effectively optimize the skills, we build the EditAdam with internally maintained dual states. Through the three-phase interleaved updates with EditAdam, the system monotonically improves without gradient or parameter tuning. Extensive experiments and detailed ablations across 5 benchmarks and 3 target LLMs demonstrate that MOSCOPT consistently outperforms all baselines, and confirm that both the mixture-of-skills architecture with selective activation and the collective evolution with three-phase interleaving are essential to its superior performance. Code is released https://github.com/zhangzhenyu13/SummerClaw/tree/master/summerclaw/agent_trainer/algorithms/moscopt.

</details>


### [425] [Dynamic Learning Solutions: A System for Personalized Educational Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14408)
*Siddhanth Sridhar,Shreya Chaurasia,Baddela Sai Yaswantha Reddy,Deepak Parmar,Shylaja S S*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个自动化流水线，将NCERT教材PDF转换为响应查询的交互式视频讲解，结合RAG与生成式多媒体组件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将静态教材转化为具吸引力的交互式数字教育内容，实现个性化、可扩展的学习体验。

Method: 用户上传PDF并提问；RAG模型针对NCERT教材结构优化，检索相关内容并生成含叙事讲解与结构化视觉提示的多场景脚本；提示经逐层实现的Stable Diffusion生成图像，再由DynamiCrafter生成动画序列；最后由Google TTS生成同步旁白。

Result: 输出整合动画、旁白与教材对齐视觉的连贯视频讲解，RAG在NCERT教材内容上表现最佳。

Conclusion: 融合多模态文档检索、生成式视觉模型、动画框架与语音合成，展示了一种可扩展的交互式个性化数字教育内容方案。

Abstract: We present an automated pipeline that converts NCERT textbooks into interactive video explanations that respond directly to user queries. A user uploads a PDF and asks a question; the system then generates a video-based explanation as output, handling both text and visual elements from the PDF for multi-modal retrieval and response generation. The pipeline combines a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) model with generative multimedia components. The RAG stage is optimized for the structure of NCERT textbooks and performs best on content from those books. Given a user query, the RAG model retrieves relevant content from the PDF and generates a multi-scene script containing narrative explanations and structured visual prompts aligned with the textbook's explanatory style. These prompts are passed to a Stable Diffusion module, implemented layer by layer for interpretability and control, which generates contextually relevant images. The images are then processed by DynamiCrafter to produce animated sequences. Finally, a Google Text-to-Speech module generates synchronized narration, aligning speech with the visual scenes through time-based control. The result is a coherent video explanation integrating animation, narration, and textbook-aligned visuals, transforming static educational material into an engaging learning experience. By combining multi-modal document retrieval, generative visual models, animation frameworks, and speech synthesis, this pipeline demonstrates a scalable approach to delivering interactive, personalized digital education content.

</details>


### [426] [Safety Signals to Verify NetOps Agents with Action-Level Granularity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14422)
*Tobias Labarta,Frederik Pahde,Novak Boskov,Maximilian Dreyer,David Birkenberger,Manzoor Ahmed Khan,Sebastian Lapuschkin,Wojciech Samek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文为NetArena网络修复任务构建了逐动作的ground truth（通过符号推演验证），并据此定义progress与harm两个执行前目标，发现基于内部信号的agent verifier比仅用可观测信号的基线更能可靠预测两者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic NetOps有望实现自主网络，但其长期可靠性是关键瓶颈。在数据中心网络中，agent需在响应告警的同时避免高风险动作，而"回避高风险动作"需要预知动作影响，这要求逐动作ground truth，但现有NetOps agent基准并不提供。

Method: 针对NetArena的网络修复任务构建逐动作ground truth：对仿真网络进行符号化replay，并在每步与环境校验，从而得到每个动作的精确价值。由此推导两个执行前目标——动作是否缩短修复距离（progress）及是否增大修复距离（harm）。在10个agent模型上比较基于内部信号的verifier与仅用可观测信号的基线。

Result: 跨10个agent模型，利用内部信号的agent verifier在预测harm和progress上均比仅用可观测信号的基线更可靠。

Conclusion: 这些内部信号有望作为安全反馈接入agent harness，使其回避高风险动作并保护目标系统。

Abstract: Agentic Network Operations (NetOps) are an emerging paradigm promising to enable workload-aware, self-adjustable, and reliable autonomous networks. While agents have proven their value in incident summarization and telemetry signal extraction, their effectiveness as autonomous control-loop engines heavily relies on their long-horizon reliability. One such setting is the datacenter fabric, where an agent must respond to alarms and operator intents while abstaining from high-risk actions that may cause or extend downtime. Abstention, however, presupposes that an action's impact is known pre-execution, which necessitates a per-action ground truth that NetOps agent benchmarks do not provide. We construct such a ground truth for the network repair task of NetArena. A symbolic replay of the emulated network, validated against the environment at every turn, yields the exact value of every action. From the action-level value, we derive two pre-execution targets, namely whether an action reduces the repair distance (progress) and whether it increases it (harm). We show across 10 agent models, that agent verifiers leveraging internal signals predict both harm and progress more reliably than a baseline using observable signals only. Perspectively, we aim to use these signals as safety feedback to an agent harness to abstain from risky actions and protect the target system.

</details>


### [427] [When does a scaling result justify a different allocation? A critical review of resource-allocation evidence for AI systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14500)
*Seyed Morteza Emadi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇批判性整合综述，探讨AI扩展（scaling）研究中的评估结果何时能真正支持资源分配决策，而非仅反映某一预算下的分数提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI扩展研究越来越多地评估"预训练模型+检索、搜索、验证、工具与交互"的复合系统，但在更大预算下取得更高分数，并不能说明额外资源应投放在哪里，即无法直接支持资源分配决策。

Method: 整合比较预训练、测试时计算、检索与智能体评估四方面的证据，区分"被测试流程的性能"与"资源限制下可达到的最优性能"；提出"能力曲面"（将性能表示为预算、机制与可得信息的函数）和"资源包络"（记录任务、开发与运行资源、信息获取与流程），并通过解析示例和已发表对比案例加以说明。

Result: 识别出三类反复出现的错配：在答案选定前即计成功、纳入部署系统实际不具备的信息、以及成本被排除在比较之外；并通过示例表明评估指标、部署规模、选择规则与停止策略都可能改变分配结论。

Conclusion: 该框架明确了在可行系统间做选择所需的比较，并推动关于分配规则跨任务与运行条件迁移的实验；但作者强调其不提出普适的扩展定律，也不从基准提升推断通用智能。

Abstract: AI scaling studies increasingly evaluate systems that combine a pretrained model with retrieval, search, verification, tools, and interaction. Yet a higher score under a larger budget does not by itself show where additional resources are best spent. This critical integrative review asks when a reported scaling result supports a resource-allocation decision. It compares evidence across pretraining, test-time computation, retrieval, and agent evaluation, distinguishing the performance of a tested procedure from the best performance achievable under a resource limit. The synthesis shows that three mismatches recur across this evidence: success counted before an answer is chosen, information a deployed system will not have, and costs left out of the comparison. A capability surface expresses performance as a function of budgets, mechanisms, and available information. Worked analytical examples show how the evaluation metric, deployment volume, selection rule, and stopping policy can alter an allocation conclusion. A resource envelope provides a structured record of the task, development and run-time resources, information access, and procedure behind a reported score. Its application to a published comparison illustrates which conclusions the evidence supports and which deployment questions remain unresolved. The resulting framework specifies the comparisons needed to choose among feasible systems and motivates experiments on the transfer of allocation rules across tasks and operating conditions. It does not propose a universal scaling law or infer general intelligence from benchmark gains.

</details>


### [428] [Beyond Scene Description: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Non-visual Access to Virtual Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14512)
*Toqeer Ali Syed,Ali Akarma,Adeel Ahmad,Danial Hameed*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 MetaBlind 架构，用八个专门智能体加一个无障碍编排器，将虚拟世界中的非视觉信息按需筛选后分发给盲人用户，目前仅为设计阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚拟世界中的课堂、会议、社交等场景默认用户能看三维场景和浮动面板，而现有视障辅助工具只能孤立解决单一任务。真实虚拟房间中障碍、发言者、手势、聊天、幻灯片、通知同时出现，若全部朗读则把视觉障碍换成听觉障碍。

Method: 将非视觉访问能力分配到八个智能体（感知、导航、社交与物体交互、通信、安全与信任、记忆、个性化等）。智能体不直接对用户说话，而是把候选信息发布到共享无障碍上下文中。编排器按安全性、目标相关性、紧迫性、置信度、用户相关性、预估听觉负载评分，仅释放当下相关的信息，通过语音、结构化音频或触觉输出。论文给出选择问题的形式化描述、编排循环算法，以及针对单智能体助手的评估方案。

Result: 无原型测量或用户研究，仅完成设计阶段论述；评估方案说明了哪些结果支持该设计、哪些结果可推翻该设计。

Conclusion: MetaBlind 通过多智能体加编排器的分层设计，试图在虚拟世界中用有限听觉带宽传递最相关信息；其有效性尚待未来原型与用户实验验证。
