Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"损失条件状态执行"(loss-conditioned state execution)，一种模型无关方法，用于决定是否执行世界模型的可行提议或保持当前状态，并在预测基准上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅凭预测信息性无法判定更新是否降低下游损失：事件排序可能近乎完美，但"保持状态"仍是唯一的绝对损失贝叶斯动作；两个转移律可共享发生信息与条件方差却需要相反的绝对损失决策。因此需将"事件可预测性"与"状态执行"分开评估。

Method: 形式化"状态可移动性"为存在可降低损失的可行修正，并区别于特定提议的收益。从预测分布构建损失特定的可行提议，在独立校准单元上评估其相对保持状态的分组有界损失增益；仅当分组的同时下置信界为正时执行提议。对固定提议与有界单元损失，可证明校准单元i.i.d.时每个被接受分组的期望损失以高概率低于保持状态。

Result: 在公共预测与动作条件动力学基准上显示更新有支撑及认证-覆盖权衡。M4 Monthly 28,684条留出序列上，方法对14.0%序列执行提议，有界损失0.588，优于保持状态的0.599与总是执行的0.621；两组配对的95% bootstrap区间均低于零。在京东六类不良库存约束预测中，强事件排序信号与基于损失的保持状态偏好并存。

Conclusion: 事件可预测性与状态执行必须分别评估；所提方法能提供有认证保障的状态更新决策，并揭示认证与覆盖之间的权衡。

Abstract: We introduce loss-conditioned state execution, a model-agnostic method that decides whether to execute a world model's fixed feasible proposal or retain the current state. Predictive informativeness alone, however, does not establish whether an update will reduce downstream loss. Occurrence ranking can approach perfection while persistence remains the unique absolute-loss Bayes action. Two transition laws can also share occurrence information and conditional variance yet require opposite absolute-loss decisions. We formalize state movability as the existence of a loss-reducing feasible correction and distinguish it from the benefit of a particular proposal. Our method constructs a loss-specific feasible proposal from a predictive distribution and evaluates its groupwise bounded-loss gain over persistence on independent calibration units. The proposal is executed only in groups with a positive simultaneous lower confidence bound. For fixed proposals and groups with bounded unit losses, we prove that every accepted group has lower expected loss than persistence with high probability when calibration units are i.i.d. draws from the target population. Experiments on public forecasting and action-conditioned dynamics benchmarks show supported updates and a trade-off between certification and coverage. On 28,684 held-out M4 Monthly series, the method executes the proposal for 14.0% of series and achieves bounded loss 0.588, compared with 0.599 for persistence and 0.621 for always executing the proposal. The paired 95% bootstrap intervals for both comparisons lie below zero. In constrained forecasting of six unhealthy-inventory types from JD$\mbox{.}$com, a leading e-retailer in China, strong occurrence-ranking signal coexists with a loss-based preference for persistence, illustrating why event predictability and state execution must be evaluated separately.

</details>


### [501] [Atria Dawn: The Dawn of Agentic Superintelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15818)
*Honglin Guo,Tao Gui,Yicheng Chen,Guanting Dong,Qiming Ge,Yuyang Hu,Zixian Huang,Jiajie Jin,Alexander Lam,Yining Li,Jiahang Lin,Yanjiang Liu,Xinyu Lu,Haijun Lv,Junlin Shang,Qisheng Su,Guoqiang Wang,Rui Wang,Zhecan Wang,Hao Xiang,Xinchen Xie,Shuhao Xing,Xiaoyu Xing,Wanghan Xu,Xinyu Yang,Yajie Yang,Chengfeng Zhao,Haoran Zhao,Ruojun Zhou,Yunhua Zhou,Yicheng Zou,Kun Cai,Qiye Cai,Xinmeng Che,Haodong Chen,Jiabei Chen,Jiahao Chen,Jiayi Chen,Yujia Chen,Lizhi Cui,Youheng Dai,Xin Deng,Yi Dong,Shihan Dou,Chenya Gu,Xu Guo,Ding Han,Feiyang Hao,Haotan He,Jie Hou,Binze Hu,Zijian Hu,Junhao Huang,Huicheng Jiang,Jiazhen Jiang,Shufan Jiang,Jiahao Kuang,Bowen Lai,Bo Li,Jiaqiang Li,Peng Li,Qilong Li,Zhuoqun Li,Jiaxiang Liu,Shuainan Liu,Tong Liu,Yi Liu,Zhonghang Lu,Jianwen Luo,Yanyi Luo,Huijie Lv,Ningsheng Ma,Zerun Ma,Houcheng Min,Chengjun Pan,Qiyuan Peng,Xiaoxuan Peng,Jianmin Qian,Jiantao Qiu,Wanying Ren,Huayu Sha,Jifei Shan,Zixin Shang,Bing Shao,Zhuohui Sheng,Jiayang Shi,Yang Shu,Aierpanjiang Simayi,Sirui Song,Yuxiao Song,Zhe Sun,Zhichao Sun,Wenzhe Tan,Wenhui Tian,Zhongbo Tian,Hanchen Wang,Pengbo Wang,Rui Wang,Yiding Wang,Yuhui Wang,Zhiheng Xi,Caijun Xu,Chao Xu,Yongfeng Xu,Xiaolei Yang,Zhixiong Yang,Qian Yao,Shihong Yi,Yuankai Ying,Jia Yu,Dingbo Yuan,Hao Yuan,Junjie Yuan,Bo Zhang,Caixian Zhang,Qiuyinzhe Zhang,Jiyuan Zhao,Penghao Zhao,Ying Zhao,Pujun Zheng,Xiaoxue Zhong,Xiaohao Zhou,Xinyu Zhou,Dongsheng Zhu,Guanru Zhu,Yulun Zhu,Yaojie Lu,Tao Ji,Hongyu Lin,Yutao Zhu,Pengfei Cao,Guoxiu He,Xianpei Han,Ben He,Zhicheng Dou,Kang Liu,Qi Zhang,Le Sun,Jun Zhao,Ji-Rong Wen,Xuanjing Huang,Yu-Gang Jiang,Bowen Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 介绍了Atria Dawn Preview——一个面向科研与工程工作流的基础智能体语言模型，通过可验证经验管线训练，在16个基准中5项取得最高分；并以该模型研发过程为案例，分析769条任务记录与智能体日志，揭示人机协作正从任务级执行转向项目级伙伴关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI智能体参与到其继任者的开发中，智能的生产方式与人类研究者的角色都在被重塑。作者希望拓展真实世界中智能体生产力的边界，并理解人类与AI在研发中的实际协作模式。

Method: 提出Atria Dawn Preview基础智能体语言模型，采用Verifiable Experience Pipeline训练，将工具介导的交互与可执行环境及外部验证的结果相连接；并在16个真实科研、工程与数字工作基准上评测。同时以该模型自身研发过程为案例，分析56名参与者的769条任务记录及智能体日志。

Result: 在16个基准中与前沿智能体相当，并在其中5项取得已报告的最高分。评估中参与者认为约三分之一的AI辅助完成任务在无AI情况下不可行；智能体常提出方法并实施修改，而人类保留多数最终决策并通过判断与反馈引导探索。

Conclusion: 人机协作正从任务级执行转向项目级伙伴关系，人类精力集中于"什么值得做"及证据如何引导研究。走向更自主的AI研究不仅要提升发现能力，也需提升有意义的人类监督能力，保留人类对持续开发风险与方向的问责权威。

Abstract: As AI agents become participants in the development of their successors, they reshape both the production of intelligence and the role of human researchers. We introduce Atria Dawn Preview, a foundation agentic language model designed for scientific research and engineering workflows, with the goal of expanding the frontier of agent productivity in the real world. This model is trained via a Verifiable Experience Pipeline that connects tool-mediated interactions to executable environments and externally verified outcomes. Across 16 benchmarks spanning real-world research, engineering, and digital work, Atria Dawn Preview is competitive with frontier agents and achieves the highest reported score on five of them. Beyond standalone performance, we examine the real research-and-development process behind this model as a case study of human--AI collaboration, analyzing 769 task records from 56 participants together with agent logs. When asked to evaluate completed tasks under comparable conditions, participants rated about one-third of completed AI-assisted tasks as infeasible without AI. More strikingly, agents frequently propose methods and implement revisions, while humans retain most final decisions and guide exploration through judgment and feedback. These observations indicate a shift from task-level execution to project-level partnership, with human effort concentrating on what is worth pursuing and how evidence should guide research. Progress toward more autonomous AI research must therefore advance both the capacity for discovery and the capacity for meaningful human oversight, preserving accountable human authority over the risks and direction of continued development.

</details>


### [502] [AlgoEvo: Self-Evolving Agentic Search for Automated Algorithm Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15820)
*Junhao Qiu,Qinglong Hu,Xialiang Tong,Mingxuan Yuan,Liyong Lin,Qingfu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 AlgoEvo，一个将自动化算法发现转化为交互式、知识积累过程的统一智能体框架，突破传统刚性搜索流程限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型驱动的算法发现框架受限于预定义控制流的刚性搜索流程，限制了自适应推理、跨范式迁移，并丢弃了有价值的执行反馈。

Method: 自主智能体基于运行时反馈动态检查、诊断和编辑代码；设计技能中心将范式特定知识与核心发现引擎解耦，统一处理单目标、多目标与多组件设计；分层经验机制将搜索轨迹组织为任务级树并提炼跨任务可复用技能。

Result: 在六个代表性基准任务上，AlgoEvo 以显著更少的评估次数和更低的 token 消耗，匹敌或超越专用方法，展现出任务内积累、跨任务迁移，以及通过灵活技能激活重现或超越现有最优性能的能力。

Conclusion: AlgoEvo 通过统一智能体框架实现了高效、可迁移的自动化算法发现，验证了知识积累与技能复用范式的有效性。

Abstract: Large language models have advanced automated algorithm discovery by synthesizing executable code, but existing frameworks trap them in rigid search pipelines with pre-defined control flows. This limitation restricts adaptive reasoning, blocks cross-paradigm transfer, and discards valuable execution feedback. We propose AlgoEvo, a unified agentic framework that transforms automated algorithm discovery into an interactive, knowledge-accumulating process. An autonomous agent dynamically inspects, diagnoses, and edits code based on runtime feedback. A design skill hub decouples paradigm-specific knowledge from the core discovery engine, allowing a single workflow to seamlessly handle single-objective, multi-objective, and multi-component design. Meanwhile, a hierarchical experience mechanism organizes search trajectories into a task-level tree to guide exploration and consolidates cross-task patterns into reusable skills. Across six representative benchmark tasks, AlgoEvo matches or surpasses specialized methods with substantially fewer evaluations and reduced token consumption, demonstrating strong intra-task accumulation, cross-task transfer, and the ability to reproduce or exceed existing state-of-the-art performance through flexible skill activation.

</details>


### [503] [LongAgent: History-Guided Agentic Search for Longitudinal Outcome Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15859)
*Siyao Wang,Florian Guitton,Shuojie Fu,Guanyu Tao,Kai Sun,Wenjia Bai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LongAgent是一种基于智能体的方法，可自主搜索变量集、时间窗口和纵向聚合函数组合，从纵向医疗数据中提取有预测价值的表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学纵向数据高度异质，变量来源多、采样间隔不同、反映不同健康维度，识别有预测价值的变量、处理纵向信息并整合多变量进行结果预测仍具挑战。

Method: 提出智能体方法LongAgent，自主搜索变量集组合、时间窗口与纵向聚合函数，并利用历史搜索记忆与数值证据指导后续探索。

Result: 合成数据上平均预测RMSE为1.7376，优于最强非智能体基线0.0151（95% CI: [0.0045,0.0260]; p=0.0273）；真实临床数据集上与最佳基线表现相当。

Conclusion: LongAgent能有效自主探索纵向数据的预测表示，在合成数据上显著优于基线，在真实临床数据上具竞争力。

Abstract: Extracting informative representations from longitudinal data that can predict future outcomes remains a critical challenge in medicine. Medical datasets are inherently heterogeneous, consisting of a large number of variables collected from different sources, sampled with different temporal spacings, and representing different aspects of human health status. This requires identifying those variables with predictive value, processing longitudinal information, and integrating multiple variables for outcome prediction. Here, we propose a novel agent-based approach, LongAgent, that can autonomously search over combinations of variable sets, temporal windows and longitudinal aggregation functions, and identify candidates with promising predictive performance. LongAgent utilises a history memory of previous searches and numerical evidence to guide subsequent exploration. On synthetic data, LongAgent achieves a mean prediction RMSE of 1.7376 and improves over the strongest non-agent baseline by 0.0151 (95% CI: [0.0045,0.0260]; p=0.0273). On a real clinical dataset, it performs comparably to the best baseline.

</details>


### [504] [Pilot Early, Commit Late: A Real-Options Model of Enterprise AI Adoption under Rapid Technological Progress](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15919)
*Gaurav Tewari*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文构建两期不确定性下的AI部署时机决策模型，区分立即部署、试点与等待，给出五个核心时机结果及一个学习位置比较结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI技术前沿快速进步、实施部分不可逆，且组织专属能力需通过行动积累，企业面临特殊的时机决策问题：立即部署、试点还是等待。

Method: 建立两期决策模型：立即部署获得当期运营价值但面临架构过时风险；等待保留观察前沿后的采纳期权；试点牺牲当期运营价值以构建组织专属学习而不完全承诺。并给出连续时间扩展。

Result: 均值保持的前沿不确定性上升提高等待与试点价值、不影响立即部署（当收益对前沿仿射时）；更快的预期前沿进展在架构仅捕获有限未来改进时会降低立即部署相对吸引力；试点优于等待当且仅当所建能力的期望价值超过其成本；足够有价值的组织专属学习产生"早试点、晚承诺"最优区域；存在闭式模块化阈值使立即部署优于最佳外部选项；生产学习与试点专属学习对时机边际影响不同。连续时间扩展中，不确定性提高采纳阈值，而能力与模块化降低阈值。

Conclusion: 论文将部署、实验与等待三者分离，说明为何快速进步可理性地增加实验却不足以证成不可逆承诺。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence presents firms with an unusual timing problem. The technology frontier is improving rapidly, implementation is partly irreversible, and organization-specific capabilities are accumulated through action. This paper develops a two-period decision model of AI deployment under uncertainty in which a firm chooses among immediate deployment, a limited pilot, and waiting. Deployment earns current operating value but exposes the firm to architectural obsolescence; waiting preserves the option to adopt after the frontier is observed; a pilot sacrifices current operating value to build organization-specific learning without full commitment. The model yields five central timing results and a sixth comparative result on where learning occurs. First, a mean-preserving increase in frontier uncertainty raises the value of waiting and piloting but leaves immediate deployment unchanged when its payoff is affine in the frontier. Second, faster expected frontier progress can reduce the relative attractiveness of immediate deployment when deployed architecture captures only a limited share of future improvement. Third, a pilot dominates waiting exactly when the expected value of the capability it builds exceeds its cost. Fourth, sufficiently valuable organization-specific learning creates a nonempty region in which "pilot early, commit late" is optimal. Fifth, there is a closed-form modularity threshold above which immediate deployment dominates the best outside option. Sixth, production learning and pilot-specific learning affect the timing margin differently. A continuous-time extension recovers the standard result that uncertainty raises the adoption threshold while capability and modularity lower it. The paper separates deploying, experimenting, and waiting, and shows why rapid progress can rationally increase experimentation without justifying irreversible commitment.

</details>


### [505] [Recurrent GraphNeural NetworkswithSet-BasedAggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15932)
*Blai Bonet*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究基于集合聚合的循环GNN，给出可从权重检验的充分条件，实现网络与BΣ^∘_1片段的双向等价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有循环GNN的逻辑刻画依赖多重集聚合、计数逻辑及无法从参数验证的停机/接受条件，缺乏可检验性。

Method: 采用集合聚合的循环GNN，识别可从权重检验的充分条件，将网络编译为公式、公式编译为网络。

Result: 证明一类网络与模态μ演算片段BΣ^∘_1（可达性与安全性性质的布尔闭包）有效双向等价；该片段恰为有限词汇上稳定化的精确表达层级，支持单一极性的不动点及其布尔组合，但不支持相反极性不动点复合。

Conclusion: 该对应无需计数逻辑、外部停机信号或非有效接受条件，为满足条件的网络提供了从权重到符号解释的可验证路径。

Abstract: Recurrent GNNs iterate message passing to convergence, and their logical characterizations to date rely on multi-set aggregation, graded (counting) logics, and halting or acceptance conditions that cannot be verified from the network's parameters. We study recurrent GNNs with set-based aggregation and identify sufficient conditions checkable from the weights for networks to compile into formulas and formulas into networks. The main result is an effective, two-directional equivalence between a class of networks and the Boolean closure of reachability and safety properties, the fragment B$Σ^{\circ}_1$ of the modal $μ$-calculus. The fragment is not an artifact: it is the exact expressive level of stabilization over finite vocabulary, which supports fixed points of a single polarity and Boolean combinations thereof, but not the composition of fixed points of opposite polarities. The correspondence needs no counting logic, no external halting signal, and no non-effective acceptance condition, yielding a verifiable path from weights to symbolic explanations for networks meeting the conditions.

</details>


### [506] [Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15983)
*Honghao Lin,David P. Woodruff,Yuan Deng,Jieming Mao,Song Zuo,Vahab Mirrokni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Colosseum，一个模型无关的推理框架，用于在数学与理论计算机科学的长期研究问题上分配推理资源，通过策略探索、准备度门控、子问题分解与验证反馈，结合并行候选生成与树聚合，在 TCS-Bench 上达到 71.0% 准确率，并用执行反馈解决 Codeforces 222 题中的 218 题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型能生成看似合理的短证明，但在长周期研究问题上仍不可靠，因为进展依赖一系列不确定且相互依赖的决策。需要一种能跨阶段分配推理、管理不确定性的框架。

Method: Colosseum 在证明构造前探索多种策略；用 readiness gate 判断某路线是否成熟到可分解；将证明计划表示为相互依赖的章节级子问题；把验证器发现路由回论证的受影响部分。各阶段并行生成候选、用针对性证伪进行攻击，并通过重叠随机样本树聚合将候选及其批评合并为单一研究产物。该流程已作为 Long Proof 模式集成到 Google Antigravity 的 Teamwork 框架。

Result: 使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro，在 FOCS、JMLR 等顶会论文的开放问题上取得新结果；在 TCS-Bench 上，用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 与 Gemini 3.7 Flash 达到 71.0% 准确率；在 Codeforces 评测中，带执行反馈的证明导向流程解决 222 题中的 218 题。

Conclusion: Colosseum 是一个模型无关的框架，能有效提升语言模型在长期数学与理论计算机科学研究问题上的可靠性与表现，并展现出在开放研究和基准测试中的强能力。

Abstract: Language models can produce plausible short proofs, but may still be unreliable on long-horizon research problems, where progress depends on a sequence of uncertain and interdependent decisions. We introduce Stellar Colosseum, a model-agnostic harness for allocating inference across research in mathematics and theoretical computer science. Colosseum explores alternative strategies before proof construction, uses a readiness gate to decide when a route is mature enough to decompose, represents the proof plan as interdependent section-level subproblems, and routes verifier findings back to the affected part of the argument. Across these stages, it generates candidates in parallel, attacks them with targeted falsification, and combines candidates and their critiques into a single research artifact through overlapping random-sample tree aggregation. The Colosseum workflow has also been integrated into Google Antigravity's Teamwork framework as the Long Proof pattern.
  We demonstrate the capabilities of Colosseum through open-ended research and evaluations on theorem-proving and competitive programming benchmarks. Using Colosseum with Gemini 3.1 Pro, we obtain several new results that address open problems arising from papers published at top venues such as FOCS and JMLR. On TCS-Bench, a benchmark of research-level theorem-proving tasks drawn from papers published at FOCS, STOC, and SODA, Colosseum achieves 71.0% accuracy using Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3.7 Flash. In a separate Codeforces evaluation using Gemini 3.1 Pro, the proof-oriented pipeline with execution feedback solves 218 of 222 problems.

</details>


### [507] [Corrupt Plans, Clean Traces: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring with Plan Injection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15989)
*Keertana Chidambaram,Andrew Ilyas,Vasilis Syrgkanis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现并命名了"plan injection"攻击：在LLM actor上下文中植入看似无害的推理可诱导其执行对抗行为并逃避监控，且该攻击可扩展至更大模型与更难任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CoT监控被视为一种安全策略，用监控器检查actor模型的推理以发现不安全规划、欺骗或错位迹象。作者希望检验该监控机制的鲁棒性，探究其是否能被规避。

Method: 作者在Lanham等人(2023)的多选题问答可监控性设置中，结合Li等人(2025)的investigator-agent诱导框架首先发现该攻击；随后将攻击推广至更难任务（多个可监控性基准）和更大模型（如DeepSeek-R1）；并测试额外监控资源（如让监控器访问注入计划、增加推理预算）对检测的影响。

Result: 攻击在不同可监控性基准上达到25-33%的监控规避率；actor模型不仅跟随注入计划，还将其改述为自己的推理而不注明来源；给予监控器注入计划反而使Bio-Math任务检测率下降多达50%；增加思考预算时，模型会花更多token为注入计划辩护而非标记它。

Conclusion: CoT监控对plan injection攻击脆弱，且更多监控资源有时反而有害，提示现有CoT可监控性安全策略存在重要漏洞。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a safety strategy where the reasoning of a large language model "actor" is inspected by a "monitor" (often another language model) for signs of unsafe planning, deception, or misalignment. We find that planting harmful but benign-sounding reasoning in the actor's context can steer it to perform adversarial actions while evading monitors, an attack we term "plan injection". We initially discover this attack in the multiple-choice question-answering monitorability setting proposed by Lanham et al. (2023), using the investigator-agent elicitation framework of Li et al. (2025). We generalize the attack and show that the discovered behavior scales to harder tasks (achieving 25-33% monitor evasion rates across different monitorability benchmarks) and larger models such as DeepSeek-R1. Across the settings we study, actor models not only follow injected plans but also paraphrase them as their own reasoning, without explicit attribution to the injections. Finally, we find cases where extra monitor resources cause harm - giving the monitor access to the injected plan drops detection by as much as 50% in the Bio-Math task and in a case study on monitor reasoning budget, we find transcripts where additional thinking tokens are spent rationalizing the injected plan rather than flagging it.

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

# cs.GT [[Back]](#toc)

### [508] [Scaling Chance-Constrained Correlated Equilibrium Computation for Exclusive Resource-Assignment Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13565)
*Jaehan Im,Ufuk Topcu,David Fridovich-Keil*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文针对机会约束相关均衡计算中联合动作数指数增长的问题，提出"精确分配"限制，将动作数从 O(2^(nr)) 降至 O(n^r)，并给出非空性与保留性条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自利智能体在中心协调者不知其成本（不确定）时，可用机会约束相关均衡实现鲁棒协调；但联合动作数随智能体数指数增长，导致计算不可行。

Method: 针对竞争共享资源、且同时使用不安全/不理想的博弈，施加"精确一对一资源分配"限制，每个资源恰好分配给一个智能体。在受限联合动作集上求解机会约束相关均衡，同时保留所有单边偏离的激励约束，并刻画受限问题的可行集结构。

Result: 受限问题的可行集恰好等于精确分配集内机会约束纯纳什均衡的凸包，由此得到非空性的充要条件；进一步给出无限制博弈中所有机会约束纯纳什均衡被该限制保留的充分条件。垂直起降机场出发走廊协调实验中，中位计算时间降低99.81%，协调性能等效。

Conclusion: 精确一对一资源分配限制在保持激励约束与协调性能的前提下大幅降低计算复杂度，为不确定成本下的多智能体资源共享协调提供可扩展方法。

Abstract: The chance-constrained correlated equilibrium concept provides a robust coordination technique for self-interested agents whose costs are uncertain to a central coordinator, but the number of joint actions considered in its computation grows exponentially with the number of agents. We propose an exact-one resource-assignment restriction for games in which agents compete for shared resources and simultaneous use of a resource is undesirable or unsafe. The restriction allows each resource to be assigned to exactly one agent, reducing the number of joint actions considered from O(2^(nr)) to O(n^r) for n agents and r resources. The resulting problem is solved over the restricted joint action set while retaining all incentive constraints associated with unilateral deviations. We show that the feasible set of the restricted problem is exactly the convex hull of the chance-constrained pure Nash equilibria contained in the exact-one assignment set, yielding a necessary and sufficient condition for nonemptiness. We further derive a sufficient condition under which all chance-constrained pure Nash equilibria of the unrestricted game are retained by the restriction. Numerical experiments in a vertiport departure-corridor coordination scenario demonstrate a 99.81% reduction in median computation time relative to the unrestricted formulation while achieving equivalent coordination performance.

</details>


### [509] [Online Fair Division: Pushing the Frontier of Approximate Proportionality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13650)
*Yingjian Du,Ankang Sun*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文研究在线公平分配中确定性算法能实现的PROP1保证，分别给出了无额外信息和已知最大物品价值(MIV)两种设定下的算法与下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线分配中资源逐一到达且决策不可撤回，需要理解此时还能实现何种公平性保证，特别是确定性算法的PROP1近似能力，并回答Choo等人提出的开放问题。

Method: 研究n个代理、非负加性估值、商品数未知且对手可自适应的确定性在线分配。无额外信息时设计确定性算法；并证明下界。另研究算法预先知道每个代理最大物品价值(MIV)的设定，设计竞争比为1/2的确定性算法并给出不可能性结果。

Result: 无额外信息下，给出保证Ω(1/log(nm))-PROP1的确定性算法，回答了开放问题；并证明对每个固定n和足够大的m，任何确定性算法的PROP1因子为O(log log m/log m)。有MIV信息时，给出竞争比1/2的确定性算法，优于Choo等人的1/n；并证明即使两个代理且精确MIV信息，也无确定性算法能任意接近1。

Conclusion: 在线公平分配的确定性PROP1保证在无额外信息时受对数级限制，而MIV信息可显著改善但无法达到接近完美的竞争比，刻画了未来信息对可实现公平性的影响。

Abstract: Online fair division captures allocation problems in which indivisible resources arrive over time and must be assigned before future resources are known. Understanding what fairness remains achievable when allocation decisions are immediate and irrevocable is a fundamental question in this setting. We study deterministic online allocation among $n$ agents with nonnegative additive valuations, where the number of goods is unknown and the adversary can adapt to previous allocation decisions. We focus on proportionality up to one good (PROP1) and examine how advance future information affects the achievable guarantees.
  In the setting without additional information, we answer an open question in Choo et al. that asks whether a nontrivial deterministic approximation for PROP1 can be obtained. In particular, we present a deterministic algorithm that guarantees $Ω(1/\log(nm))$-PROP1, where $m$ is the number of goods. Moreover, we complement this result by showing that, for every fixed $n$ and all sufficiently large $m$, every deterministic algorithm has an instance with $m$ goods on which its PROP1 factor is $O(\log\log m/\log m)$. We also study the setting where the algorithm knows in advance the maximum item value (MIV) for every agent. With MIV information, we give a deterministic algorithm with competitive ratio 1/2, improving the $1/n$ guarantee in Choo et al. We also show that no deterministic algorithm can achieve a competitive ratio arbitrarily close to one, even for two agents with exact MIV information.

</details>


### [510] [Revisiting EFX and fPO Allocations for Binary Chores](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13970)
*Zehan Lin,Xiaowei Wu,Shengwei Zhou*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究二元加性成本下不可分杂务的公平高效分配，重点是不等权利与best-of-both-worlds保证。提出新词典型势函数，得出WEFX+fPO的分配，并揭示不等权利下的彩票不可能性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二元估值在物品中研究充分，但杂务对应情形理解不足；已有工作（Tao et al. TCS 2025）仅解决等权利的EFX+fPO，本文要刻画不等权利下的公平与效率兼容性。

Method: 针对杂务设计新的字典序势函数：任何最小化该势函数的分配同时满足WEFX与fPO；并据此给出多项式时间局部搜索算法。对于best-of-both-worlds，构造等权利下多项式时间的彩票，使事前EF+fPO、每个实现EFX+fPO；同时用反例证明不等权利下不可能性。

Result: 不等权利下，可计算得到WEFX且fPO的分配；best-of-both-worlds方面，不等权利存在尖锐障碍：即使两个代理且二元加性成本相同，也不存在同时满足事前WEF与事后WEF1的彩票。等权利下则可在多项式时间构造事前EF+fPO且每个实现EFX+fPO的彩票。

Conclusion: 二元杂务在不等权利下可通过势函数方法实现WEFX与fPO兼容，但best-of-both-worlds保证在不等权利下受根本限制；等权利情形则可同时获得强事前与事后保证。

Abstract: We study fair and efficient allocations of indivisible chores under binary additive costs, with a focus on unequal entitlements and best-of-both-worlds guarantees. While binary valuations have been extensively studied for goods, their chore counterpart remains much less understood. A notable exception is due to Tao et al. (TCS 2025), who established that EFX and fPO are compatible for binary chores with equal entitlements. We revisit binary chores under unequal entitlements and establish the computation of allocations that satisfy WEFX and fPO. Our key technical contribution is a new lexicographic potential function tailored to chores: any allocation minimizing this potential ensures both WEFX and fPO. This potential further guides a polynomial-time local-search algorithm for computing allocations with such fairness and efficiency guarantees. For best-of-both-worlds guarantees, we show that unequal entitlements create a sharp obstruction: even with two agents and identical binary additive costs, no lottery can simultaneously satisfy ex-ante WEF and ex-post WEF1. In contrast, for equal entitlements, we construct in polynomial time a lottery that is ex-ante EF and fPO, while every realization is both EFX and fPO.

</details>


### [511] [Consistency-Robustness Tradeoffs for Strategyproof Scheduling with Predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14088)
*Hau Chan,Jianan Lin,Chenhao Wang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文研究带预测的无关机调度中的策略防护机制，提出EdgeSkip，将一致性-鲁棒性权衡改进为(4, 2n-2)，并证明该权衡在job-wise加权机制类中的紧下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在n台无关机上最小化makespan需保证策略防护（agent私知处理时间），同时利用公开预测提升性能；已有工作(Balkanski等)仅有(6, 2n)的保证，一致性与鲁棒性的最优权衡尚未确定。

Method: 提出确定性策略防护机制EdgeSkip，属于job-wise加权机制类：每个job用预测相关的权重独立分配，基于预测算出的多项式时间2-近似参考调度与标准权衡参数；另研究使用最优参考调度的版本及一个容错变体。

Result: EdgeSkip达4-consistent与(2n-2)-robust，优于之前的(6, 2n)；无计算限制下可达C-consistent与max{n,(n-1)C/(C-1)}-robust（任意C>1），并给出该机制类的匹配信息论下界；对任意确定性策略防护机制证明鲁棒性下界max{n, C/(C-1)}；实验显示良好的实证性能。

Conclusion: 论文确定了job-wise加权机制类中一致性-鲁棒性的精确权衡，并给出更一般策略防护机制的鲁棒性下界，同时通过实验验证了所提机制的有效性。

Abstract: We study strategyproof scheduling on \(n\) unrelated machines with predictions. Each machine is controlled by an agent with privately known processing times, while the mechanism receives a public prediction of the processing-time matrix before the agents report. The objective is to minimize the makespan subject to strategyproofness. We measure performance by consistency, the approximation guarantee for correct predictions, and robustness, the worst-case guarantee for arbitrary predictions.
  We introduce \textsc{EdgeSkip}, a deterministic strategyproof member of the class of job-wise weighted mechanisms. Such mechanisms allocate each job independently using prediction-dependent weights. Using a polynomial-time \(2\)-approximate reference schedule computed from the prediction and a standard tradeoff parameter, \textsc{EdgeSkip} is \(4\)-consistent and \((2n-2)\)-robust, improving on the \((6,2n)\) guarantee of Balkanski, Gkatzelis, and Tan. Without computational restrictions, \textsc{EdgeSkip} with an optimal reference schedule is \(C\)-consistent and \(\max\{n,(n-1)C/(C-1)\}\)-robust for every \(C>1\). We prove a matching information-theoretic lower bound for all job-wise weighted mechanisms, thereby determining the exact consistency--robustness tradeoff for this class. For arbitrary deterministic strategyproof mechanisms, we establish the robustness lower bound \(\max\{n,C/(C-1)\}\) for every \(C>1\). We also study an error-tolerant variant and improve upon prior guarantees. Experiments demonstrate that our mechanisms achieve good empirical performance.

</details>


### [512] [Approximating Optimal Welfare in Complementary Allocation under Decentralized Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14301)
*Meryem Essaidi*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究互补可分割资源在机构仅观测本地坐标时的分配问题，提出阈值引荐机制，可用极少信息将本地信息损失从任意大降为常数因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 互补资源常由只看到个体需求不同坐标的机构分配；机构知道自己资源是否缺失，却不知道补齐后是否形成有用组合。论文旨在隔离信息问题而非激励问题，衡量“分割信息”相对协作式去中心化基准 DEC 的福利成本。

Method: 定义基准 DEC：在合作机构、已知人口分布与容量下，仅依赖本地信息的最优规则。分析本地观测导致的效率损失，并提出阈值引荐：机构只报告其价值是否低于公共阈值，清算规则只用联合报告。主要工具是 profile-level charging certificate；进一步使用几何阈值阶梯/楼梯机制，用双对数级消息恢复常数比例 OPT。

Result: 仅有本地观测时，最优协调政策可任意低效：损失因子与 m 线性相关，三机构时可达 OPT 的倒数因子。单阈值引荐达到 OPT/[4(1+ln(2/OPT))] 的福利，每机构 1 bit，且等收入族说明该 log 损失对单阈值紧。阈值阶梯用 Θ(log log(1/OPT)) bits 恢复 OPT/8，并在该类中必要。

Conclusion: 简单报告语言能把巨大的本地信息损失转化为常数因子恢复：一个阈值获得对数近似；一个阈值楼梯用 log-of-log bits 获得常数因子近似。

Abstract: Complementary resources are often allocated by agencies that see different coordinates of an individual's needs. If an intervention requires complementary resources, an agency may know if said person lacks its own resource; yet not know if supplying completes a useful bundle. We study allocation of $m$ divisible complementary goods when each agency observes only its own coordinate of a baseline-access profile.
  To isolate information from incentives, we measure the welfare cost of this split against a generous decentralized benchmark DEC: the best rule that acts on local information alone, with cooperative agencies and known population distribution and capacities. Even so, local observation alone can make optimally coordinated policies arbitrarily inefficient: a factor linear in $m$ (even with equal capacities), and a factor inverse in OPT (with but three agencies).
  Threshold referrals recover much of this loss: an agency reports if its value lies below a public threshold, and a clearing rule uses only the joint reports. Aggregating types by their reports captures a rectangle under the optimal half-utility survival curve. Our main tool is a profile-level charging certificate: if optimal utility is at least twice a threshold, OPT pays at least that on every deficient coordinate. This yields welfare at least ${\rm OPT}/[4(1+\ln(2/{\rm OPT}))]$ with one bit per agency; and an equal-revenue family shows this log-loss tight for one threshold. A geometric threshold ladder improves this to a constant fraction of OPT with doubly-logarithmic messages: a staircase recovers ${\rm OPT}/8$ with $Θ(\log\log(1/{\rm OPT}))$ bits, and this is necessary within the class.
  The results isolate how a simple reporting language turns large local-info losses into constant-factor recovery. In short: One threshold gets a log-approximation. A staircase, with log-of-log bits, a constant-factor.

</details>


### [513] [Envy-Free Chore Allocation with Unit Subsidies under Negative Dichotomous Valuations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14465)
*Mainak Sarkar,Soumyarup Sadhukhan*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究负二分估值下不可分杂务的补贴分配问题，证明每人至多1单位补贴即可实现无嫉妒，且补贴总额不超过n-1，绑定紧且可多项式时间计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 这是 Barman 等 (2022) 二分物品模型的杂务对应版本。物品模型中已知至多每代理1单位补贴即可保证无嫉妒，本文追问杂务下是否保持同样的最优保证，且不依赖额外结构假设。

Method: 从 Tao 等 (2025) 算法产生的无嫉妒部分分配出发，在终端相等图的尾部强连通分量中将剩余杂务分配给不同代理，并通过相关相等图中的后向闭包确定受补贴代理，补贴向量取{0,1}^n。

Result: 对任意负二分估值实例，存在完整分配A与补贴向量p∈{0,1}^n，∑p_i≤n-1，使(A,p)无嫉妒；且A在补贴前已满足EF1。界是紧的，分配与补贴可在值预言模型中多项式时间计算。若同时要求帕累托最优，则单位补贴保证一般无法维持。

Conclusion: 杂务与物品在二分边际下具有相同的每人至多1单位补贴的最优保证，且可实现EF1+无嫉妒；但该保证与帕累托最优不兼容，算法基于部分分配与终端相等图结构。

Abstract: We study the allocation of indivisible chores with subsidies under negative dichotomous valuations, where the marginal disutility of every chore is either zero or one. This is the chore analogue of the dichotomous goods model of Barman et al. (2022), for which a subsidy of at most one unit per agent is known to suffice for envy-freeness.
  We show that the same optimal guarantee holds for chores, under no structural assumption beyond binary marginals. For every instance with negative dichotomous valuations, there exists a complete allocation $A$ and a subsidy vector $p\in\{0,1\}^n$ with $\sum_{i\in N} p_i\le n-1$ such that $(A,p)$ is envy-free. Moreover, the allocation $A$ is EF1 even before subsidies are paid. The bound is tight, and the allocation and subsidies can be computed in polynomial time in the value-oracle model. We further show that the unit-subsidy guarantee cannot, in general, be maintained if Pareto optimality is also required.
  Our algorithm starts from an envy-free partial allocation produced by the algorithm of Tao et al. (2025), assigns the remaining chores to distinct agents in a tail strongly connected component of the terminal equality graph, and determines the subsidised agents through a backward closure in the associated equality graph.

</details>


### [514] [Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in Markets with Congestion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14827)
*Qixuan Zai,Randall Berry*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究拥塞资源下多智能体强化学习（MARL）的企业价格竞争，探讨独立学习智能体如何形成默契合谋，并分析学习动态、状态表示与策略交互对竞争的共同影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有文献表明独立学习的MARL智能体可能产生默契合谋行为，但在带拥塞资源、需求曲线未知的市场中这种合谋如何形成尚不清楚。本文旨在填补这一空白，并对经济学学习与学习型市场设计提供启示。

Method: 构建Bertrand竞争模型：企业通过公布价格竞争，顾客依据价格与拥塞程度选择企业；价格、拥塞与服务需求量的关系由未知的反需求曲线决定，企业需通过经验学习。每个企业建模为自利学习智能体，以利润最大化为目标选择价格。

Result: 结果显示独立学习的智能体在拥塞资源市场中会出现默契合谋行为，学习动态、状态表示与策略交互共同塑造竞争结果。

Conclusion: 学习动态、状态表示与策略交互共同影响竞争格局，研究对经济学习理论及学习型市场设计具有双重启示意义。

Abstract: This paper investigates multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) in settings where firms compete for customers using congestible resources. We consider Bertrand competition in which firms compete by announcing prices and customers choose among firms based on both price and congestion. The relationship between price, congestion and the quantity of customers willing to accept service is governed by an unknown inverse demand curve, which firms must learn through experience. Each firm is modeled as a self-interested learning agent that chooses its price to maximize profit. A growing literature has shown that independently learning MARL agents can develop tacitly collusive behavior. We examine how such behavior emerges in markets with congestible resources. Our results provide insight into how learning dynamics, state representation, and strategic interaction jointly shape competition, with implications for both economic learning and the design of learning-enabled markets.

</details>


### [515] [Strategic Decision Focused Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14907)
*Tinashe Handina,Yuehan Diao,Adam Wierman,Eric Mazumdar*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文将决策聚焦学习扩展到存在策略性互动的场景（战略决策聚焦学习），发现预测精度与均衡收益之间可能是非单调关系，并提出算法应对。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有决策聚焦学习多假设单一决策者在孤立环境下优化，忽视了当ML预测影响多个策略性主体行为并改变博弈均衡的情形。

Method: 形式化"战略决策聚焦学习"：ML系统预测一个外生状态，部分主体在博弈前观察到该状态；分析预测如何影响主体策略及均衡，并提出算法方法。

Result: 证明预测精度—均衡收益景观可能是非单调的，即更优的预测反而可能降低表现；在野生动物保护和基础设施防护等基准上验证了所提方法。

Conclusion: 设计预测器时考虑策略性互动至关重要，战略因素从根本上改变了学习问题的性质。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) predictions are increasingly being used to guide decision-making, giving rise to the problem of decision-focused learning (DFL) where predictors are optimized for downstream decision quality rather than accuracy alone. However, most existing work assumes a single decision-maker optimizing in isolation. This paper formalizes strategic decision-focused learning, where an ML system predicts an exogenous state that some agents observe before playing a game. For example, a park ranger may predict wildlife locations to allocate anti-poaching patrols against strategic poachers. While the exogenous state is unaffected by agent actions, predictions influence agents' strategies and the resulting equilibrium. We find that strategic considerations fundamentally change the learning problem. In particular, we show the prediction accuracy-equilibrium payoff landscape can be non-monotonic, i.e., better predictions can degrade performance. We propose algorithmic approaches to address these challenges and validate them across benchmarks in wildlife conservation and infrastructure protection. Our theory and experiments highlight the importance of accounting for strategic interactions when designing predictors.

</details>


### [516] [Improved Impossibility Bounds for Maximin Share Allocations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15085)
*Tomer Ezra,Tamar Garbuz*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文改进了不可分割物品分配中最大化最小份额(MMS)的不可行性下界：对商品将缺口从1/n^4提升到逆多对数级，对家务对称改进，并改进了四智能体小规模普遍界(商品39/40→20/21，家务44/43→31/30)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MMS是核心公平基准，即使加性偏好下也未必同时可达。已有大量近似算法研究，但定量不可行性（ impossibility）下界关注不足，本文旨在填补这一空白并强化已有界。

Method: 针对充分大的智能体数n，构造加性商品实例使任意分配中某智能体所得不超过其MMS的1-Ω((log n)^{-2})；对家务构造使某智能体成本至少为其MMS的1+Ω((log n)^{-2})倍。另构造4智能体11物品实例改进常数普遍界。

Result: 商品缺口由1/n^4改进为逆多对数级（对数尺度上指数级提升）；家务得到对称结果。由此证明：对任意固定ε>0，商品保证1-O(n^{-ε})与家务保证1+O(n^{-ε})均不可行。小规模普遍界商品39/40→20/21，家务44/43→31/30。

Conclusion: MMS的不可行性远强于此前认知，即使允许随n缓慢衰减的近似因子也无法保证，为近似保证的极限提供了更紧的量化刻画。

Abstract: The maximin share (MMS) is a central fairness benchmark for allocating indivisible items, but it need not be simultaneously attainable even under additive preferences. While extensive work has developed approximation guarantees, quantitative impossibility bounds have received comparatively little attention. We establish improved asymptotic and constant impossibility bounds for both goods and chores.
  For every sufficiently large number $n$ of agents, we construct additive goods instances in which every allocation gives some agent at most a $1-Ω((\log n)^{-2})$ fraction of her MMS. This strengthens the $1/n^4$ shortfall of Feige, Sapir, and Tauber (2021) to an inverse-polylogarithmic shortfall, an exponential improvement on the logarithmic scale of $n$. For chores, we construct instances in which every allocation gives some agent cost at least a $1+Ω((\log n)^{-2})$ factor of her MMS. Consequently, for every fixed $\varepsilon>0$, guarantees of $1-O(n^{-\varepsilon})$ for goods and $1+O(n^{-\varepsilon})$ for chores are impossible.
  We also give four-agent, eleven-item instances that improve the universal impossibility bounds from $39/40$ to $20/21$ for goods and from $44/43$ to $31/30$ for chores.

</details>


### [517] [Tight Subsidy Bounds for Weighted Proportional Allocation of Mixed Manna](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15208)
*Jugal Garg,Eklavya Sharma,Xiaowei Wu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究混合 manna 下的比例公平分配，用货币补贴恢复比例性并最小化总补贴，证明了紧补贴界 τ(n)≈n/4，并给出多项式时间算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合 manna 中比例分配未必存在，需借助补贴恢复比例性；此前 goods-only/chores-only 的上界 n/3-1/6 与下界 τ(n)≈n/4 之间存在间隙。

Method: 将 KKM 不动点定理推广到基于份额（share-based）的公平概念，用于加权混合 manna 场景，并设计固定代理数下的多项式时间算法。

Result: 证明总补贴至多 τ(n) 即可实现比例性，闭合了上下界间隙；结果适用于加权混合 manna，且分配满足 WPROP1。

Conclusion: 确立了混合 manna 下比例性的紧补贴界，解决了 Wu et al. (2023) 和 Garg et al. (2026) 的公开问题，并提供可计算算法。

Abstract: We study the problem of fairly allocating m indivisible items among n agents with possibly unequal entitlements in the mixed manna setting, where each item may be perceived as a good or a chore by different agents. We focus on the fundamental fairness notion of proportionality. Since proportional allocations need not exist in this setting, we allow monetary subsidies to restore proportionality while minimizing the total subsidy. When each item's (dis)utility is bounded by 1, a total subsidy of at least τ(n) \approx n/4 may be necessary. For goods-only or chores-only instances, the best previously known upper bound was n/3-1/6 due to Wu and Zhou~(2024). We close this gap by proving that a total subsidy of at most τ(n) always suffices, thereby establishing the tight subsidy bound. Our results hold even in the more general setting of weighted mixed manna, resolving an open question posed by~Wu et al. (2023) and Garg et al. (2026). The allocation also satisfies weighted proportionality up to one item (WPROP1). Our proof develops a novel application of the Knaster-Kuratowski-Mazurkiewicz (KKM) fixed-point theorem, extending the KKM framework to share-based fairness notions. Finally, we design a polynomial-time algorithm to compute such allocations for any fixed number of agents.

</details>


### [518] [Reconfiguration in Fair Division Revisited](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15358)
*Fabian Frank,Warut Suksompong*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究不可分物品公平分配的重配置问题：在保持每一步公平性的前提下，通过交换序列将一个公平分配转化为另一个。聚焦EFk层级，证明了EF1重配置的若干不可能性与可行性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公平分配之间能否在保持公平性的条件下相互转化（重配置）是重要问题；本文考察EFk层级中，相同size vector的两个EF1分配是否总能通过保持EFk的路径连接。

Method: 理论分析与构造证明：对任意固定k构造反例；考察envy cycle elimination算法与最大Nash福利解；研究recursively balanced picking sequences（含round-robin）；并用归约证明EF1重配置存在性判定的NP难性；另研究允许转移的更宽松模型。

Result: 对于任意固定k，两个具有相同size vector的EF1分配不一定存在中间满足EFk的重配置路径，即使来自envy cycle elimination或最大Nash福利解亦然；但由recursively balanced picking sequences（含round-robin）产生且size vector相同的分配总可通过保持EF2的路径连接。判定EF1重配置路径是否存在对任意固定代理数为NP难。允许转移的模型下获得额外连通性保证。

Conclusion: EFk重配置存在尖锐的层级分界：EF1到EFk一般不可行，而特定规则（如recursively balanced picking sequences）可保证EF2连通；交换模型下的判定问题计算困难，允许转移可提供更多连通性保证。

Abstract: We revisit reconfiguration in the fair allocation of indivisible goods, where the goal is to transform one fair allocation into another through a sequence of exchanges while preserving fairness at every step. Our focus is on the hierarchy of envy-freeness up to $k$ goods (EF$k$). We show that for any fixed $k$, two EF1 allocations with the same size vector need not admit a reconfiguration path whose intermediate allocations satisfy EF$k$. This impossibility persists even when the two allocations arise from standard EF1 approaches: the envy cycle elimination algorithm or the maximum Nash welfare solution. In contrast, we prove that allocations with the same size vector produced by recursively balanced picking sequences, including round-robin, are always connected via a path that maintains EF2. We also show that deciding whether an EF1 reconfiguration path exists is NP-hard for any fixed number of agents. Furthermore, we complement these exchange-based results by studying a more permissive model that also allows transfers, establishing additional connectivity guarantees.

</details>


### [519] [Differentially Private Multicolor Discrepancy and Fair Division of Indivisible Goods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15372)
*Max Dupré la Tour*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究纯差分隐私下不可分物品的公平分配，提出入口隐私算法实现共识EF up to O(√n+log³m)，改进先前O(n log m)依赖，并给出结构化情形多项式算法及Ω(log n)下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 延续Manurangsi和Suksompong的工作，在纯差分隐私约束下研究不可分物品公平分配，目标是改进对代理数n的依赖并获得更强保证。

Method: 提出入口隐私算法，核心是私有的多色差异（multicolor discrepancy）算法；该算法可能需指数时间。对物品值属于大小D的公开字母表情形，给出多项式时间入口隐私算法。

Result: 一般情形高概率达到共识EF up to O(√n+log³m)，优于先前普通EF的O(n log m)；结构化情形高概率达到普通EF up to O(polylog(mD))；并证明入口隐私下普通EF需移除Ω(log n)个物品的下界，即使二元效用也成立。

Conclusion: 在纯差分隐私下显著改进了公平分配的近似保证，并给出匹配的下界，多色差异私有算法具有独立价值，但一般算法可能指数时间。

Abstract: We study the fair division of indivisible goods under pure differential privacy, continuing the line of work initiated by Manurangsi and Suksompong. For $n$ agents with nonnegative additive utilities over $m$ goods and a fixed privacy parameter, we give an entry-private algorithm that, with high probability, achieves consensus envy-freeness up to $O(\sqrt n+\log^3 m)$ goods. This substantially improves the dependence on $n$ over the previous $O(n\log m)$ guarantee for ordinary envy-freeness, while providing the stronger consensus guarantee. A key ingredient is a private algorithm for multicolor discrepancy, which may be of independent interest. Our algorithm may require exponential time.
  We also obtain substantially stronger guarantees under additional structure: when all item values belong to a public alphabet of size $D$, we give a polynomial-time entry-private algorithm achieving ordinary envy-freeness up to $O(\operatorname{polylog}(mD))$ goods with high probability.
  Finally, we prove an $Ω(\log n)$ lower bound on the number of goods that must be removed to achieve ordinary envy-freeness under entry privacy, for sufficiently many goods, even with binary utilities.

</details>


### [520] [Delegating Authorization to Misaligned Agents: Coalitional Alignment and Safe Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15803)
*Natalie Collina,Surbhi Goel,Aaron Roth,Sikata Bela Sengupta*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究长时程AI agent的控制问题：用审查小组代替人工审批。提出k-robust coalitional alignment条件，刻画在容忍k个反对票时审查的充分必要性，并推广到序贯控制与策略投票情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程agent每步动作会改变状态并影响未来轨迹；若agent未完全对齐，需在执行前审批关键动作。但逐步人工审批使注意力成为瓶颈，而把审查委托给其他AI agent又会引入同样的对齐问题（审查者本身可能也未对齐）。因此需要找到一种弱于个体对齐、但足以保证安全性的集体审查条件。

Method: 设proposer提出动作，每个reviewer报告该动作相对baseline是否提升自身效用；采用容忍k个反对票的阈值规则。证明该规则安全的充要条件是：移除任意k个reviewer后，principal的效用可写成剩余reviewer效用的非负组合加上一个在所有可行proposal上非负的项，即k-robust coalitional alignment。并将该刻画提升到带任意proposer的折扣MDP序贯控制中；进一步分析reviewer策略性投票下的Nash均衡安全性。

Result: (1) 在MDP中，每个状态的安全性既是induced policy不劣于baseline的必要条件也是充分条件；(2) 策略投票下，reward-function空间中的全panel覆盖可保证一致同意规则下所有Nash均衡安全，而更宽松的阈值即使用户个体对齐也可能存在不安全均衡；(3) 用现有reviewer模型实验表明，即便容忍部分反对票，集体审查也能在没有个体对齐者的情况下保持可靠。

Conclusion: 集体审查的安全性可由弱于个体对齐的k-robust coalitional alignment保证，该条件在序贯控制中同样必要且充分；阈值放宽会带来策略投票下的安全风险，但适度容忍反对票在实践中仍可保持可靠，为AI agent的规模化安全审批提供理论框架。

Abstract: Long-running AI agents create a control problem: each action they take changes the state, which in turn affects the trajectory of future actions. If the agent is not fully aligned, then guaranteeing safety requires approving consequential actions before allowing them to be executed. But requiring human approval at every step makes attention a bottleneck. Delegating review to other AI agents raises the same alignment problem: the reviewers may themselves be misaligned. We identify a condition on a reviewing panel that is weaker than individual alignment yet necessary and sufficient for a guarantee that the principal fares at least as well in expectation as under a designated baseline policy.
  Each reviewer agent reports whether an action proposal made by a proposer agent improves its own utility relative to the baseline. We show that a threshold rule tolerating $k$ disapprovals is safe exactly when, after any $k$ reviewers are removed, the principal's utility can be written as a nonnegative combination of the remaining reviewers' utilities, plus a term that is nonnegative on every feasible proposal. We call this property $k$-robust coalitional alignment. The characterization lifts to sequential control: in a discounted MDP with an arbitrary proposer agent, safety at every state is both necessary and sufficient for the induced policy to match or improve on the baseline.
  When reviewers vote strategically, full-panel coverage in reward-function space guarantees that every Nash equilibrium is safe under the unanimous approval rule; in contrast, more permissive thresholds can admit unsafe equilibria even when reviewers are individually aligned.
  Experiments with existing reviewer models show that collective review can remain sound without an aligned individual, even when some disapprovals are tolerated.

</details>


### [521] [On the Hardness of Maximin Share Allocations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15841)
*Sushmita Gupta,Sanjay Seetharaman*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究精确MMS分配存在性判定的计算复杂性，证明了加法物品下该问题是D^P-难，2-加法估值下是Δ_2^P-完全，并给出关于代理人数量的强/弱coNP-难二分结果及近似比FPTAS的不可能性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kurokawa等证明精确MMS分配不一定存在后，大量工作研究近似MMS。但Bouveret和Lemaître十多年前提出的基本复杂性难题——判定精确MMS分配是否存在有多难——一直未解决。加法估值仅有Δ_2^P上界而无硬度结果，2-加法估值仅知NP-难，与上界间存在巨大差距，且加法与k-加法情形的精确复杂性被列为公开问题。

Method: 针对加法物品，构造归约证明MMS存在性判定是D^P-难；针对2-加法估值，在单调子模物品实例类上证明Δ_2^P-完全性；对三个代理证明弱coNP-难，对无限制代理数证明强coNP-难，并通过强硬度构造产生最优MMS近似比的逆多项式间隙；最后用保持MMS存在性的多项式时间变换将物品结果推广到杂务情形。

Result: (1) 加法物品下MMS存在性判定为D^P-难，是该长期问题的首个硬度结果；(2) 2-加法估值下达到Δ_2^P-完全，弥合了复杂性差距，据知是此类首个结果；(3) 三代理弱coNP-难，与两代理的存在性保证形成精确二分；无限制代理数强coNP-难；(4) 强硬度构造给出逆多项式间隙，除非P=NP否则不存在近似最优MMS比的FPTAS。

Conclusion: 本文在MMS存在性判定的复杂性问题上取得多方面进展，给出了加法与2-加法情形下的硬度与完全性结果，建立了代理人数目上的复杂性二分，并通过多项式时间变换将全部物品结果推广至杂务情形。

Abstract: The maximin share (MMS) guarantee is a central fairness benchmark for allocating indivisible items. Since Kurokawa, Procaccia and Wang [EC'14, JACM'18] showed that exact MMS allocations need not exist, much work has studied existence and computation of approximate MMS allocations. In contrast, a basic complexity question posed more than a decade ago by Bouveret and Lemaître [JAAMAS'16] has remained unresolved: how hard is it to decide whether an exact MMS allocation exists?
  For additive valuations, Lonc and Truszczynski [JAIR'20] showed membership in $Δ_2^P$ (also known as $P^{NP}$), but no hardness result was known. For the more general class of 2-additive valuations, Bouveret and Lemaître established NP-hardness, leaving a substantial gap to the $Δ_2^P$ upper bound. Moreover, the (precise) complexity of MMS existence in additive and $k$-additive settings was posed as an open question.
  We make progress on all of these fronts: (1) For additive goods, we prove that deciding MMS existence is $D^P$-hard, giving the first hardness result for this longstanding problem. (2) For 2-additive valuations, we close the complexity gap by proving $Δ_2^P$-completeness on a class of instances of monotone submodular goods. To the best of our knowledge this is the first result of this kind.
  We also prove weak coNP-hardness for three agents, thereby establishing a precise dichotomy with the known existence guarantee for two agents; and strong coNP-hardness when the number of agents is unrestricted. Moreover, the strong hardness construction produces an inverse-polynomial gap in the optimal MMS approximation ratio, ruling out an FPTAS for approximating this ratio unless P=NP. Finally, we show that all these results for goods extend to the chores setting through a polynomial-time transformation that preserves MMS existence.

</details>


### [522] [Core Up-To-One for Participatory Budgeting with Additive Utilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15928)
*Piotr Skowron*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究加性效用下的参与式预算，提出基于效用加权调和熵与成本惩罚的选择规则，证明其返回满足"core-up-to-one"的预算可行结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参与式预算中需在预算约束下公平且高效地分配公共资源，现有规则在满足核心（core）等公平性质上存在局限，本文寻求兼顾预算可行性与近似核心性质的机制。

Method: 在加性效用假设下，设计一种选择规则，结合效用加权的调和熵（utility-weighted harmonic entropy）与成本惩罚项进行优化。

Result: 证明该规则返回的结果是预算可行的，且满足"core-up-to-one"（即核心性质允许至多一个项目的偏离）。

Conclusion: 该规则为参与式预算提供了一种理论上具备近似核心保证的可行方法。

Abstract: We study participatory budgeting with additive utilities. We introduce a selection rule based on utility-weighted harmonic entropy and a cost penalty, and prove that it returns budget-feasible outcomes satisfying core-up-to-one.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [523] [Abstention Errors and Segment Support in CUAD: An Auditable Contract-Extraction Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13274)
*Zeki Emre Tekin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对固定RoBERTa检查点在CUAD测试集上的合同条款抽取进行回溯性可复现评估，重点衡量冗余输出与类别内可用证据，而非仅参考恢复率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合同条款抽取基准只衡量参考恢复，但用于审阅辅助时还需评估不必要的输出以及各类别内可用证据的充分性。

Method: 保留早期冻结的候选生成，修正匹配错误，并在62份训练集合同上以90%召回目标重选类别阈值；对102份测试合同的30,464个候选进行重新评估。

Result: 修正后操作点恢复82.2%参考跨度，CUAD精度8.2%；30,464个返回串中19,562个出现在无标注答案问题上，系统对2,938个此类问题回答1,335个，假阳率45.4%（95%区间43.3–47.9%）；匹配候选仅占返回串20.3%；41个类别中仅9个满足≥30正/30负合同，支持度阈值20和40下分别变为18和2，另有2类无负样本。

Conclusion: 研究刻画了单一检查点、解码器与阈值策略的表现，早期测试访问和检查点训练重叠限制确证性解读；论文仅提供原始与修正分析及软件检查工件，不确立新发布标准或生产就绪性。

Abstract: Contract-clause extraction benchmarks measure reference recovery, but interpreting a system for review assistance also requires measuring unnecessary output and the evidence available within categories. This paper presents a retrospective, reproducible evaluation of a fixed public RoBERTa checkpoint on CUAD's published 102-contract test split. Candidate generation is preserved from an earlier frozen run; matching errors are corrected and category thresholds are reselected on 62 training-split contracts using the original 90% recall target. The corrected operating point recovers 82.2% of reference spans at 8.2% CUAD precision. Of 30,464 returned candidate strings, 19,562 occur on questions with no annotated answer. The system answers 1,335 of 2,938 such questions, a 45.4% false-positive rate (95% contract-bootstrap interval: 43.3-47.9%). Matching candidates constitute 20.3% of returned strings, illustrating why reference-based precision and candidate-level review burden require different denominators. Only nine of 41 categories have at least 30 positive and 30 negative contracts; this count changes to 18 and two under support minima of 20 and 40. Two categories have no negative contracts, making their no-answer false-positive rates undefined. These findings describe one checkpoint, decoder, and threshold policy. Earlier test access and uncertain checkpoint training overlap limit confirmatory interpretation. The paper supplies the original and corrected analyses, predictions, and software checks as ancillary artifacts; it establishes neither a new release criterion nor production readiness.

</details>


### [524] [From Experiments to Decisions: Reusing Evidence in Autonomous Coding Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13299)
*Bobber Cheng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文在400任务NeuroGolf实验中重构证据复用方式，揭示自主编码智能体常将未经证实的结论沿用下去，并提出可检查的证据交接机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主编码智能体虽能记住实验，却会携带实验并不支持的结论。需要研究证据在后续任务中如何被复用，以及这种复用产生的错误。

Method: 重构400任务NeuroGolf行动中的证据复用，选取同一操作者的井筒预测记录作跨域对比；用数值反例暴露过宽排除；考察前缀式接受门（三阈值）；提出可检查交接（含命题、范围、候选与评估者身份、检查状态、重开条件）、调度树（调查/修复/重开/停止）与晋升谓词。

Result: 数值反例暴露了过宽的排除；部分案例区分了失败、不完整与修订后程序所支持的下一步。井筒记录显示额外弱点：协调者正确承认仅新颖性拒绝，却将其总结为已测量闭环。前缀式接受门在三阈值下目标分数低于无门控适应。

Conclusion: 实践教训是：不仅要保存实验结果，还要保存它们对后续行动的限制条件；通过可检查交接与晋升谓词，要求每项检查既通过又有证据支持其用于所请求的决策。

Abstract: Autonomous coding agents can remember an experiment yet carry forward a conclusion it does not justify. We reconstruct how evidence is reused in a 400-task NeuroGolf campaign, with selected wellbore-prediction records from the same operator as cross-domain comparisons. A numerical counterexample exposes an overbroad exclusion; other episodes distinguish what failed, incomplete and revised programs justify doing next. The wellbore records reveal an additional weakness: a coordinator correctly acknowledges a novelty-only rejection, then summarizes it as measured closure. Separately, a prefix-based acceptance gate at three thresholds yields worse target scores than ungated adaptation in the retained experiment. These cases motivate an inspectable handoff linking the tested proposition, its scope, candidate and evaluator identity, check statuses, and reopening condition. A dispatch tree separates investigation, repair, reopening and stopping; a promotion predicate requires that each check both passes and has evidence supporting its use for the requested decision. The practical lesson is to preserve not just experimental results, but their limits on subsequent action.

</details>


### [525] [SkillSeam: Six Principles for Auditing Agent Skill Collections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13321)
*Kang Ruiyuan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 SkillSeam，一种审计技能库集合关系的方法，将六条设计原则映射为可测试的失败机制与扰动实验，量化技能系统"接缝"处的失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单个技能很少独立失败，失败往往发生在技能集合的接缝处。随着技能库增长，流程竞争注意力、别名重复加载、边界模糊、粒度失当，会把路由错误转化为任务失败。然而缺乏将技能编写经验转为可测试系统属性的方法。

Method: 从一套封存技能系统中扰动六条设计原则：持久性梯度、系统一致性、状态门控、正交覆盖、流动、粒度纪律。每条原则对应特定失败机制、最强可观测量与受控扰动测试；通过失败机制预测的通道而非仅用准确率来评估。

Result: 压平持久性层级使加载技能token增60%；悬挂锚点使总token增64%、准确率降3.1pp；固定技能数与上下文，用同义别名替换无关对照使非规范路由从0/32升至15/32并翻转半数匹配复述对；所有权审计中重叠通道使冲突从0/16增至14/16；平淡触发器使路由冲突从3/32升至30/32、加载token膨胀3.7倍；一种粒度错配带来最大准确率降幅-12.5pp。

Conclusion: 将六条编写建议转化为可测试的系统属性，且不把每个探针都当作确认。发布字节差异变体、任务切片、汇总与一页设计清单，供其他技能系统测量相同失败通道。

Abstract: A folder of competent skills is not yet a reliable system. Skills rarely fail alone; they
  fail at the seams of a collection. As an agent's skill library grows, procedures compete for
  attention, aliases double-load, boundaries blur, and poorly sized skills turn routing errors
  into task failures. We introduce SkillSeam, a method that audits the relationships through
  which individual skill files become a system. It maps each collection-level principle to a
  failure mechanism, its strongest observable, and a controlled perturbation test. From one
  sealed skill system, SkillSeam perturbs six design principles: persistence gradient, system
  coherence, regime gating, orthogonal coverage, flow, and granularity discipline. Crucially,
  each principle is evaluated through the channel its failure mechanism predicts rather than
  through accuracy alone. Flattening the persistence hierarchy increases loaded-skill tokens
  by 60%; a dangling anchor raises total tokens by 64% and shifts accuracy by -3.1pp; with
  skill count and context size held fixed, replacing an unrelated control with a synonymous
  alias raises noncanonical routes from 0/32 to 15/32 and flips half of matched paraphrase
  pairs; in a candidate-ownership audit, overlapping lanes raise reported ownership conflicts
  from 0/16 to 14/16; bland triggers drive routing conflicts from 3/32 to 30/32 and inflate
  loaded-skill tokens 3.7x; and one granularity mis-mix produces the largest accuracy drop,
  -12.5pp. These outcomes turn six pieces of authoring advice into testable system properties
  without treating every probe as confirmation. We release the byte-differenced variants, task
  slices, rollups, and a one-screen design checklist so that other skill systems can measure
  the same failure channels.

</details>


### [526] [The Agentic Company OS: Substrate Inversion for Sustained Enterprise Agent Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13334)
*Oliver Aleksander Larsen,Mahyar T. Moghaddam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 企业AI智能体常在演示中成功、却在长期运行中失效。本文认为根源在于智能体推理所依赖的数据是为人类操作员和传统应用设计的，而非为语言模型设计。作者主张围绕"认知基底"（智能体读取的共享工作上下文）重建，将schema转换隔离到动作边界，并以四层框架（数据、知识、智能、治理）落地。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行业报告显示多数智能体试点无法进入生产，已部署系统很少保留反馈或持续改进；基准测试中单次成功掩盖了不可靠的重复表现。作者认为这些失败模式有共同的架构根源：智能体在为人设计的数据结构上推理，而非为LLM的推理界面设计，导致上下文带宽浪费和跨回路学习无法复合。

Method: 这是一篇立场论文（position paper）。提出两大机制：上下文带宽不对称（单次通读连贯文本 vs. 逐字段类型化访问会剥离关系）；跨回路耦合（动作、技能、策略回路只有在共享同一基底时才能复利）。提出四层框架：数据、知识、智能、治理；以Sync Agent强制执行动作边界，并采用逐技能信任梯度。同时分析主要反对意见与风险，如编译路径上的间接提示注入。Markdown被视为当下可用的实例，而非已被证明的智能体原生原语。

Result: 作为立场论文，未报告实证结果。其主要产出是：论证共享基底的必要性、提出四层可操作化框架、复活经典多智能体系统的共享基底传统（置于LLM时代经济学下）、并勾勒直接评估基底的未来研究议程。

Conclusion: 企业智能体的持续运行失败源于"认知基底"与LLM推理界面不匹配。应重建围绕匹配推理界面的表示，仅在动作边界做schema转换，使治理与可审计性成为基底的固有结构属性。

Abstract: Enterprise AI agents often succeed in a demonstration and then stall once they must operate day after day. An industry report estimates that most pilots never reach production and that deployed systems rarely retain feedback or improve over time, while agent benchmarks show single-run successes masking unreliable repetition. We argue that these failure modes share a common architectural root: agents reason over data structured for human operators and traditional applications, not for the language models that power them. This position paper proposes that companies deploying agents in sustained operation should rebuild their cognitive substrate, the shared environment agents read as working context, around representations matched to that reasoning surface, isolating schema translation to the action boundary. Markdown is the instantiation available today, not a proven agent-native primitive. Two mechanisms ground the argument: context-bandwidth asymmetry, the gap between one-pass reading of connected prose and field-by-field typed access that strips relations; and cross-loop coupling, the claim that action, skill, and policy loops compound only if they share one substrate. A four-layer framework (Data, Knowledge, Intelligence, Governance) operationalizes the position, with a Sync Agent enforcing the action boundary and a per-skill trust gradient, making governance and auditability structural properties of the substrate. The position revives the shared-substrate tradition of classical multi-agent systems under LLM-era economics. We analyze the main objections and risks, including indirect prompt injection on the compile path, and outline a research agenda for evaluating substrates directly.

</details>


### [527] [Usage Control in Public Data Exchange Infrastructures for Future Digital Governance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13450)
*Oleksandr Kosenkov,Fathiyeh Faghih,Eric Jackson,Theo Dimitrakos*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文分析公共数据交换基础设施（如爱沙尼亚X-Road）中数据使用控制（DUC）的实践挑战与需求，通过跨学科视角提出概念愿景，以实现隐私设计的未来数字治理系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共数据交换基础设施对数据密集型数字公共服务与欧盟数字经济至关重要，其下一代需要先进的数据使用控制机制来应对隐私设计等新兴需求，缓解大规模自动化数据交换中的隐私威胁。尽管各学科已有研究，但学科交叉处存在显著实践挑战。

Method: 以分析性研究为主，考察爱沙尼亚X-Road系统及新兴用例，采用跨学科视角，整合使用控制的形式化验证与监控、需求工程以及数字治理研究。

Result: 提炼出公共数据交换基础设施中数据使用控制的关键需求，并提出开发此类使用控制的概念愿景。

Conclusion: 该概念愿景旨在使未来数字治理系统能够按设计遵从隐私要求，为下一代公共数据交换基础设施的数据使用控制发展提供方向。

Abstract: Public data exchange infrastructures, such as X-Road, are essential to data-intensive digital public services and the EU digital economy. Their next generation requires advanced data usage control (DUC) mechanisms that address emerging requirements, including privacy by design, to mitigate privacy threats inherent in large-scale automated data exchange. Although research within the individual disciplines already addresses many of the emerging requirements, significant practical challenges arise at the intersection of the disciplines.
  This paper analytically examines the practical challenges and requirements of data usage control in public data exchange infrastructures. We examine the Estonian X-Road system and emerging use cases through an interdisciplinary lens that integrates formal verification and monitoring of usage control, requirements engineering, and digital governance research. We formulate key requirements and propose a conceptual vision for developing usage control in public data-exchange infrastructures to enable future digital-governance systems to comply with privacy requirements by design.

</details>


### [528] [Rethinking Software Development as a Self-Adaptive Socio-Technical System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13461)
*Javier Cámara*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出将软件开发视为一个自适应社会技术系统，其中软件项目与开发配置（参与者、职责、权限、信息、验证）随目标、证据、不确定性和风险的变化而协同演化，从而产生"演化软件"与"重构工程方式"两种耦合的自适应形式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic AI 正在扩展到各种软件工程活动中，但人机组织形式通常被视为固定的。这种固定配置在开发情境演化时可能变得次优，因此需要一种动态调整的思路。

Method: 提出将软件开发建模为自适应社会技术系统，让软件项目与开发配置（包括参与者、职责、权限、信息、验证五个维度）随目标、证据、不确定性和风险的变化而自适应调整，形成两种耦合的自适应：演化软件本身，以及重构后续工程的执行方式。作者用一个概念验证（proof of concept）来说明该想法。

Result: 通过概念验证展示了该自适应社会技术系统思想的可行性，并概述了相关挑战与未来计划。

Conclusion: 软件开发中的人机组织不应固定不变，而应随开发情境动态重构；作者呼吁关注其挑战并规划后续研究。

Abstract: Agentic AI is expanding across various software engineering activities, yet human-agent organization is typically treated as fixed, which is problematic because development configurations may become suboptimal as development context evolves. We propose viewing software development as a self-adaptive socio-technical system in which both the software project and the development configuration (participants, responsibilities, authority, information, and verification) adapt as goals, evidence, uncertainty, and risk evolve. This yields two coupled forms of adaptation: evolving the software and reconfiguring how subsequent engineering is performed. We illustrate the idea with a proof of concept, outlining challenges and future plans.

</details>


### [529] [Is Self-Admitted Technical Debt Tested? An Empirical Study of Coverage, Co-change, and Impact](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13485)
*Suzuka Yoshimoto,Kosei Horikawa,Daniel Feitosa,Yutaro Kashiwa,Hajimu Iida*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文实证研究了开源Java项目中自认技术债(SATD)与软件测试的关系，发现开发者很少同步添加测试来验证债务解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TODO/FIXME注释是开发者对代码次优的明确自认，但SATD是否真正受到软件测试的额外审查仍属未知。作者希望从三个维度刻画SATD与测试的关系：受影响代码的测试覆盖程度、开发者是否在解决债务时同步添加测试、以及这种测试对缺陷长期可观测性的影响。

Method: 对8个开源Java项目开展实证研究：分析最新版本中784个SATD实例的测试覆盖率，并对5,175个SATD移除事件进行纵向分析。

Result: 60.7%的SATD受影响代码被现有测试套件覆盖；但开发者很少在债务解决时同步修改测试，仅3.4%的移除提交包含专门针对该债务的新测试（12.5%在同一提交中附带添加测试）。纵向分析显示短期内无论是否修改测试，SATD解决的局部缺陷引入率几乎相同；但在更长观察窗口下，添加测试组的累积缺陷对齐概率反而略高（6.32% vs 4.37%），可能与复杂组件的选择性测试有关。

Conclusion: 开发者将SATD偿还视为普通代码变更而非高风险维护活动：尽管开发者自己曾标记代码次优，大多数债务移除仍缺乏针对性验证。

Abstract: When developers write a TODO or FIXME comment, they are explicitly admitting that the code is suboptimal: a built-in warning that this logic deserves extra scrutiny. Yet it is an open question whether Self-Admitted Technical Debt (SATD) actually receives that scrutiny in the form of software testing. We aim to characterize the relationship between SATD and testing across three dimensions: the extent to which SATD-affected code is covered by existing tests, whether developers synchronize test additions with debt resolution, and whether such testing affects the long-term observability of resulting defects. For that, we conducted an empirical study on eight open-source Java projects, analyzing test coverage of 784 SATD instances identified in the latest releases and performing a longitudinal examination of 5,175 SATD removal events. Our results show that while 60.7% of SATD-affected code is covered by existing test suites, developers rarely synchronize test modifications with debt resolution; manual inspection confirms that only 3.4% of SATD removal commits include new tests specifically targeting the resolved debt (vs. 12.5% that co-add tests in the same commit). Longitudinal analysis further suggests that SATD resolutions exhibit nearly identical localized bug induction rates within short-to-medium-term windows regardless of test modifications. However, over a longer, unrestricted observation window, a slight divergence emerges where the test-added group reaches a higher cumulative defect alignment probability (6.32% vs. 4.37%), a counterintuitive trend potentially driven by the selective testing of inherently complex components. Developers treat SATD repayment as an ordinary code change rather than as a high-risk maintenance activity: most debt removals proceed without targeted verification, despite the developer's own prior flag that the code is suboptimal.

</details>


### [530] [Comparative Framework Analysis for Enterprise Generative AI Applications: Chatbot, Automation, and Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Migration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13577)
*Oleg Grynets,Olena Pochernina,Alona Seletska,Daryna Tukalo,Dmytro Kostetskyi,Ivan Fedorchuk,Vasyl Lyashkevych*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究比较三类企业级生成式AI应用（文档开发助手、邮件/问询自动化、Oracle到PostgreSQL迁移工具）的框架适配性，主张按组件（而非跨应用统一）选择框架，采用概率组件生成提议、确定性组件掌权的分层架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业生成式AI应用类型差异大，框架适配性难以用单一跨应用标准衡量；需要判断框架选择应依据什么维度（部署条件、组件职责等）。

Method: 对三类应用进行对比分析，评估维度包括：组件边界、编排、策略检索/推理、模型集成、确定性验证、持久化、可观测性、运营效率。重点考察概率组件与确定性组件的职责划分。

Result: 证据支持分层架构：概率组件负责生成提议，确定性组件掌握路由、授权、验证、持久化、幂等性与最终结果裁决。搜索质量、工作流控制、安全行为、迁移验证无法由单一跨应用评估概括。

Conclusion: 框架适配性取决于具体应用、部署条件与组件职责，因此应以组件为单位选择框架，并辅以显式契约、应用专属证据与独立验证边界。

Abstract: This study compares framework suitability across three classes of enterprise generative AI applications: a documentation-based development assistant, an email and inquiry automation system, and an Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration tool. The analysis evaluates component boundaries, orchestration, policy retrieval or reasoning, model integration, deterministic validation, persistence, observability, and operational efficiency. Across the three applications, the evidence supports layered architectures in which probabilistic components generate proposals, while deterministic components retain authority over routing, authorization, validation, persistence, idempotency, and final outcomes. The results indicate that framework suitability depends on the application, deployment conditions, and component responsibility: search quality, workflow control, safety behavior, and migration validation cannot be reduced to a single cross-application assessment. Therefore, the study substantiates the need for framework selection at the component level, supported by explicit contracts, application-specific evidence, and independent validation boundaries.

</details>


### [531] [ForgeTrain: Forging Production-Grade Training Frameworks via Harness-Driven AI Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13645)
*Qingfeng He,Zhui Zhu,Shangzhan Li,Yaojian Chen,Haojun Sun,Xu Chen,Leshan Li,Yifei Shen,Changjingxing Zhao,Mengyuan Fan,Wenyu Guan,Yiyun Zheng,Yuxuan Zuo,Zhen Li,Zhenghang Luo,Yuxuan Li,Xu Han,Zhiyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出"Forge Engineering"范式，用AI为每个场景从零构建专用实现，并实例化为训练框架ForgeTrain，在多种模型-硬件配置上MFU提升4.7-33.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用框架（如Megatron-LM）存在"generality tax"（通用性税），其抽象边界限制场景特定优化并带来运行时开销。AI代码生成降低了构建框架的成本，使"每场景一个专用框架"成为可能。

Method: 从零为每个场景构建专用实现，并在正确性与可用性约束下迭代优化至峰值性能；专用实现无继承的抽象边界，可跨栈整合优化。实例化为ForgeTrain：以可信框架为黄金参考，将等价性从Bit-for-Bit单调放宽至Surpass。

Result: 在多种模型-硬件配置上，ForgeTrain持续生成正确的训练引擎，MFU相较现有训练框架提升4.7-33.2%。据称是首个由AI端到端锻造、达到或超越其人类参考的生产级训练框架。

Conclusion: 专用实现可达到更高性能上限，AI驱动的"每场景一框架"工程范式可行且有效，为训练框架设计提供新思路。

Abstract: Training large models still relies on general-purpose frameworks such as Megatron-LM, whose generality tax constrains scenario-specific optimization and adds runtime overhead through accumulated abstraction. AI code generation reduces the cost of building a framework, and makes it affordable to forge one per scenario. We propose Forge Engineering: building a dedicated implementation from scratch for each scenario and iteratively optimizing it toward peak performance under correctness and usability constraints. Dedicated implementations inherit no abstraction boundaries, so they can integrate optimizations across the stack and reach a higher performance ceiling. We instantiate this paradigm for training frameworks as ForgeTrain, which holds a trusted framework as a golden reference and relaxes equivalence monotonically from Bit-for-Bit to Surpass. Experiments across multiple model--hardware configurations show that ForgeTrain consistently produces correct training engines and improves MFU over established training frameworks by 4.7--33.2%. To our knowledge this is the first production-grade training framework forged end-to-end by AI to match or surpass its human reference.

</details>


### [532] [TyPatch: Transforming Patches into Typestate Rules for Kernel Bug Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13728)
*Ruoyu Wang,Tuo Li,Jia Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出TyPatch，将补丁的缺陷语义与分析器实现解耦：LLM把补丁翻译为typestate规则，共享后端执行分析，在Linux v6.16发现559个bug（121个被确认）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 完整checker生成要求模型同时恢复补丁的缺陷语义并实现复杂程序分析机制（对象跟踪、别名分析、路径状态维护、过程间传播），把两者耦合在一个端到端代码生成任务中，会使简单缺陷规则变成不稳定且昂贵的分析器实现问题。

Method: 解耦补丁特定缺陷语义与分析器实现。LLM将每个补丁翻译为typestate规则，指定被跟踪对象、动作、守卫、转移和违规；共享后端执行这些规则，将动作绑定到程序事件、跨别名跟踪对象标识、沿程序路径传播typestate，并为所有规则生成报告。

Result: 在Linux v6.16上，TyPatch发现559个不同bug，其中121个已被内核开发者确认。与SOTA完整checker构造流程的38个补丁匹配对比中，生成token减少88.3–90.1%，初始报告池精度为基线的3.42–14.95倍。

Conclusion: 通过将缺陷语义与分析器实现解耦，TyPatch以更低的生成成本和更高的精度从历史补丁中挖掘内核缺陷，验证了该范式的有效性。

Abstract: Historical Linux kernel patches capture defect knowledge that applies beyond their original repair sites. Recent work has shown that large language models (LLMs) can generate static-analysis checkers from historical patches and use them to uncover new kernel bugs. However, complete-checker generation requires the model both to recover the defect semantics expressed by a patch and to implement sophisticated program-analysis machinery, including object tracking, alias analysis, path-state maintenance, and interprocedural propagation. Coupling these responsibilities in a single end-to-end code-generation task can turn a simple defect rule into an unstable and expensive analyzer-implementation problem.
  To address this problem, we present TyPatch, which decouples patch-specific defect semantics from analyzer implementation. An LLM translates each patch into a typestate rule specifying its tracked object, actions, guards, transitions, and violations. A shared backend then executes these rules, binding their actions to program events, tracking object identity across aliases, propagating typestate along program paths, and producing reports for all rules. On Linux v6.16, TyPatch finds 559 distinct bugs, 121 of which have been confirmed by kernel developers. In a matched 38-patch comparison with the state-of-the-art complete-checker construction workflow, TyPatch uses 88.3-90.1% fewer generation tokens, while its initial report pools achieve 3.42-14.95$\times$ the precision of those produced by that workflow.

</details>


### [533] [Towards a faithful stochastic model for brain digital twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13973)
*Abdelhamid Rouatbi,Alexandre Muzy,Eugene Syriani*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出结合随机神经网络与马尔可夫调制泊松过程的随机模型，映射为离散事件系统规范，用于提升脑数字孪生保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑电活动涉及从单神经元到全脑区域的多个尺度机制，现有模型通常只捕捉少数机制，无法同时高保真地覆盖单神经元与神经元群体两个尺度。

Method: 提出一种随机模型，融合随机神经网络（Random Neural Networks）与马尔可夫调制泊松过程（Markov-Modulated Poisson Processes），并将其映射到离散事件系统规范（DEVS）以构建可执行仿真模型。

Result: 得到一个初步的可执行仿真模型，适合集成到脑数字孪生系统中。

Conclusion: 该模型有望提升脑数字孪生的保真度，为跨尺度脑电活动模拟提供可行方案。

Abstract: Twinning the brain means reproducing its electrical activity with fidelity. This activity arises from many neuronal mechanisms across several scales, from a single neuron to whole brain regions. Current large initiatives rely on models that each capture only a few of these mechanisms. Some act at the scale of a single neuron, others at the scale of neuronal populations. No single model captures both scales with fidelity. We propose a new stochastic model, based on a combination of Random Neural Networks and Markov-Modulated Poisson Processes, that would improve the fidelity of a brain digital twin. We map the model to the Discrete Event System Specification. This yields an initial executable simulation model suitable for incorporation into a brain digital twin.

</details>


### [534] [Introspective Uncertainty Estimation for LLM-Based Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13975)
*Thomas Klassert*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文研究基于LLM内部隐藏状态的内省不确定性估计（IUE），用于代码生成任务的正确性判断与故障定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的代码虽流畅但功能常不正确，限制了其在软件工程中的可信应用，因此需要可靠的正确性评估方法。

Method: 在LiveCodeBench和BigCodeBench上进行响应级评估，并通过增强管道从错误程序派生token级和行级标签；比较静态与动态响应级特征，评估跨任务、领域、token位置的泛化以及行级故障定位。

Result: 隐藏状态含强响应级正确性信号，静态单token探针最佳，动态策略无一致增益；跨任务/领域/位置泛化可行但真实项目仍有退化；行级预测比响应级更难，但已知错误程序下Top-K故障点排序仍有效。

Conclusion: 隐藏状态是估计代码功能正确性的稳健信息源，支持响应级风险筛查加行级优先定位的两阶段工作流。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation but can produce fluent yet functionally incorrect outputs, which limits trust in their usage for practical software engineering workflows. This thesis investigates whether Introspective Uncertainty Estimation (IUE), based on internal hidden-state representations of LLMs, can reliably indicate correctness at the response and line levels for code generation tasks. The objective is to determine the extent to which hidden states encode information about functional code correctness and how this can be leveraged for practical risk assessment and fault localization. Methodologically, this thesis combines response-level evaluation on LiveCodeBench (LCB) and BigCodeBench (BCB) with an augmentation pipeline that derives token- and line-level labels from incorrect programs. In this setup, it compares static and dynamic response-level features, evaluates generalization across tasks, programming domains, and token positions, and studies line-level fault localization.
  The results show that hidden states contain a strong response-level correctness signal. Static single-token probes perform best, while more elaborate dynamic strategies yield no consistent gains. While generalization across tasks, domains, and token positions is feasible, setting-dependent degradation largely remains for real-world software projects. At a fine granularity, line-level prediction is substantially harder than response-level estimation. However, in a conditional localization setup with known-incorrect programs, Top-K point-of-failure ranking remains effective. Overall, the findings suggest that hidden states are a robust and informative resource for estimating functional code correctness, supporting a two-stage workflow that combines response-level risk screening with targeted line-level prioritization.

</details>


### [535] [Deterministic Temporal Reconciliation for Effective-Dated Identity Lifecycle Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14017)
*Pramod Ubbala*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种确定性时间对账方法，用于处理带有生效时间的身份事件，在乱序、重复、修订、取消等情况下重建权威最终状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 身份生命周期自动化中，业务事实的“生效时间”与权威源的“最后修订时间”是两个不同概念。修正、取消、未来生效、重复投递和乱序到达会导致账户状态不一致，仅依赖传输顺序或生效时间处理会产生分歧。

Method: 方法将逻辑业务事实与其物理修订分离：去重完全重放，按事务时间新鲜度选择每个事实的权威修订，移除已取消事实，再按有效时间顺序应用存活事实。并在明确源假设下证明排列不变性、重放幂等性、修订支配性和确定性快照构建。

Result: 在25万个生成身份历史、1,585,589条投递记录的可复现合成故障注入基准中，所提方法在所有测试案例都重建出单独保留的权威最终状态。75%投递乱序时，精确状态准确率为：到达顺序42.35%、有效时间排序85.38%、事务时间排序76.61%、所提方法100%。另有4万次排列实验中，所有排列在该对账契约下均产生相同最终状态。

Conclusion: 该确定性时间对账方法能有效解决身份事件在乱序、重复和修订场景下的状态分歧问题，在合成基准上显著优于按到达顺序、有效时间或事务时间处理的方案，并具备排列不变和重放幂等保证。

Abstract: Identity lifecycle automation processes workforce changes that carry two distinct notions of time: when a business fact becomes effective and when an authoritative source last revised it. Corrections, cancellations, future-dated changes, duplicate delivery, and out-of-order arrival can therefore produce divergent account states when processors rely on transport order or effective time alone. This paper presents a deterministic temporal reconciliation method for effective-dated identity events. The method separates logical business facts from their physical revisions, deduplicates exact replays, selects the authoritative revision of each fact using transaction-time freshness, removes canceled facts, and then applies surviving facts in valid-time order. We establish permutation invariance, replay idempotence, revision dominance, and deterministic snapshot construction under explicit source assumptions. A reproducible synthetic fault-injection benchmark compares the method with arrival-order, effective-time, and transaction-time processing. Across 250,000 generated identity histories and 1,585,589 delivered records, the proposed method reconstructed the separately retained authoritative final state in all tested cases. At 75% delivery disorder, exact-state accuracy was 42.35% for arrival-order processing, 85.38% for effective-time sorting, 76.61% for transaction-time sorting, and 100% for the proposed method. A separate 40,000-permutation experiment produced the same final state for every tested permutation under the proposed reconciliation contract.

</details>


### [536] [Yesterday's Interviews for Today's Engineers: Retrospective Perceptions and a Work-Aligned Hiring Framework (2005-2026)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14046)
*Vitalii Romaniuk*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文回顾2005—2026年软件工程招聘的四个阶段，指出面试负担不断扩张而所考知识虽多具岗位相关性却仍可能构成无效流程，并提出基于票据的务实评估框架（Ticket-Based Pragmatic Assessment Framework）以重构招聘评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 技术招聘已自成技能体系，候选人需为与岗位仅部分相似的流程做准备；作者试图解释为何“考的内容与工作相关”与“流程仍可能无效”并不矛盾，并为招聘评估提供可操作的规范框架。
