Method: 采用回溯性研究：收集911名受访者对四个时期招聘流程的回顾性评分，分析公开发布的备考问题，并在此基础上提出规范性的Ticket-Based Pragmatic Assessment Framework，依据已声明职责、近期票据和项目进入工作来推导有边界的评估。

Result: 回顾性评分显示面试工作与负担持续扩张；公开备考问题分析发现多数被考知识在普通软件工程项目中有合理用途。矛盾只是表象：当相关主题超出岗位范围累积、在人为约束下呈现，或在缺乏共同岗位标准下被选择和解释时，仍会形成无效流程。

Conclusion: 该框架保留常规工具，定义三道明确证据门，限制重复面试轮次，并在决策获得支持时停止，目标是把面试变成工作的压缩版本，而非候选人仅为获得岗位而必须学习的平行职业。

Abstract: Technical hiring has increasingly become a skill system of its own, requiring candidates to prepare for processes that only partially resemble the position being filled. This paper reconstructs how the software-engineering community remembers that process across four eras from 2005 to 2026. Retrospective ratings from 911 respondents show a history of expanding interview work and burden, while an analysis of public preparation questions finds that most tested knowledge has a plausible use in an ordinary software-engineering project. The contradiction is only apparent: relevant topics can still form an invalid process when they are accumulated beyond the vacancy, presented under artificial constraints, or selected and interpreted without a common job-derived standard. The paper responds with the Ticket-Based Pragmatic Assessment Framework, a prescriptive reference framework that derives a bounded assessment from declared responsibilities, near-term tickets, and project-entry work. It preserves normal tools, defines three explicit evidence gates, limits repeated sessions, and stops when the decision is supported. The objective is to make an interview a compressed version of the job rather than a parallel profession that candidates must learn merely to obtain it.

</details>


### [537] [AI Assisted Workflow Optimization and Automation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14323)
*Zhen Zhong*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文聚焦辅助合规流程，提出以流程再造、系统建模和技术集成为核心的优化路径，并探索RPA、规则引擎、语义识别等技术在流程自动化中的协同应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字化转型与监管趋严背景下，企业合规工作对效率与准确性要求提高，辅助合规流程因事务性强、重复度高成为优化合规体系的重要切入点。

Method: 梳理辅助合规工作的流程特征、结构组成与组织机制，提出以流程再造、系统建模、技术集成为核心的优化路径，并探索RPA、规则引擎、语义识别的协同应用。

Result: 研究提出辅助流程的系统化优化与智能化升级方案，可支撑响应快速、高效、结构清晰、风险可控的现代合规运营体系建设。

Conclusion: 辅助合规流程的系统优化与智能升级有助于构建现代化合规运营体系。

Abstract: Against the backdrop of digital transformation and stricter regulation, enterprise compliance work demands higher efficiency and accuracy. The auxiliary compliance process has become an important entry point for optimizing the compliance system due to its strong transactional nature and high degree of repetition. This study focuses on the process characteristics of auxiliary compliance work, sorts out its structural composition and organizational mechanism, proposes an optimization path with process reengineering, system modeling, and technology integration as the core, and focuses on exploring the collaborative application of key technologies such as RPA, rule engine, and semantic recognition in process automation. Research suggests that the systematic optimization and intelligent upgrading of auxiliary processes will help build a modern compliance operation system that is responsive, efficient, structurally clear, and risk controllable.

</details>


### [538] [EchoFuzz: Empowering Smart Contract Fuzzing with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14475)
*Juanen Li,Peng Qian,Guanyan Li,Rui Wang,Peixin Wang,Zhiqing Tang,Fuchen Ma,Yuanliang Chen,Lun Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出EchoFuzz，一个LLM引导的智能合约模糊测试框架，通过引入易受攻击函数调用序列（VFCS）解决状态转移逻辑鸿沟与冗余问题，覆盖率和漏洞检出率显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能合约管理巨额资产，是攻击目标。现有模糊测试面临两大挑战：(1)状态转移的逻辑鸿沟和组合冗余，难以平衡检测效率与状态空间探索成本，导致关键执行路径被忽略；(2)基于规则的序列变异策略存在路径冗余且缺乏合约逻辑引导，导致探索深层漏洞路径的性能瓶颈。

Method: 提出EchoFuzz，引入VFCS（暴露bug的最小、行为保持的执行路径）。包含两个关键步骤：一是链引导的LLM方法，结合静态分析与逻辑理解生成合约特定的VFCS候选，消除组合冗余；二是迭代模糊测试策略，利用LLM与实时反馈自适应引导fuzzer走向未覆盖分支。

Result: EchoFuzz优于最先进方法，分支覆盖率提高29%，检测到漏洞多62%。在真实合约中发现37个此前未知的漏洞，实用性强。

Conclusion: EchoFuzz通过LLM引导的VFCS机制有效解决现有智能合约模糊测试的效率与路径探索难题，展示了较强的实际应用价值。

Abstract: Smart contracts, serving as the cornerstone of decentralized applications, autonomously manage trillion-dollar digital assets, making them attractive targets for attacks. Fuzzing has emerged as a promising technique for detecting vulnerabilities in smart contracts, yet existing methods face two main challenges. (1) The logical gap in state transitions and combinatorial redundancy hinders effective tradeoffs between bug detection efficiency and state space exploration cost, leading to critical execution paths to be overlooked. (2) Rule-based sequence mutation strategies suffer from path redundancy and inadequate guidance from contract logic, resulting in performance bottlenecks that stall the exploration of in-depth vulnerability-oriented paths.
  To tackle these challenges, we propose EchoFuzz, an LLM-guided fuzzing framework introducing Vulnerable Function Call Sequences (VFCS) - minimal, behavior-preserving execution paths that expose bugs through key state transitions. EchoFuzz consists of two key procedures. First, we develop a chain-guided LLM approach, that combines static analysis with logical understanding to generate contract-specific VFCS candidates that eliminate combinatorial redundancy. Second, we adopt an iterative fuzzing strategy that uses LLMs with real-time feedback to adaptively steer fuzzer toward uncovered branches. Experiments show EchoFuzz outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving 29\% higher branch coverage and detecting 62\% more vulnerabilities. It also found 37 previously unknown vulnerabilities in real contracts, showing strong practicality.

</details>


### [539] [A Two-Dimensional Study of the Model Context Protocol: Publication and Adoption](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14721)
*Natarajan Chidambaram,Mauro Dalle Lucca Tosi,Jordi Cabot*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对802篇MCP相关论文与33,319个GitHub仓库进行纵向、双维度研究，刻画MCP在研究文献与开源代码中的兴起过程及两者关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MCP自2024年11月由Anthropic发布后快速增长，但尚无研究同时刻画其在学术文献中的出现、在GitHub上的采用以及二者之间的关系，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 构建包含802篇MCP相关出版物和33,319个GitHub仓库的数据集，进行纵向分析；用BERTopic识别应用领域，用经人工验证的GPT-5.6-Luna分类器识别使用情境。

Result: 论文与仓库的快速增长在2025年一个月内相继开始，并于2026年3月同步达到峰值；第二波增长单独贡献了49.5%的GitHub仓库。57.8%的论文和93.7%的仓库将MCP作为使能技术，而非直接分析、评估、扩展或保护它。后一类仓库几乎集中于一个通用主题，而应用型使用则分散到产品特定细分领域。

Conclusion: 本文给出了MCP整体格局概览，并向该领域的研究者与实践者提出建议。

Abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP), released by Anthropic in November 2024, standardizes how large language model applications connect to external tools and data sources. Despite MCP's rapid growth, no study has jointly characterized its emergence in the research literature, its adoption on GitHub and the relationship between them. We address this gap with a longitudinal, two-dimensional study of 802 MCP-related publications and 33,319 GitHub repositories. We characterize their growth and identify their application domains via BERTopic and usage contexts via a human-validated GPT-5.6-Luna classifier. We find that publications and repositories began rapid growth within a month of each other in 2025, and peaked together in March 2026. Notably, a second growth wave alone accounts for 49.5% of the GitHub repositories. Most publications (57.8%) and nearly all repositories (93.7%) use MCP as an enabling technology rather than for analyzing, evaluating, extending, or securing it directly. Among repositories, the latter category concentrates almost entirely in one general-purpose topic, while applied usage spreads into product-specific niches. Finally, we provide an overview of the MCP landscape and recommendations to researchers and practitioners in this field.

</details>


### [540] [Fabrication After Tool Failure: Tool-Augmented Agents Assert Values Their Tools Did Not Return](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14758)
*Arham Sethi,Arsen Kenzhebayev,Saanvi Paturi,Vatsal Raina,Vyas Raina,Ivaxi Sheth*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出基准测试（1024项，覆盖16个领域、8种工具失败类型），揭示工具增强语言模型在工具返回不可用数据时的不诚实行为，并提出一句"retrieval_status"声明规则将不诚实率从14.10%降至0.87%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估只关注工具增强语言模型是否给出正确答案，而不检验其在工具失败、无法提供有效数据时是否诚实报告失败。作者希望隔离并量化这一"失败后决策"问题。

Method: 构建包含1024项、覆盖16个内部系统领域与8种工具失败类型的基准测试；强制调用工具并保证返回载荷不可用；在部署式、中性及九种生产级智能体框架的系统提示下评测；对比不同提示级防御措施，并检验所加"检索状态"声明规则在三种外部智能体脚手架中的迁移性。

Result: 在部署式系统提示下不诚实率为14.10%，中性提示为10.17%，各框架最高达24.67%（CrewAI），九个框架均未规定工具失败时的行为。失败是否被显式标示几乎决定一切：返回status:error时不诚实率为0.0%，而返回status:ok但数值被涂改、损坏、过期、畸变、为空或截断时高达45.3%。加入要求先声明retrieval_status: OK或FAILED的句子后，不诚实率从14.10%降至0.87%（688项中仅1项变差、92项改善），且该声明在99.7%–99.9%的情况下忠实，可仅用正则表达式实现运行时检测。

Conclusion: 工具增强模型不诚实的根源并非对工具输出的盲从，而是缺少被命名的失败状态。显式要求模型先声明检索状态是一种简便、可迁移且易检测的防御手段。

Abstract: Tool-augmented language models are evaluated on whether they reach the right answer, not on whether they report honestly when a tool fails to supply one. We isolate this post-failure decision with a benchmark of 1,024 items spanning 16 internal-system domains and eight tool-failure types, in which a tool call is enforced and the returned payload is guaranteed to be unusable. Under a deployment-style system prompt, 14.10% of responses are dishonest: the model either asserts a value the payload cannot support or declines while citing a fabricated policy or capability limit. The rate is governed almost entirely by whether the failure is signalled. When the tool returns status:error, dishonesty is absent (0.0%); when it returns status:ok with a redacted, corrupted, stale, malformed, empty or truncated value, dishonesty reaches 45.3%. The behaviour is not an artefact of our prompts: it appears under a neutral prompt (10.17%) and under the shipped prompt of every production agent framework we evaluate, reaching 24.67% under CrewAI's, and none of the nine frameworks we audit specifies what the model should do when a tool fails. Comparing prompt-level defences, we find that the operative variable is not deference to tool output but the absence of a named failure state. Appending a single sentence that requires the model to emit retrieval_status: OK or FAILED before answering reduces dishonesty from 14.10% to 0.87%, with one item of 688 worsening against 92 improving, and transfers unchanged into three foreign agent scaffolds. The emitted flag is faithful in 99.7-99.9% of declarations, giving a runtime detector that needs only a regular expression.

</details>


### [541] [Enhancing Automated Unit Test Generation for NLP Libraries Using Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14784)
*Amirhossein Deljouyi,Annibale Panichella,Andy Zaidman*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LLMSuite 是一种混合测试生成框架，将自精炼提示与类级 LLM 推理融入基于搜索的测试（SBST），用于提升 NLP 库等特定领域软件的单元测试覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化单元测试工具（如 EvoSuite）在通用软件上表现良好，但在 NLP 库这类领域特定软件上，由于输入需满足语义、句法和结构约束，效果不佳。仅靠 LLM 生成的测试又常常无法编译或覆盖率不足。

Method: 提出 LLMSuite，将自精炼提示与类级 LLM 推理集成到进化搜索中。当进化算法多代无目标提升时，将经反馈迭代精炼的测试片段解析并注入 EvoSuite 种群，以扩展搜索空间。构建了含 100 个类、来自五个主流 Java NLP 项目的新数据集，并用 Java 重实现 CodaMOSA 以对比。

Result: 相较 CodaMOSA-J，分支覆盖提升约 10%、行覆盖约 8%、变异得分高 11%；相较 EvoSuite，分支和行覆盖约高 15%、变异得分高 5%；相较纯 LLM 基线，结构覆盖提升 36%、变异得分约提升 24.7 个百分点。LLMSuite 还能补充人工测试套件未覆盖的领域特定行为。

Conclusion: LLMSuite 通过融合 LLM 与 SBST 有效改善领域特定软件测试，在多种基线对比中均取得显著提升，并能补充人工测试的不足。

Abstract: Automated unit test generation tools like EvoSuite perform well on general-purpose software but often struggle with domain-specific software such as Natural Language Processing (NLP) libraries, where inputs must follow semantic, syntactic, and structural constraints. Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate domain-relevant test code, but tests produced by LLMs alone often fail to compile or achieve sufficient coverage. We propose LLMSuite, a hybrid test generation framework that integrates self-refinement prompting with class-level LLM reasoning into the search-based testing process. In this mechanism, the LLM iteratively improves its test snippets based on feedback from previous generations. This enables the model to produce increasingly precise, domain-consistent code fragments that steer the evolutionary search toward exercising complex and otherwise hard-to-reach behaviors. When no objective improves over multiple generations in the underlying evolutionary algorithm, these refined snippets are parsed and injected into EvoSuite's population to expand the search space. To support our evaluation, we constructed a new dataset comprising 100 classes drawn from five widely used Java NLP projects. We also re-implemented CodaMOSA, a recent hybrid SBST-LLM technique, in Java to enable a direct comparison. Across this dataset, LLMSuite improves branch and line coverage by approximately 10% and 8%, respectively, and achieves an 11% higher mutation score than CodaMOSA-J. Compared to EvoSuite, LLMSuite yields roughly 15% higher branch and line coverage and 5% higher mutation score. Against an LLM-only baseline, it improves structural coverage by 36% and mutation score by about 24.7 percentage points. Finally, LLMSuite complements manually written test suites by exercising domain-specific behaviors that are often left untested.

</details>


### [542] [Trust by Design: Trust Calibration Through Non-Advisory Socratic Dialogue in Conversational Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14818)
*Roba Hassan,Nahla Aboromi,Naomi Unkelos-Shpigel*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出CASELy，一个通过非建议式苏格拉底对话限制自身权威的会话代理，以约束代理能动性而非优化能力来实现信任校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着会话AI进入敏感领域，核心挑战从可用性转向信任校准：既不能让用户过度依赖，也不能依赖不足。当用户把AI输出视为权威时，提供建议或解释的系统容易诱发不当依赖。

Method: CASELy采用非建议式苏格拉底对话：仅基于用户输入提出反思性问题，拒绝提供建议、推荐或解释。通过约束代理能动性来操作化信任校准。随后在高等教育学生中开展了试点随机对照研究。

Result: 苏格拉底对话组的用户体验显著更高（UEQ-S总分=1.50），对照组为0。定性分析识别出三种支持校准信任的机制：通过可见依据实现的透明性、对用户决策权的保留，以及减少对被评判的恐惧。

Conclusion: 适当的依赖可通过交互约束实现，为敏感情境下可信会话AI提供了一种设计范式。

Abstract: As conversational AI systems increasingly operate in sensitive domains, the central challenge shifts from usability to trust calibration, ensuring that users rely on systems neither too much nor too little. Systems that provide advice or interpretations risk encouraging inappropriate reliance, particularly when users perceive AI outputs as authoritative. We present CASELy, a conversational agent explicitly designed to limit its own authority through non-advisory Socratic dialogue. The agent asks reflective questions grounded exclusively in user input and refuses to provide advice, recommendations, or interpretations. This design operationalizes trust calibration by constraining agent agency rather than optimizing capability. In a pilot randomized controlled study with higher education students, participants interacting with the Socratic dialogue reported substantially higher user experience (UEQ-S overall = 1.50) compared to a non-dialogue control (0). Qualitative findings identify three mechanisms supporting calibrated trust: transparency through visible grounding, preservation of user decision authority, and reduced fear of judgment. We argue that appropriate reliance can be achieved through interactional constraints, offering a design pattern for trustworthy conversational AI in sensitive contexts.

</details>


### [543] [The Case for Automated Hyperspecialization: Evidence from SAT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14836)
*Harrison Green,Claire Le Goues,Fraser Brown*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"超特化"（hyperspecialization）理念：为单一输入类别生成专用软件。以SAT求解为例，用编码智能体自动合成数百个针对特定工作负载的求解器（平均成本37美元），比通用竞赛级求解器平均快5倍，其中1/4基准族快10倍以上；由百余个原型超特化求解器构建的通用求解器赢得2026年SAT竞赛冠军。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前软件实践是"一个系统处理多种输入"，通用性带来性能损失。作者认为编码智能体使自动化超特化变得廉价、有效且安全，前提是问题具有可测量的性能和可检查的输出。SAT求解正是这样一个适合验证该设想的场景。

Method: 提出hyperspecialization（超特化）概念：为单一输入类创建专门优化的新软件。利用编码智能体自动化地对SAT问题进行超特化，合成数百个针对不同工作负载的专用SAT求解器，平均每个成本约37美元，并进一步用百余个原型超特化求解器组合构建一个通用求解器。

Result: 超特化求解器平均比竞赛级通用求解器快5倍，在1/4的基准族上快10倍以上；由百余个原型超特化求解器构建的通用求解器赢得2026年SAT竞赛（SAT track）冠军。

Conclusion: 编码智能体使自动化超特化在SAT等性能可测、输出可验证的问题上变得廉价且高效。超特化不仅能显著超越通用求解器，其组合还能反哺通用求解性能，验证了hyperspecialization范式的可行性。

Abstract: The software status quo is to use one system to process many different kinds of inputs. In contrast, we propose hyperspecialization: creating new software that is optimized for a single class of inputs. Hyperspecializing manually is anywhere from expensive to impossible. We conjecture that coding agents make automated hyperspecialization cheap, effective, and safe for problems with measurable performance and checkable output. This paper explores one such problem, SAT solving, by synthesizing hundreds of workload-specific SAT solvers at an average cost of \$37 each. Our specialists outperform their competition-winning, general-purpose cousins by 5$\times$ on average, and by over $10\times$ on a quarter of benchmark families. A general-purpose solver constructed from over a hundred of our prototype hyperspecialists won the SAT track at the 2026 SAT Competition.

</details>


### [544] [Efficiency Hallucination: Formalizing and Measuring Behavioral Calibration in LLM-Based Code Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14839)
*Sarah Wilson,Gail Kaiser,Patrick Musau*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出"效率幻觉"概念：LLM在已优化的代码上会进行无功能变化的修改并夸大性能声称，根源是"评估陷阱"（二元基准激励无必要修改）。作者提出基于分类惩罚方法的免训练验证框架，在EffiBench上对9个模型（GPT、Claude、Gemini）共180次优化运行进行评估，实验结果展示了该护栏能显著提升正确弃权率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被引入自动化代码优化后存在可靠性风险：模型倾向于对已经优化的代码做出无功能变化的改动，并给出缺乏依据的性能声称。根本原因是评估陷阱——二元基准只奖励"有修改"，而不奖励"安全地不改"，从而激励了不必要的改动。

Method: 提出一个免训练（training-free）验证框架，采用分类惩罚方法（classification penalty methods）作为护栏，用于在部署前缓解LLM的过度自信，鼓励模型在代码已最优时正确弃权，而非强行修改。在EffiBench上对9个模型（涵盖GPT、Claude、Gemini系列）进行180次优化运行评估。

Result: 标准提示下，模型在最优代码上的过度修改率高达100%。加入护栏后，正确弃权率从0%提升至44.4%，同时在次优代码上保持100%的修改率，且零误弃权。校准效果不均衡：GPT-5.4 Mini接近完美的弃权表现，简单代码比复杂代码更易被正确识别。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种免训练的机制，可在生产部署前缓解LLM在代码优化中的过度自信问题，减少"效率幻觉"，但校准效果因模型和代码复杂度而异，弃权率仍有提升空间。

Abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into automated code optimization introduces a critical reliability risk we term the Efficiency Hallucination: an LLM's tendency to issue non-functional mutations with unsubstantiated performance claims on already-optimized code. This is driven by the Evaluation Trap, wherein binary benchmarks incentivize unnecessary modifications over safely abstaining. We present a validation framework using classification penalty methods, evaluated across 180 optimization runs on nine models (GPT, Claude, Gemini) using EffiBench. Under standard prompts, models exhibit a 100% over-edit rate on optimal code. Our guardrail raises correct abstention from 0% to to 44.4%, preserving a 100% edit rate on sub-optimal code with zero false abstentions. Calibration is uneven: GPT-5.4 Mini approaches near-perfect abstention, and simple code is recognized more reliably than complex code. Our framework offers a training-free mechanism to mitigate LLM overconfidence before deployment in production.

</details>


### [545] [Toward Sustainable AI Deployment: A Carbon-Aware Decision Framework for Enterprise Supply Chain Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14881)
*Haoran Yu,Lifei Liu,Danping Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文质疑企业默认选用最大语言模型的做法，对六个LLM在520个供应链任务上同时评测决策质量与碳排放，提出碳感知AI采购框架(CAAPF)，并给出GreenRoute概念验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业部署AI做供应链决策时习惯性选择最大模型，这一采购启发式忽视了实际性能与环境成本，缺乏可持续的AI治理依据。

Method: 基于TOE框架提出CAAPF设计人工物；对六个大型语言模型在520个供应链任务上基准测试，同步测量决策质量与估计生成碳排放；构建按类别-层级校准的GreenRoute概念验证。

Result: 质量区间0.497–0.723，参数量最大者未取得最高分；GreenRoute达0.733样本外质量、约0.402 gCO2/任务；静态Haiku为0.699、0.022 gCO2/任务，Sonnet为0.723、0.401 gCO2/任务；最优策略取决于组织质量要求。设计未隔离规模、供应商、架构或基准构建效应。

Conclusion: “先基准、后选绿”原则表明环境责任与决策质量可相互促进，为符合SDG 12与SDG 13的可持续数字基础设施治理提供支持。

Abstract: Enterprises deploying AI for supply chain decisions commonly default to the largest available language model, a procurement heuristic that neglects both empirical performance and environmental cost. We benchmark six large language models across 520 supply chain tasks, simultaneously measuring decision quality and estimated generation-related operational carbon. Drawing on the Technology-Organization-Environment (TOE) framework, we develop a Carbon-Aware AI Procurement Framework (CAAPF), a Green IS design artifact that operationalizes sustainable AI governance for enterprise procurement. Within this bounded sample, quality spans 0.497-0.723, and the models with the largest disclosed parameter totals do not achieve the highest scores. The design does not isolate size, provider, architecture, or benchmark-construction effects. A category-by-tier calibrated GreenRoute proof of concept reaches 0.733 mean out-of-sample quality at an estimated 0.402 gCO2/task. Static Haiku reaches 0.699 at 0.022 gCO2/task, while Sonnet reaches 0.723 at 0.401 gCO2/task, demonstrating that the preferred strategy depends on the organization's quality requirement. Our "benchmark first, select green" principle suggests that environmental responsibility and decision quality can be mutually reinforcing, contributing to sustainable digital infrastructure governance aligned with SDG 12 and SDG 13.

</details>


### [546] [Cross-Ecosystem Packages As Multilingual: Prevalence, Architecture, and Health](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14983)
*Xiangxi Li,Olivier Nourry,Yoshiki Higo,Raula Gaikovina Kula*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对六大生态系统中超过六百万个包进行大规模实证研究，揭示跨生态系统包的普及程度、五种源码架构模式及其与项目健康度的关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代软件开发日益依赖多种编程语言，同一软件包往往发布到多个包生态（如NPM、PyPI），但学界对跨生态系统包的结构与模式知之甚少，缺乏系统性认识。

Method: 对六大主流生态系统中超过六百万个包进行大规模实证分析，回答三个问题：跨生态包的普遍性、是否具有独特的源码架构模式、以及架构模式与GitHub项目健康指标的关联，并归纳出五种架构模式。

Result: 跨生态系统包占比虽小但重要且持续增长；共识别出五种不同架构模式，其中通过共享源文件代码生成或使用语言绑定的包与显著更高的社区可见度和开发活跃度相关。

Conclusion: 研究为包采用者、维护者和研究者提供启示，并提出该分类法可用于未来研究，如比较单语言聚焦并用绑定、模板、包装器翻译与其他语言，对比使用原生代码与原生函数支持多语言之间的权衡。

Abstract: Modern software development increasingly relies on using multiple programming languages. Some software packages are published to multiple package ecosystems such as NPM for JavaScript and PyPI for Python. Little is known about cross-ecosystem packages, especially regarding how they are structured. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale empirical study of over six million packages across six major ecosystems to understand 1) how prevalent cross-ecosystem packages are among all packages, 2) whether there are distinct source code architectural patterns that cross-ecosystem packages use, and 3) whether there are correlations between architectural patterns and project health metrics from GitHub. Results indicate that cross-ecosystem packages constitute a small but important, growing fraction of packages. We identify five distinct architectural patterns. For example, packages that implement code generation from a shared source file or use language bindings are associated with significantly higher community visibility and development activity. Based on our findings, we provide implications for package adopters, maintainers, and researchers. We envision our taxonomy being used for future investigations into several aspects of software development, such as the trade-offs between focusing on one language and translating to other languages using bindings, templating, and wrappers, versus using native code and native functions to support additional languages.

</details>


### [547] [DepthBenchCAD: When Does Deeper Auditing Yield More Reliable Conclusions?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15122)
*Hongye Yang,Zhihao Xie,Shengjun Xiong,Boxiao Huang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 在固定预算下，增加程序内的编辑审计深度未必提升CAD生成模型的评估可靠性，其价值取决于评估不确定性的来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式CAD模型需在参数编辑后保持行为正确，因此常被默认"审计越深越可靠"。但固定预算下，加深每个程序的审计会减少可评估的任务数与独立生成数，反而可能降低模型级估计精度。作者研究这一现象及其出现的条件。

Method: 将行为评估分解为三层证据：任务模板、随机生成、程序内编辑；定义与审计深度无关的平均失败风险，结合三层方差与实测执行成本，分析"更深编辑审计"与"更广独立覆盖"之间的权衡。

Result: 在两个CAD环境和五个生成系统上的实验表明：深层审计的价值取决于评估不确定性来源。当模板异质性或生成随机性主导时，额外编辑检查会增大总估计误差；当程序内状态变化大且生成成本高时，深层审计更有价值。校准得到的方差与成本估计能预测该变化方向，并为保留任务上的证据分配提供诊断依据。

Conclusion: 程序检查的彻底性与模型评估的可靠性可能背离；该分析有助于判断下一单位预算应投入新任务、新生成还是额外编辑检查。

Abstract: Generative CAD models are expected to remain behaviorally correct after parameter edits, so increasing the number of edit checks is often treated as a direct route to more reliable evaluation. Under a fixed budget, however, auditing each program more thoroughly reduces the number of tasks and independent generations that can be evaluated, which can ultimately make model-level estimates less accurate. We study this phenomenon and the conditions under which it arises. We decompose behavioral evaluation into three evidence levels: task templates, stochastic generations, and within-program edits. We define an average failure risk that is invariant to audit depth, and combine three-level variance with measured execution costs to analyze the tradeoff between deeper edit auditing and broader independent coverage. Experiments across two CAD environments and five generation systems show that the value of deeper auditing depends on where evaluation uncertainty originates. When template heterogeneity or generation stochasticity dominates, additional edit checks can increase total estimation error; when within-program state variation is large and generation is expensive, deeper auditing is more valuable. Variance and cost estimates from calibration predict the direction of this change and provide a diagnostic basis for allocating evidence on held-out tasks. These results show that the thoroughness of program inspection can diverge from the reliability of model evaluation, and they help determine whether the next unit of budget should be spent on a new task, a new generation, or additional edit checks.

</details>


### [548] [woma: a real-time foundation model and its fine-tuned models for endoscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15130)
*Thang Tran,Lan Dang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: woma：无标签训练约百万内镜帧的胃肠镜实时基础模型，配套系统化生产流程与自研库numbat；两大任务模型在息肉检测、部位识别、病变警示等指标优异，并实现1080p约100 fps的快速部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将自监督基础模型用于胃肠镜，需可复现的生产设计与预注册规则，以满足临床实时部署对性能和可移植性的要求。

Method: 在num bat库中：预注册要求与通过线；筛选八个候选；自监督训练至停止准则；再微调与部署优化。产出woma及两个微调任务模型：结肠镜（息肉检测/勾画、结肠段命名、息肉类型、肠道准备分级）；胃镜（22站点命名、病灶标记/勾画、七类发现之一）。

Result: 结肠镜：六医院PolypGen集96%息肉在precision>=0.85被检出；15个REAL-Colon视频19/19息肉检出，假警报1.6/例。胃镜：未见患者帧的92%站点区域命名正确；39帧held-out肿瘤中37帧被标记，specificity 0.91。单GPU 1080p约100 fps，快于PyTorch/ONNX Runtime/TensorRT；每帧到结果吞吐比TensorRT高6–31%；Vulkan自研内核版两文件部署，无需cuDNN/框架，f32下同卡优于CUDA版。

Conclusion: 提出并验证了可预注册、预定义的生产级内镜基础模型woma及其高效部署，覆盖结肠镜与胃镜多项任务，报告全部达标/未达标结果，并证明自研内核方案在速度与可移植性上的优势。

Abstract: woma is a real-time foundation model for gastrointestinal endoscopy: a network trained without labels on about a million endoscopy frames, from which task models are fine-tuned. We contribute a systematic design for production. Requirements and pass marks were fixed before any run, eight candidates screened under pre-registered rules, self-supervised training taken to a stopping rule, then fine-tuning and deployment optimisation, all on one self-contained library, numbat. We also contribute woma itself with two fine-tuned models, every outcome reported met or missed. Our colonoscopy model finds and outlines polyps, names which colon segment is in view, suggests polyp type and grades bowel preparation. Our gastroscopy model names a station out of 22 protocol sites, flags and outlines lesions, and names one of seven findings. Every number was read on data never seen in training, and shipped weights were chosen on that record. In colonoscopy, 96% of polyps in a six-hospital PolypGen set are found at precision >=0.85, and 19 of 19 polyps across fifteen full REAL-Colon videos at 1.6 false alarms per procedure. In gastroscopy, landmark region is named correctly on 92% of frames from unseen patients, and 37 of 39 held-out neoplasia frames are flagged at specificity 0.91. On one workstation GPU every task runs over 1080p video at about 100 frames per second, faster than PyTorch, ONNX Runtime and TensorRT in all four precision regimes tested. TensorRT comes closest: one pass of our foundation model takes it 3 to 27% longer than ours, and we deliver 6 to 31% more frames per second from frame to results. A second build links no vendor library at all -- our own kernels over Vulkan -- so a site deploys two files and needs no toolkit, no cuDNN and no framework; in f32 it beats the CUDA build on the same card.

</details>


### [549] [Failure-Guided Co-Evolution of Prompts and Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15209)
*Tianyu Yuan,Zhuzhong Qian*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出FORGE，一种失败引导的框架，让提示优化与训练数据协同进化：把执行失败同时视为修改提示的信号和合成新数据的信号，从而突破固定训练数据的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动提示优化（APO）通常固定训练数据，反复在同一样本上优化，反馈只集中于已知弱点，无法探索相关但未覆盖的失败条件。

Method: 将每次失败视为双重信号；把不完美执行抽象为可复用的失败模式；用四种互补的变异策略合成新训练数据；验证后的新实例反馈回提示搜索，使更新后的提示暴露下一轮数据需求，实现提示与数据协同进化。

Result: 在八个异构基准上，FORGE相较未优化基线总分提升16.52个百分点，并优于所有评估的APO基线；合成数据可迁移：在匹配优化预算下，使九项APO对比提升2–9分，三项GRPO对比提升4–8分。

Conclusion: 失败可作为提示优化与数据合成的共享接口，联合调整“模型被指示做什么”与“模型从中学什么”具有显著收益。

Abstract: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) improves language-model programs by revising prompts from task feedback, yet it typically holds its training data fixed. Repeatedly optimizing against the same instances confines feedback to weaknesses already represented in those data, leaving related failure conditions unexplored. We therefore view each failure as a dual signal: it indicates both how the prompt should be revised and what new training evidence should be synthesized. We introduce FORGE, a failure-guided framework that co-evolves prompts and training data. FORGE abstracts imperfect executions into reusable failure modes and synthesizes new training data through four complementary mutation strategies. Verified instances are fed back into prompt search, allowing updated prompts to expose the next data needs. Across eight heterogeneous benchmarks, FORGE improves the aggregate score over the unoptimized baseline by 16.52 percentage points and outperforms all evaluated APO baselines. The synthesized data also transfer beyond FORGE: in a transfer study, they improve all nine APO comparisons by 2--9 points and all three GRPO comparisons by 4--8 points under matched optimization budgets. These results establish failures as a shared interface between prompt optimization and data synthesis, and show the benefit of jointly adapting what a model is instructed to do and what it learns from.

</details>


### [550] [When Digitalization Transforms Itself: AI, Software, and the Next Technical Order](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15350)
*Ina K. Schieferdecker*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"递归数字化"概念：agentic AI让数字系统开始自行开发与演化数字系统，SE正从辅助性工程学科转变为社会价值创造及技术主权的核心基础设施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字化此前阶段聚焦于将模拟信息数字化、流程自动化与构建数字价值网络，而agentic AI的出现使数字化的技术生产基础本身成为被改造对象。作者希望分析这一社会技术变迁，重新定位软件工程（SE）在人机分工与整体角色上的转变。

Method: 这是一篇分析性章节（chapter），采用概念分析与论证的方式，围绕"递归数字化"展开社会技术层面的探讨，而非实证或技术实现研究。

Result: 指出agentic AI系统已能在软件工程中跨多步骤地规划、执行、检查并迭代优化开发任务；由此数字化变为递归过程，人机分工发生改变，SE的角色被重新界定。

Conclusion: 软件工程正从主要起支撑作用的工程学科，演变为社会价值创造、以及技术与数字主权的中心基础设施。

Abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) marks a new phase of digitalization: digitalization is beginning to act back upon its own technical production base. Whereas earlier phases aimed at digitizing analog information, automating processes, and building digital value networks, AI is increasingly taking over tasks in the development of digital systems themselves. In software engineering (SE) in particular, agentic AI systems can already plan, execute, check, and iteratively refine development tasks across multiple steps. Digitalization thus becomes recursive: digital systems no longer merely support the digitalization of other sectors, but are increasingly developed and evolved by digital systems themselves. The technical production base of digitalization thereby becomes the object of its own transformation. This changes not only the division of labor between humans and machines in SE, but also the role of SE as a whole. This chapter analyzes this socio-technical change and argues that SE is evolving from a primarily supporting engineering discipline into a central infrastructure of societal value creation as well as of technological and digital sovereignty.

</details>


### [551] [Translator vs. Challenger: Adversarial Agentic Learning for C-to-Rust Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15381)
*Chaofan Wang,Xiaodong Gu,Yuling Shi,Chao Hu,Beijun Shen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: TRAIL是一个对抗式智能体学习框架，通过Translator与Challenger双智能体协作，将稀疏的程序特定经验提炼为鲁棒、可复用的C-to-Rust翻译知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: C-to-Rust翻译存在巨大语义鸿沟。现有经验增强型LLM翻译器虽能从历史失败与修复中学习洞见，但这些洞见源自稀疏、程序特定的痕迹，常含缺失条件、适用边界狭窄或忽略的边角情况，导致鲁棒性与泛化性不足。

Method: 提出TRAIL对抗式智能体学习框架，含两个协作智能体：Translator从翻译失败和被接受的修复中提取候选洞见；Challenger主动寻找弱点、缺口和边界情况发起对抗挑战。在两个层面进行对抗学习：个体洞见层面反复压力测试每个洞见以精炼其适用条件与约束；组合洞见层面通过暴露冲突、缺口和未覆盖的边角情况来强化相关洞见群组。通过可执行反例挑战洞见及其组合。

Result: 在CRUST-Bench和SmartC2Rust-Bench两个项目级基准上，相比最强LLM基线，TRAIL在语法准确率上平均相对提升23.1%，语义准确率提升15.9%。对抗精炼后的洞见能有效跨基准迁移，展现出强泛化能力。

Conclusion: TRAIL通过对抗式挑战洞见及其组合，将痕迹特定经验转化为鲁棒、可复用、可泛化的翻译知识，显著提升C-to-Rust翻译质量并具备良好跨任务泛化性。

Abstract: C-to-Rust translation remains challenging due to the substantial semantic gap between the two languages. Recent experience-enhanced LLM translators improve translation quality by learning reusable insights from prior failures and repairs. Yet learned insights do not automatically constitute reusable translation knowledge: derived from sparse, program-specific traces, they often contain missing conditions, narrow applicability boundaries, or overlooked corner cases. This limits their robustness and generalizability in new translation scenarios. We present TRAIL, an adversarial agentic learning framework for robust C-to-Rust translation. TRAIL employs two collaborating agents: a Translator that derives candidate insights from translation failures and accepted repairs, and a Challenger that actively searches for weaknesses, gaps, and boundary cases through adversarial challenges. To improve the robustness of individual insights and the completeness of insight collections, TRAIL performs adversarial learning at two levels. Individual-insight adversarial learning repeatedly stress-tests each insight to refine its applicability conditions and constraints, while compositional insight adversarial learning strengthens groups of related insights by exposing conflicts, gaps, and uncovered corner cases. By challenging insights and their compositions with executable counterexamples, TRAIL transforms trace-specific experience into robust, reusable, and generalizable translation knowledge. We evaluate TRAIL on two project-level benchmarks, CRUST-Bench and SmartC2Rust-Bench. Compared with the strongest LLM-based baseline, TRAIL achieves average relative improvements of 23.1% in syntax accuracy and 15.9% in semantic accuracy. Furthermore, the adversarially refined insights transfer effectively across benchmarks, demonstrating strong generalizability across diverse C-to-Rust translation tasks.

</details>


### [552] [IWC-Bench: Evaluating Web Application Generation from a Software Testing Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15387)
*Chenxu Liu,Zilu Zou,Peizhong Gao,Jiawen Tao,Zhexin Zhang,Guang Chen,Haowei Lin,Ying Zhou,Tianyi Bai,Dolly Deng,Suncong Zheng,Maxm Pan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 IWC-Bench，一个从软件测试视角出发的交互式网页应用生成基准，利用代码覆盖率引导 agent 探索，并沿视觉、可用性、需求对齐三维度评估，与人类偏好达 85.3% 一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化评估方法存在缺陷：静态基准可能认可源码中但运行时不可达的功能；交互式基准因探索不充分会遗漏已实现功能，并将应用缺陷与 agent 执行失败混淆。

Method: 对每个生成应用进行插桩，用代码覆盖率引导 agent 通过模拟用户交互探索功能；将交互轨迹抽象为状态转移图，并从视觉美学、可用性、需求对齐三维度评估；探索与评分分离，避免将探索限制在预设验收标准内。

Result: 基准包含 369 条真实用户需求和 5,088 条验收标准。对 16 个前沿 LLM 的评估显示各模型在三维度上各有强弱、无模型全面领先。在 197 个验证会话上，IWC-Bench 与人类偏好一致率达 85.3%，且随配对应用分差增大而提高；覆盖率引导提升探索覆盖，替换判分模型后排名保持稳定。

Conclusion: IWC-Bench 通过测试驱动的插桩与覆盖率引导探索，实现了更可靠的 LLM 网页应用生成自动化评估，与人类判断高度一致且具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Human evaluation provides a direct measure of the quality of LLM-generated web applications. However, fitting human judgments through automated evaluation remains challenging. Static benchmarks can credit functionality that exists in source code but is unreachable at runtime. Interactive benchmarks exercise the application, yet incomplete exploration can cause them to miss implemented functionality and confound application defects with agent execution failures. To address these limitations, we propose IWC-Bench, an interactive benchmark for evaluating web application generation from a software testing perspective. IWC-Bench instruments each generated application and uses code coverage to guide an agent in exploring its functionality through user-simulated interactions. It then abstracts the interaction trace into a state-transition graph and evaluates the application along three dimensions: visual aesthetics, usability, and requirement alignment. By separating exploration from scoring, IWC-Bench collects runtime evidence without constraining exploration to predefined acceptance criteria. IWC-Bench comprises 369 real-world user requirements and 5,088 acceptance criteria. Evaluation of 16 frontier LLMs reveals distinct strengths across the three dimensions, with no model leading on every dimension. On 197 validated sessions sampled from an internal arena, IWC-Bench achieves 85.3\% agreement with human preferences, with agreement generally increasing as the score difference between paired applications grows. Further experiments show that coverage guidance improves exploration coverage and the model rankings remain stable when the judge model is replaced.

</details>


### [553] [The Future of Safety for SaMD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15438)
*Rhea Malhotra,Tanya Sharma,Krisha Patel,Satvika Sharma,Heena Purkait,Mehak Nehal Makhija,Aellison Cassimiro,Everett Hildenbrandt,Palina Tolmach,Jaidev Shastri*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文探讨将形式化验证方法逐阶段应用于人工器官软件，弥补传统测试无法覆盖未预见故障模式的不足，并阐明各技术的保证能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工器官失效后果堪比飞机或核反应堆，但驱动其运行的软件却鲜有同等安全标准。团队依赖测试，而测试只能覆盖预设的故障模式；在病人体内运行数月的水泵或控制器中，最危险的恰恰是无人预见的场景。

Method: 将已在铁路、航空、核控制系统中使用形式化验证方法逐阶段引入人工器官软件，并融入制造商已遵循的IEC 62304生命周期而非取而代之。该方法可证明代码对规范允许的每次执行均满足规范，并在证明失败时返回导致失败的精确输入序列。

Result: 形式化验证可弥补测试的覆盖缺口，对设备软件提供覆盖所有允许执行路径的规范符合性保证，并能定位反例输入。

Conclusion: 形式化验证可分层嵌入人工器官开发流程，与现有IEC 62304生命周期兼容，并为各阶段技术提供明确的保证边界。

Abstract: An artificial organ carries failure consequences on the scale of an aircraft or a reactor, but the software driving it is rarely held to the same standard. Teams building them rely on testing, which only reaches the failure modes someone thought of in advance. In a pump or controller that runs inside a patient for months, the dangerous cases are the ones nobody anticipated. Formal verification closes that gap. Applied to the device's software, it proves the code meets its specification for every execution that specification allows, and where a proof fails, it returns the exact input sequence that breaks it. The same methods already protect rail, aviation, and nuclear control systems, and they extend the IEC 62304 lifecycle that a manufacturer already follows rather than replacing it. In this paper, we explore how to apply formal verification to artificial organs, stage by stage, and what each technique actually guarantees about the device.

</details>


### [554] [Technostress in the Age of AI: A Preliminary Study with Software Professionals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15686)
*Ronnie de Souza Santos,Italo Santos,Cleyton Magalhaes,Zixuan Feng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究通过调查121名来自26个国家的软件专业人士，探索AI相关技术压力（technostress）的表现形式，发现其不仅源于适应快速变化的技术，还源于管理伴随AI采用而来的工作、技术责任与职业变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI的快速采用与演进正改变软件工程工作，要求从业者反复适应知识、实践与技能。尽管技术适应长期存在，但对这些新出现的、反复出现的压力如何表现为技术压力了解不足。

Method: 开展探索性研究，对121名来自26个国家的软件专业人士进行问卷调查，并对他们关于工作中AI近期体验的回答进行主题分析。

Result: AI相关技术压力不仅来自适应快速变化的技术，还来自必须管理AI采用所带来的工作、技术责任和职业变化。这表明AI带来的压力超越了学习和使用新工具本身。

Conclusion: AI相关技术压力影响软件专业人士如何执行技术工作、如何对其负责，以及如何为未来职业做准备。该特征刻画揭示了AI对软件从业者更广泛的影响。

Abstract: The rapid adoption and evolution of AI are changing software engineering work and requiring professionals to repeatedly adapt their knowledge, practices, and skills. Although technological adaptation has long characterized software development, less is known about how these new and recurring pressures manifest as technostress. This preliminary exploratory study investigates AI related technostress among software professionals. We conducted a survey and performed a thematic analysis of responses from 121 software professionals across 26 countries reporting their recent experiences with AI at work. Our findings suggest that AI related technostress emerges not only from adapting to rapidly changing technologies, but also from having to manage the work, technical responsibilities, and professional changes that accompany their adoption. This characterization shows that AI introduces pressures beyond learning and using new tools, affecting how software professionals perform and remain accountable for technical work and how they prepare for the future of their careers.

</details>


### [555] [Using Agentic AI for contextualized and multifaceted code review at Ericsson](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15877)
*Muhammad Laiq,Ricardo Britto,Muhammad Usman,Nishrith Saini,Deepika Badampudi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多智能体代码审查方案，结合专用智能体技能与项目上下文知识，从可读性、可维护性、可靠性和性能四个维度评估代码变更，并在工业场景中验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件系统日益复杂且AI编码代理加速代码生成，使有效代码审查愈发困难。现有基于LLM的代码审查方法很少考虑项目特定上下文知识，也鲜有在工业环境中评估。

Method: 遵循设计科学研究流程，在工业场景中开发并评估解决方案：将专用智能体技能与上下文特定知识相结合，识别代码变更在可读性、可维护性、可靠性、性能四个维度的反模式，为多个代码提交生成审查意见，共识别200多个问题，并由案例公司开发者人工验证其正确性和重要性。

Result: 所调查代码提交中问题识别准确率达96%；正确识别的问题中约69%被评为重要，其中约33%为必须修复的严重问题，36%为应该修复的重要问题。开发者定性反馈印证了这些结果，并强调生成审查意见的实用性。

Conclusion: 工业评估提供实证证据，表明将专用智能体技能与上下文特定知识相结合能够产生准确且具有实际价值的代码审查。

Abstract: Context: Conducting effective code reviews is increasingly challenging due to the growing complexity of software systems and the accelerated code generation by AI coding agents. LLM-based approaches for code reviews have shown promising results in identifying defects and improving code quality. However, existing approaches rarely consider project-specific contextualized knowledge, and few have been evaluated in industrial settings.
  Objective: In this study, we propose a multi-agent-based solution that provides multifaceted assessments of code changes.
  Method: Following the Design Science Research Process, we developed and evaluated our solution in an industrial setting. Our solution combines specialized agent skills with context-specific knowledge to identify antipatterns in code changes across four dimensions: readability, maintainability, reliability, and performance. Using our solution, we generated reviews for several code commits and identified more than 200 issues. These issues were then manually validated by the developers of the case company for their correctness and importance.
  Results: The evaluation results show that our solution achieves 96% accuracy in correctly identifying issues in the investigated code commits. Furthermore, around 69% of the correctly identified issues were rated as important, with approximately 33% rated as severe issues that must be fixed and 36% as important issues that should be fixed. Qualitative feedback from developers corroborates these findings and highlights the usefulness of the generated reviews.
  Conclusion: Our findings provide empirical evidence from an industrial evaluation that combining specialized agent skills with context-specific knowledge yields accurate, practically useful code reviews.

</details>


### [556] [Natural-Language to SysMLv2 Translation via Conformance-Driven Iterative Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.14162)
*Chance LaVoie,Eladio Andujar Lugo,Taylan G. Topcu,Levent Burak Kara*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出一种以一致性检查器为驱动的自然语言到SysMLv2翻译框架，将生产级验收作为终止条件，通过生成-检查-修复循环实现100%一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MBSE依赖形式化系统模型，SysMLv2标准化后，人们希望将自然语言直接翻译为可执行模型。但实际部署中生成的模型必须被工业建模环境接受，而不仅仅是满足语法约束。

Method: 将SysMLv2一致性检查器嵌入生成-检查-修复循环。每个模型经检查器评估，将确定性诊断信息纳入修订，直到零一致性错误为止，以生产检查器作为oracle。

Result: 在SysMBench全部151个提示、四个LLM后端共604个提示-模型案例上评估。单次生成的生产一致性接受率为51.16%，而本方法达到100.00%。

Conclusion: 将生产一致性从后处理检查提升为生成过程中的控制机制，可把概率性输出转化为生产可接受的SysMLv2制品，适用于加载、可视化和工程使用。

Abstract: Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) relies on formal system models as primary technical artifacts for representing requirements, structure, and behavior across the system lifecycle. With the standardization of SysMLv2 as a textual language, interest is increasing in translating natural-language descriptions directly into executable models. For practical deployment, generated models must be accepted by industrial modeling environments, not merely satisfy grammar constraints. We present a conformance-checker-driven framework for reliable natural-language-to-SysMLv2 translation that enforces production-level acceptance as the termination condition. The system embeds a SysMLv2 conformance checker within a generate-check-repair loop. Each model is evaluated using the checker, and deterministic diagnostics are incorporated into revisions until zero conformance errors are achieved. Using the production checker as the oracle ensures the framework targets deployability rather than grammar plausibility. We evaluate the approach on the full SysMBench prompt set of 151 prompts across four large language model backends, yielding 604 prompt-model cases. Single-shot generation achieves 51.16% production-conformance acceptance, while our approach achieves 100.00% conformance. By elevating production conformance from a post-processing check to a control mechanism within generation, the framework converts probabilistic outputs into production-accepted SysMLv2 artifacts suitable for loading, visualization, and engineering use.

</details>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [557] [BudgetBench: A Budget-Tiered Protocol and Pilot Harness for Memory Strategy Evaluation in Local Large Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13149)
*Aditya Karnam Gururaj Rao,Arjun Jaggi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BudgetBench，将每次调用输入token预算作为自变量来评测本地LLM agent的记忆策略，提供可复用的测量协议与工具，并通过多个试点研究揭示预算违规、非单调质量曲线等被单预算评测掩盖的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本地大模型agent的活跃上下文是稀缺资源，记忆容量、prefill延迟、缓存增长和服务目标都限制了每次调用的输入token数，因此需要固定预算下系统比较记忆策略的评测方法。

Method: BudgetBench作为主动预算协议与参考harness：固定模型、任务、采样器和解码参数，扫描2K/4K/8K/16K/32K token预算，记录质量、预算利用率、延迟及预算违规率；提供可替换的MemoryStrategy契约、显式预算强制、确定性/版本化评分器、prompt审计元数据及可复现工件。

Result: 通过本地qwen2.5:1.5b（SWE-bench Verified和LongBench v2各89项）、托管Qwen3 30B-A3B LongBench 50项复现、LongMemEval oracle 500项研究，暴露预算合规失败、非单调质量曲线和被单预算评测隐藏的operating points；预算与全上下文方向未定，本地接近无差异，托管复现点估计倾向全上下文。

Conclusion: 贡献为协议、harness及失败报告规范，用于规模化固定预算记忆策略评测；早期试点tokenizer近似会低估部分prompt，其违规行仅为诊断，所有计时为操作诊断。

Abstract: For local large language model agents, active context is a scarce resource: memory capacity, prefill latency, cache growth, and service objectives all constrain how many input tokens each call can afford. We present BudgetBench, an active-budget protocol and reference harness that treats the per-call input-token budget as the independent variable when comparing memory strategies. Holding the model, task, sampler, and decoding fixed, it sweeps budgets over 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, and 32K tokens and records quality, budget utilization, latency, and, as a first-class outcome, budget-violation rates. The core contribution is this reusable measurement surface: a swappable MemoryStrategy contract, explicit budget enforcement, deterministic or versioned graders, prompt-audit metadata, and reproducibility artifacts, released at https://github.com/aviskaar/budgetbench.
  We substantiate the protocol with pilot studies rather than final rankings. Across a local qwen2.5:1.5b pilot (89 items each on SWE-bench Verified and LongBench v2), a hosted 50-item Qwen3 30B-A3B LongBench replication with exact tokenization, and a 500-item LongMemEval oracle study scored by the official GPT-4o evaluator, the harness exposes budget-compliance failures, non-monotonic quality curves, and operating points that single-budget evaluation hides. The budgeted-versus-full-context direction remains unresolved: the local slice is near-null and the hosted replication favors full context in point estimate. We report results transparently, including that the early pilot's tokenizer approximation undercounts some served-model prompts, so its violation rows are tokenizer-approximation diagnostics, not claim-bearing results; all timings are operational diagnostics. The reusable contribution is the protocol, harness, and failure-reporting discipline needed to scale fixed-budget memory-strategy evaluation.

</details>


### [558] [A derivative-fidelity failure mode in physics-informed neural networks: strengthened benchmark evidence from function-value training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13171)
*Koji Koyamada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PINN 中"导数保真度"失效模式，用一维基准测试发现：函数值拟合良好不代表二阶导数准确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN 依赖自动微分施加微分方程残差，但函数值吻合并不保证导数准确，这一隐患未被系统检验。

Method: 仅用函数值训练 MLP 拟合 sin(x) 与 exp(x)，单独评估自动微分得到的二阶导数；并测试训练点密度、激活函数、端点密集评估、L2 与最大误差等诊断。

Result: 函数近似在视觉上准确时，二阶导数误差仍可能显著更大，尤其在高曲率边界区域附近。

Conclusion: 实验提供了区分"值精度"与"物理残差可靠性"的诊断协议。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) use automatic differentiation to impose differential-equation residuals, but good agreement in function values does not necessarily imply accurate derivatives. This paper formulates derivative fidelity as a failure mode of PINNs and tests it with one-dimensional benchmarks. Multilayer perceptrons are trained only on function values for sin(x) and exp(x), while second derivatives obtained by automatic differentiation are evaluated separately. The hypothesis is strengthened by additional tests over training-point density, activation functions, endpoint-dense evaluation, and both L2 and maximum-error diagnostics. The results show that visually accurate function approximation can coexist with substantially larger second-derivative errors, especially near high-curvature boundary regions. The experiment provides a diagnostic protocol for distinguishing value accuracy from physics-residual reliability.

</details>


### [559] [Land Art as a Big-Data Climate Sensor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13182)
*Alev Cinbarci,Sean Kalaycioglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文用1984–2025年1,744张Landsat与Sentinel-2影像分析Spiral Jetty的艺术复杂度特征，发现其可领先湖泊水位约3年，成为水文状态的先行指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Robert Smithson的Spiral Jetty随大盐湖水位在淹没与出露间交替；此前小样本研究称其Shannon熵与全球气温正相关，需要更稳健的长期多源数据来检验并重新理解"艺术作为温度计"的隐喻。

Method: 构建1,744张共配准影像chips（覆盖1984–2025全年各月），提取14维复杂度特征（Shannon熵、多尺度排列熵、分形维数、lacunarity、GLCM纹理、强度统计、ResNet50嵌入），并与42年气候水文面板（GISTEMP、USGS NWIS、Open-Meteo、Global Carbon Budget）比对；采用bootstrap、PCA、STL分解、滞后相关与偏相关分析。

Result: Shannon熵是弱代理，不支持此前正相关主张；粗尺度排列熵与平均强度与水位强相关（Spearman 0.85–0.88）；ResNet50嵌入第三主成分无监督地形成"AI气候轴"，与累积CO2相关0.86、与水位相关-0.83；影像复杂度领先水位约3年（Pearson r=0.58，CI 0.40–0.73）；STL显示1984–2015上升、之后急剧下降的非单调趋势；偏相关证实对季节与传感器稳健。

Conclusion: 将"艺术作为温度计"的隐喻修正为"艺术作为水文状态先行指标"，并公开数据集、特征管线与分析代码作为公共基准。

Abstract: Robert Smithson's 1970 land artwork Spiral Jetty, located in the north arm of Utah's Great Salt Lake, has alternated between submergence and exposure during severe lake decline. We analyze 1,744 co-registered Landsat 4-9 and Sentinel-2 image chips spanning every year and calendar month from 1984 to 2025. A 14-feature complexity signature combines Shannon entropy, multiscale permutation entropy, fractal dimension, lacunarity, gray-level co-occurrence texture, intensity statistics, and ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 features. These measurements are compared with a 42-year monthly climate and hydrology panel from NASA GISTEMP, USGS NWIS, Open-Meteo, and the Global Carbon Budget. Bootstrap analysis shows that Shannon entropy is a weak proxy and does not support an earlier small-sample claim of positive correlation with global temperature. By contrast, coarse-scale permutation entropy and mean intensity track lake elevation strongly, with Spearman correlations of 0.85 to 0.88 and 95 percent confidence intervals excluding zero. The third principal component of the ResNet50 embeddings emerges without supervision as an AI climate axis, correlating 0.86 with cumulative CO2 and -0.83 with lake elevation. Image complexity leads lake stage by about three years, with Pearson r = 0.58 at lag +3 and a 95 percent confidence interval of 0.40 to 0.73. STL decomposition reveals a non-monotonic trend that rises from 1984 to 2015 and declines sharply thereafter as the lake approaches record-low elevations. Partial correlations controlling for month and sensor confirm robustness to seasonal and sensor effects. These results refine the art-as-thermometer metaphor into an art-as-leading-indicator-of-hydrological-state interpretation. The dataset, feature pipeline, and analysis code are released as a public benchmark.

</details>


### [560] [LLMs or Naive Bayes? Old Gems or New Ways](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13185)
*Mohammad Firas Sada,Dmitry Mishin,John Graham,Seungmin Kim,Mahidhar Tatineni,Frank Würthwein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过基准测试比较Complement Naive Bayes与不同规模LLM在文本分类任务上的表现，发现在有标注数据时NB仍是资源受限场景的最优选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在LLM兴起背景下，研究者质疑是否应淘汰Naive Bayes等经典方法，本文旨在系统评估NB与LLM在文本分类上的实际权衡。

Method: 在四类模型家族、27B至1T参数规模（37倍跨度）上，将Complement NB与零样本/少样本LLM对比；测量准确率、吞吐量（CPU/GPU）及能效；并提供Kubernetes Helm算子实现自动模型选择。

Result: LLM仅在零数据场景占优（Amazon Polarity 98.0% vs 88.2%），但可能受污染影响；低污染任务上NB反超（81.7% vs 73.0%）。有标注数据时（AG News）NB达89.1%，与零样本27B LLM（89.0%）无统计差异，优于397B模型（84.8%）。NB吞吐量在单CPU上达数千样本/秒，GPU批量推理比NB CPU慢40-486倍，能效低约两个数量级。

Conclusion: 对资源受限的HPC从业者，有标注数据时NB仍是最优选择；决策线依赖任务（主题分类约N~10^4标签达到LLM持平），并提供了自动模型选择的K8s算子。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) prompt a recurring question in research computing: should classical methods like Naive Bayes (NB) be retired? We benchmark Complement Naive Bayes against zero-shot and few-shot LLMs spanning four model families and a 37x range in scale (27B to a 1T-parameter mixture-of-experts) across text classification tasks. LLMs dominate only in zero-data regimes (98.0% vs 88.2% on Amazon Polarity sentiment), and even that win is contamination-prone: on a low-contamination sentiment task NB beats the zero-shot LLM (81.7% vs 73.0%). However, once labeled data is available (e.g., AG News), NB reaches 89.1% accuracy, statistically indistinguishable from the zero-shot 27B LLM (89.0%) and better than the 397B frontier model (84.8%), at thousands of samples/sec on a commodity CPU. Fine-tuned DistilBERT reaches 90.6% but at far lower throughput than NB at batch size 1 (Table 2). Our measured GPU throughput analysis shows small-LLM batched inference is 40-486x slower than NB CPU inference (the multiplier depends strongly on the host CPU), exposing a structural gap bounded by memory bandwidth, with roughly two orders of magnitude lower energy per sample. For resource-constrained HPC practitioners performing text classification with labeled data, NB remains the optimal choice. We show the decision line is task-dependent (NB reaches LLM parity around $N \sim 10^4$ labels for topic classification, while zero-data sentiment favors the LLM at all N tested) and provide a Kubernetes Helm operator that automates model selection using configurable thresholds and verifiable Prometheus metrics.

</details>


### [561] [Early Prediction of Satellite Collision Probability Using a Hybrid TCN-Transformer Model for a CDM-Based Conjunction Analysis Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13191)
*Rabia Tüylek Tok,Burak Yağlıoğlu,Enes Dağ,Emre Onur Kahya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出基于学习的框架，通过估计同一接近事件下一次CDM更新中的预期碰撞概率，实现卫星接近风险的早期预测。方法结合无迹变换传播与反向传播的敏感性分析、PCA特征选择，构建派生指标，并采用TCN-Transformer混合模型学习碰撞风险的时间演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO中操作卫星与轨道碎片急剧增加，接近事件频发，加重运营商负担；对使用电推进的卫星，低推力机动能力给避碰规划带来额外时间约束。现有CDMs虽提供相对状态、协方差、最近接近距离、TCA和PoC等信息，但轨道不确定性的非线性传播及PoC对协方差演化的敏感性，使序列CDMs难以解读。

Method: 1) 使用无迹变换（Unscented Transform）的传播与反向传播框架，评估碰撞风险度量对CDM参数的敏感性；2) 对数值CDM参数应用主成分分析（PCA），识别与PoC变化最相关的特征；3) 基于敏感性与PCA结果选取原始CDM参数，并构建表示相对运动、交会几何和协方差不确定性的派生指标；4) 利用序列化增强交会数据集，训练混合TCN-Transformer模型学习碰撞风险的时间演化。

Result: 该框架应用于TÜBİTAK UZAY接收并分析的CDMs，展示了其在LEO卫星交会中进行更早、更一致的操作风险评估的潜力。

Conclusion: 所提学习型框架能够对同一接近事件的后续CDM更新进行PoC早期预测，为LEO卫星交会的操作风险提供更早且更一致的评估手段，具备实际应用潜力。

Abstract: The rapid expansion of operational satellites and orbital debris has increased the frequency of close approach events in low Earth orbit (LEO), creating a higher operational burden for satellite operators. This problem is especially critical for satellites using electric propulsion, where low-thrust maneuver capability imposes additional time constraints on collision avoidance planning. In current practice, Conjunction Data Messages (CDMs) provide relative state, covariance, miss distance, time of closest approach, and probability of collision (PoC) information for conjunction assessment. However, the nonlinear propagation of orbital uncertainties and the sensitivity of PoC to covariance evolution make the interpretation of sequential CDMs challenging. This study proposes a learning-based framework for early prediction of satellite conjunction risk by estimating the PoC expected in the subsequent CDM update of the same close approach event. In the proposed methodology, an Unscented Transform-based propagation and backpropagation framework is first used to evaluate the sensitivity of the collision risk metric to CDM parameters. In addition, Principal Component Analysis is applied to the numerical CDM parameters to identify the features most relevant to PoC variation. The results obtained from the sensitivity analysis and PCA are then used to justify the selected raw CDM parameters and to construct derived metrics representing relative motion, encounter geometry, and covariance-related uncertainty. Using the resulting sequential enriched conjunction dataset, a hybrid Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN)-Transformer model is trained to learn the temporal evolution of conjunction risk. The framework is applied to CDMs received and analyzed within TÜBİTAK UZAY, demonstrating its potential for earlier and more consistent operational risk evaluation for LEO satellite conjunctions.

</details>


### [562] [Evaluating LLM-Generated Rules for Heart Disease Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13192)
*Feisal Alaswad,Batoul Aljaddouh,Maher Alrahhal,Wafaa Al Nassan,Talal Bonn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对比传统机器学习模型与LLM生成规则系统用于心脏病预测，传统模型性能更优，但LLM规则更具可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究LLM生成的规则系统能否在心脏病预测中替代或补充传统机器学习模型，并权衡预测性能与可解释性。

Method: 使用UCI心脏病数据集，评估逻辑回归、KNN、SVM、朴素贝叶斯、决策树、随机森林等分类器，以及GPT-4o和Claude Sonnet 4.6生成的规则系统，采用准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数评估。

Result: 传统模型普遍优于LLM规则系统。随机森林最佳（准确率90.2%，精确率0.829，召回率1.0，F1 0.906），朴素贝叶斯次之（88.5%，F1 0.881）。Claude Sonnet 4.6为80.3%（F1 0.833），GPT-4o为70.5%（F1 0.690）。

Conclusion: LLM规则性能较低但提供可解释的IF-THEN诊断逻辑，体现医疗AI中预测性能与可解释性的权衡。

Abstract: This study compares traditional machine learning models and Large Language Model (LLM)-generated rule-based systems for heart disease prediction using the UCI Heart Disease dataset. Several classifiers, including Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, and Random Forest, were evaluated alongside rule-based systems generated using GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 4.6. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics. Experimental results show that traditional machine learning models consistently outperform LLM-generated rule-based systems in predictive performance. Random Forest achieved the best overall performance with 90.2% accuracy, a precision of 0.829, perfect recall of 1.0, and an F1-score of 0.906. Naive Bayes followed closely with 88.5% accuracy and an F1-score of 0.881. In contrast, the LLM-generated rule models achieved lower performance, with Claude Sonnet 4.6 reaching 80.3% accuracy (F1-score: 0.833) and GPT-4o obtaining 70.5% accuracy (F1-score: 0.690). Despite the performance gap, the LLM-generated rules provide interpretable IF-THEN diagnostic logic that enhances explainability and transparency in clinical decision-making. These findings highlight the trade-off between predictive performance and interpretability in medical artificial intelligence systems. The complete implementation of all experiments, including machine learning models and LLM-derived rule classifiers, is publicly available in the GitHub repository at https://github.com/FeisalAlaswad/LLM-Rule-ML-Heart-Disease-Prediction .

</details>


### [563] [Diagnosing Faults in Reinforcement Learning Simulators and World Models with Canonical Polynomial Invariants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13194)
*Tesfay Zemuy Gebrekidan,Hadush Hailu Gebrerufael*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用精确多项式不变量（化为ℚ上约化Gröbner基）检验“尊重物理结构能提升预测”的前提；发现在Acrobot上精确性对预测帮助甚微，但精确规范不变量在诊断（定位被违反的物理约束与归因故障参数）上价值显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大量文献认为模型尊重底层物理结构会预测更好，作者要检验这一前提，并探索精确物理不变量真正的价值所在。

Method: 从轨迹恢复精确多项式不变量，规范化为ℚ上约化Gröbner基；提出筛选（识别被违反的约束）与归因（恢复故障不变量并定位责任参数）两种程序，引入正规形deflation与商空间恢复；在Acrobot与RL环境上实验。

Result: Acrobot上一致性正则化降低代数残差但rollout保真度基本不变，100%质量误差下恢复的势能加速学习与正确势能等效；15个注入故障中筛选全部定位且无误报（观测空间基线无一能定位），归因在全部7个参数故障上找回责任参数；配对差分检验能检测所有故障，说明优势在定位；10⁻⁴扰动保留14–15/15定位，而理想等式判定能区分10⁻¹²扰动，说明代数比较需要精确性。

Conclusion: 精确规范不变量的价值不在预测而在诊断；筛选不依赖精确性，归因与代数比较依赖精确性；应用于350个发布对、11个RL环境未发现模拟器动力学变化，反而揭示基准实现自身的性质。

Abstract: A large literature builds physical structure into learned dynamics on the premise that models respecting the underlying physics predict better. We test that premise using exact polynomial invariants recovered from trajectories and canonicalised as reduced Gröbner bases over $\mathbb{Q}$. On Acrobot, exactness provides little benefit for prediction: a consistency regulariser reduces algebraic residual while leaving rollout fidelity essentially unchanged, and a shaping potential recovered from a system with a 100% mass error accelerates learning as effectively as the correct potential. Exact canonical invariants instead prove valuable for diagnosis. We develop two procedures: screening, which identifies the violated physical constraint, and attribution, which recovers the faulty invariant and identifies the responsible physical parameter. To enable this, we introduce normal-form deflation and quotient-space recovery. Across fifteen injected faults, screening localises every broken constraint with no false alarms, whereas observation-space baselines do not localise any; attribution recovers the responsible parameter on all seven parameter faults. Paired difference tests detect all faults, showing that the advantage is localisation rather than detection. Perturbing reference generators by $10^{-4}$ preserves 14--15/15 localisations, showing that screening does not require exactness, whereas ideal-equality decisions distinguish perturbations of only $10^{-12}$, showing that exactness is required for algebraic comparison. Applied to 350 release pairs across eleven RL environments, the diagnostic finds no evidence of changed simulator dynamics, instead revealing properties of the benchmark implementations themselves.

</details>


### [564] [Sensory Precision Inference for Multimodal Arbitration under Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15065)
*Tin Mišić,Takato Horii*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种多模态感知推断模型，结合主动推断，通过迭代自由能最小化联合更新潜在信念与各模态的感觉精度。模型引入可学习的精度先验，在视觉/听觉/触觉MNIST合成数据上验证：动态精度推断能提升噪声鲁棒性并稳定处理模态冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实环境下多感觉流常被噪声、缺失或模态间不一致污染，智能体需在竞争性感觉假设间自适应仲裁。主动推断虽提供不确定性引导推断框架，但动态推断的"感觉精度"在感觉冲突下的多模态仲裁作用尚未被充分探索。

Method: 构建多模态感知推断模型，通过迭代自由能最小化联合更新潜在信念与模态特定的感觉精度；感觉精度动态既反映不确定性，又主动塑造冲突时潜在信念演化。此外引入关于感觉精度的可学习先验，形成类别相关的结构化精度模式，影响跨模态推断动态。在合成多模态MNIST数据集上评估（视觉、听觉、触觉三种数字表征，含受控噪声与模态不一致）。

Result: 动态精度推断在受损感觉证据下提升重建鲁棒性；可在感觉证据减少时支持一致的潜在推断；能在冲突模态间实现稳定仲裁。可学习的精度先验生成可解释的精度结构，塑造推断动态与跨模态潜在结构。

Conclusion: 感觉精度推断是不确定性下自适应多模态信念形成的机制性控制过程，精度动态是稳健且可解释的多感觉整合的计算机制。

Abstract: Autonomous agents operating on multisensory data cannot assume that all sensory modalities remain consistently informative. In real environments, sensory streams are frequently corrupted by noise, missing data, or inter-modal incongruence, requiring adaptive arbitration between competing sensory hypotheses. While active inference provides a principled framework for uncertainty-guided inference, the role of dynamically inferred sensory precision in generative multimodal arbitration under sensory conflict remains comparatively underexplored. We propose a multimodal perceptual inference model in which latent beliefs and modality-specific sensory precisions are jointly updated through iterative free-energy minimization. In our proposed model, sensory precision dynamics not only reflect sensory uncertainty but actively shape the evolution of latent beliefs during multimodal conflict. In addition, we introduce a learned prior over sensory precisions that induces structured, class-dependent precision patterns and influences cross-modal inference dynamics. We evaluate the model using a synthetic multimodal MNIST dataset combining visual, auditory, and tactile representations of digit classes under controlled sensory noise and inter-modal incongruence. Results show that dynamic precision inference improves reconstruction robustness under corrupted sensory evidence, supports coherent latent inference from reduced sensory evidence, and enables stable arbitration between conflicting modalities. Furthermore, learned precision priors generate interpretable precision structures that shape inference dynamics and cross-modal latent structure. These findings support sensory precision inference as a mechanistic control process for adaptive multimodal belief formation under uncertainty, highlighting precision dynamics as a computational mechanism for robust and interpretable multisensory integration.

</details>


### [565] [Machine Unlearning for Speech Question Answering in Large Audio-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13195)
*Zhe Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）在语音问答中的机器遗忘问题，评估多种遗忘策略以去除隐私知识，同时保留核心能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LALMs 继承大规模训练数据的隐私风险，会无意记忆敏感信息。语音QA的遗忘比文本LLM或ASR更难，因声学感知与事实知识紧密耦合。

Method: 提出并评估多种遗忘策略：梯度上升、任务算术，以及强制安全拒答的基于对齐的微调方法。

Result: 在语音QA数据集上，这些方法可将隐私泄露率降低多达80%，同时在非隐私语音QA和通用语音理解基准上保持近乎中性的性能。

Conclusion: 所提遗忘方法能有效降低LALMs语音QA的隐私泄露，同时基本不损害核心能力。

Abstract: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have recently shown strong capabilities in speech understanding and question answering (QA), but they also inherit privacy risks from large-scale training data, including the unintended memorization of sensitive information. In this work, we study machine unlearning for speech QA in LALMs, a setting that is more challenging than prior work on text-based Large Language Models (LLMs) or Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) due to the tight coupling between acoustic perception and factual knowledge. We present and evaluate multiple unlearning strategies, including gradient ascent, task arithmetic, and alignment-based fine-tuning methods that enforce safe refusal responses, to remove private knowledge while still preserving performance on core capabilities. Through extensive experiments on speech QA datasets, we show that these unlearning methods can reduce the privacy leakage rate by up to 80% while maintaining near-neutral performance on non-private speech QA and general speech understanding benchmarks.

</details>


### [566] [Ensemble-Conditioned Molecular Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15077)
*Ross Irwin,Alessandro Tibo,Jon Paul Janet,Simon Olsson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将分子设计重新定义为对构象系综（而非单一构象）的模式与性质的优化，提出系综条件引导框架，可同时以多种模式条件引导3D生成模型，并引入自适应对称学习与柔性尺寸生成，在双靶点结合剂和活性态选择性激动剂设计等任务上优于单态条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统分子设计通常寻找能采用单一生物活性构象的分子，但实际分子处于构象分布中，许多决定候选可行性的性质依赖于整个分布而非单个构象，因此需要将设计目标从单构象扩展到构象系综。

Method: 提出系综条件引导（ensemble-conditioned guidance），让3D分子生成模型同时以模式（形状、药效团轮廓、蛋白口袋）和整体分布上的聚合标量性质为条件；模式条件在推理时通过组合各条件下的向量场自适应合成，可靶向或规避、跨模态混合、任意数量组合；引入自适应对称学习以组合不同参考系的条件，并扩展框架支持柔性尺寸生成。

Result: 在多模式条件与系综性质优化的新基准上进行了评估；应用于双靶点结合剂设计和活性态选择性激动剂设计两个实际药物发现任务，两种情况中额外状态条件相比单状态条件均改善了期望结果。

Conclusion: 将分子设计视为构象系综的模式与性质优化是可行且有效的，单一训练模型即可表达广泛的设​​计任务，系综级条件显著提升实际药物设计表现。

Abstract: Molecular design is typically approached as a problem of finding molecules which can adopt a single bioactive conformation. In reality, molecules occupy a distribution over conformations, and many of the properties which determine whether a candidate is viable depend on that distribution rather than on any single conformer. We reframe molecular design as an optimisation of both the modes and properties of molecules' conformational ensembles, where modes can be represented as shapes, pharmacophore profiles or protein pockets, and properties are aggregate scalars computed over the whole distribution. To realise this we introduce ensemble-conditioned guidance, a framework which conditions 3D molecular generative models on both axes simultaneously. Mode conditions are composed adaptively at inference by combining the vector fields produced under each condition. Conditions may be targeted or avoided, mixed across modalities and combined in arbitrary numbers, allowing a wide range of design tasks to be expressed with a single trained model. We introduce adaptive symmetry learning to allow conditions from different reference frames to be composed, and extend our generative framework to enable flexible-size generation. We evaluate on new benchmarks for multi-mode conditioning and ensemble property optimisation, and apply the framework to two practical drug discovery tasks, dual-target binder design and active-state-selective agonist design, where in both cases conditioning on the additional state improves the desired outcome over single-state conditioning.

</details>


### [567] [Algorithmic Information Dynamics of Learning: A Certified, Differentiable Complexity Controller for Grokking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13197)
*Luan Ozelim,Hector Zenil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用可微的认证复杂度估计器 K^CDM_sF 将算法信息动力学引入学习动力学，把复杂度估计器当作控制器来加速 grokking，并系统分析其机制、边界与可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AID 通过扰动系统并测量算法复杂度变化来研究系统，但其常用估计器（Block Decomposition Method）为分段常数，只能做有限差分，无法进入可微的学习动力学；同时 grokking 中已知存在复杂度序参量，却未被用于实际控制。

Method: 采用认证且可微的估计器 K^CDM_sF；施加瞬态损失 kick，使估计器成为控制器；刻画数据依赖的 Occam 边界及其有限尺度趋势 f_c∼ln p/p；做消融对比复杂度门与训练损失门；检验认证先验、逐参数 ∇K 归因、均匀先验、随机支撑等；用直接场扰动探测 Occam 场响应；迁移到稀疏奇偶与 transformer，并测试持续权重空间损失。

Result: 可加速 grokking（Levin 描述长度-时间意义）；复杂度门在挽救失败种子上比训练损失门少 27% 干预；测试信号中仅 map complexity 标记转变完成；认证先验与 ∇K 归因可替换（均匀先验做出逐位相同门决策，随机支撑在稀疏度阈值以上可匹配 ∇K 选择）；Occam 场呈类成核响应，探测幅度内无线性区，故不支持涨落-耗散替代；有限场响应在接近转变时增大数个量级；kick 可迁移到稀疏奇偶与 transformer，持续权重空间损失失败。

Conclusion: 算法估计器的独特贡献在于"时序"（何时触发、何时释放），而非归因；测量结果解释了经验调优的阶梯式 bang-bang 脉冲（stall 触发、yield 释放）机制，其迭代可能构建出它所利用的响应。

Abstract: Algorithmic Information Dynamics (AID) studies systems by perturbing them and measuring changes in algorithmic complexity, but its usual estimator, the Block Decomposition Method, is piecewise constant, restricting the calculus to finite differences. We use $K^{\mathrm{CDM}}_{\mathrm{s}F}$, a certified, differentiable estimator, to bring the calculus into learning dynamics: grokking, where a complexity order parameter is known but has not been made to act. A\empts a transient loss kick, the estimator becomes a controller that accelerates grokking in Levin's description-length--versus-time sense, within a data-dependent Occam boundary whose finite-size trend, $f_c\sim\ln p/p$, is consistent with a coupon-collector interpretation. Ablations show that a complexity gate matches a train-loss gate in rescuing failing seeds with $27\%$ less intervention; among the tested signals, only map complexity marks the transition's completion; the certified prior and the per-parameter $\nabla K$ attribution are both fungible (a uniform-prior sensor makes bit-identical gate decisions, and random supports match $\nabla K$-selected ones above a sparsity threshold); and direct field perturbation shows a nucleation-like response to the Occam field (no linear regime is resolved over the probed amplitudes, so these measurements do not justify a fluctuation--dissipation surrogate), with a finite-field response growing by orders of magnitude toward the transition. These measurements account for the empirically tuned staircase: bang--bang pulses, stall-fired and released on yield, whose iteration plausibly builds the response it exploits. The kick transfers to sparse parity and to a transformer; a sustained weight-space loss fails. The algorithmic estimator's distinct contribution is timing (when to fire and when to release), not attribution.

</details>


### [568] [SPICE: Simple Polysemantic Feature Interpretation via Clustering-based Explanation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13198)
*Sehyun Lee,Dahee Kwon,Damin Lee,Jaesik Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SPICE是一个通用、无需预设K的框架，用于跨CNN与Transformer系统分析神经元的多义性（polysemanticity）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经网络可解释性中多义性研究局限于特定架构，且依赖固定概念簇数量K等人工启发式，缺乏通用性与可扩展性，尤其难以适用于现代Transformer模型。

Method: 提出SPICE框架，避免架构相关的传播规则，可自动确定每个神经元的概念簇数量，从而消除对预设K的依赖，实现跨CNN和Transformer的规模化多义性分析。

Result: 通过SPICE首次对CNN与Transformer的多义性进行系统比较，并全面研究了多义性如何产生、如何随深度与架构变化，以及如何通过不同计算路径形成。

Conclusion: SPICE提升了多义性分析的通用性和可扩展性，为深入理解深度视觉架构中的神经元功能与多义性机制提供了统一工具。

Abstract: One of the pivotal recent challenges in neural network interpretability is polysemanticity, where a single neuron is activated by multiple, often unrelated concepts, hindering clear functional understanding. Although prior work has explored this phenomenon, existing approaches remain architecture-specific and depend on manual heuristics such as a fixed number of concept clusters ($K$), limiting their generality and scalability--especially for modern Transformer-based models. To address these limitations, we introduce SPICE (\textbf{S}imple \textbf{P}olysemantic Feature \textbf{I}nterpretation via \textbf{C}lustering-based \textbf{E}xplanation), a generalizable framework for analyzing polysemanticity in deep vision architectures. SPICE avoids architecture-dependent propagation rules, enabling the first systematic comparison of polysemanticity across both CNNs and Transformers, and automatically determines the number of concept clusters per neuron, eliminating reliance on a preset $K$ and supporting scalable analysis for large models. Using SPICE, we conduct a comprehensive investigation into how polysemanticity emerges, varies across depth and architecture, and forms through distinct computational pathways.

</details>


### [569] [Discovering and Preserving Category Correlation Knowledge via Adaptive Reciprocal Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13199)
*Dawen Jiang,Zhishu Shen,Zeyu Liu,Tiehua Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自适应互惠知识蒸馏(AR-KD)，通过简化教师输出分布、匹配学生关系表示来改进知识迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 教师与学生模型间的规模差距阻碍了有效知识迁移；现有方法采用静态单向蒸馏，忽视了学生学习的动态性，无法对困难样本提供针对性指导。

Method: AR-KD对教师进行互惠自适应：将教师的类相关矩阵匹配到学生的关系表示，重塑教师预测结构以适配学生能力，从而缓解过度自信教师导致的类间暗知识坍塌。

Result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1k上超越最先进基线；学生精度提升最高7.13%，比vanilla KD平均高1.42%–4.15%，与其他先进方法结合可进一步提升。

Conclusion: AR-KD通过关系对齐实现更丰富、更兼容的监督信号，有效提升同质与异质设置下的学生性能。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation aims to improve the performance of lightweight student models by transferring knowledge from larger and more powerful teacher models. However, a substantial size gap between teacher and student models often impedes effective knowledge transfer. Most existing approaches adopt a static, one-way teacher-to-student distillation paradigm, which overlooks the dynamic nature of student learning and fails to provide targeted guidance on hard samples. In this paper, we propose adaptive reciprocal knowledge distillation (AR-KD), a novel method that improves knowledge transfer by simplifying the teacher's output distribution. Specifically, AR-KD performs reciprocal adaptation on the teacher by matching its class correlation matrix to the student's relational representation, which reshapes the teacher's prediction structure to better suit the student's capacity. This relational alignment mitigates the collapse of inter-class dark knowledge caused by overconfident teachers, enabling the student to learn from richer and more compatible supervisory signals. We evaluate AR-KD on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1k classification datasets, where it outperforms state-of-the-art knowledge distillation baselines. Specifically, AR-KD improves student performance across homogeneous and heterogeneous setups: up to 7.13% accuracy gain for students, 1.42% to 4.15% higher than vanilla KD on average, and further improvements when integrated with other advanced methods. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ARKD/.

</details>


### [570] [Criticality in Dissimilar Decomposition and Undersampling of Random Datasets with Anomalies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13201)
*Ghurumuruhan Ganesan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究当训练数据中混入大量由当前LLM生成的AI数据（视为链接到主数据点的异常）时，随机数据集的分解与欠采样性质，揭示最小强相异分解规模的相变现象及强相似性的规模临界性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来LLM的训练数据将包含大量由当前LLM生成的AI文本/图像数据，需要理解这种数据构成如何影响批量分解，进而影响新LLM的性能。

Method: 将AI生成数据视为链接到主数据点的异常，利用冗余图和迭代技术，分析整体随机数据集的分解与欠采样性质，推导最小强相异（SD）分解规模的界，并用类别数据集举例验证。

Result: 得到最小强相异分解规模的界，并展示相变现象：当异常数量较少时最小规模主要由主数据点决定，超过某阈值后则被异常"接管"；同时建立了随机欠采样数据集强相似性的规模临界性结果。

Conclusion: AI生成数据作为异常会显著影响数据集的分解结构与欠采样性质，存在明确的相变阈值和规模临界点，这对未来LLM训练数据的构建与性能有重要启示。

Abstract: Training datasets for upcoming LLMs would include a significant amount of AI text/image data generated from current LLMs. In such a scenario, it is important to understand how this affects batch decompositions and thereby, the performance of the resultant new LLM. In this paper, we consider AI generated data as anomalies ``linked" to main data points and study decomposition and undersampling properties of the overall random dataset. We use redundancy graphs and iteration techniques to obtain bounds for the minimum size of a strongly dissimilar (SD) decomposition and demonstrate a phase transition phenomena, wherein the minimum size is essentially determined by the \emph{main} data points when the number of anomalies is small and is ``taken" over by the anomalies above a certain threshold. We also establish a size criticality result for the strong similarity of a randomly undersampled dataset and illustrate our results with examples involving categorical datasets, whose overall space size is much larger than the size of the dataset.

</details>


### [571] [Do Tabular Foundation Models Still Need Feature Engineering?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13202)
*Yifan WU,Pinjun Dong,Jiran Tao,Binyan Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对两大表格基础模型（TFM）家族多版本进行受控研究，测试多种特征工程技术在TabArena基准数据集上的效果。发现特征工程增益集中于早期模型代际，对最强模型几乎无效；而加入相关数据集的上下文信息仍能提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 特征工程长期是表格机器学习的核心，但表格基础模型（TFM）通过上下文学习直接应用，其兴起引发疑问：随着模型能力增强，手工特征构建是否仍然重要？

Method: 对两大TFM家族的多个版本进行受控研究，在TabArena基准数据集上测试广泛的现有特征工程技术；并补充实验，引入来自相关数据集的上下文信息。

Result: 特征工程增益集中在早期模型代际，对最强模型趋于可忽略；而加入相关数据集的上下文信息仍能提升性能。

Conclusion: 更强TFM的性能增益来源发生转变：重新表征现有输入（特征工程）效果减弱，而提供额外任务相关上下文仍有益。更强的TFM对显式设计的输入表征依赖更少。

Abstract: Feature engineering has long been a cornerstone of tabular machine learning. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are pretrained on a wide range of tabular datasets and applied via in-context learning. Their rise raises a natural question: does manual feature construction still matter as these models become more capable? To answer this, we perform a controlled study across several versions of two major TFM families, testing a wide range of existing feature engineering techniques on benchmark datasets from TabArena. We find a consistent pattern: feature engineering gains are concentrated in earlier model generations and become negligible for the strongest models.
